Bring her 20 Spore Puff wisps from Stonecap Keep so she can see what it was made of. Up the Walls Story 54 Garrick Garrick wants to know what can be seen from the top of Stonecap Keep. Climb to the highest point of the Battlements, the old lookout over the first wall. Shiny Things, Found Story 56 Wilf Wilf always wanted to know where the Shrooms were carrying their shiny things. The answer is up the walls of Stonecap Keep. Collect 20 Stolen Trinkets from the Hoarder Shrooms on the Battlements. Brass and Tin Story 57 Mott Mott the pedlar has heard where his stolen wares went. Recover 15 pieces of Pedlar's Tinware from the Hoarder Shrooms of Stonecap Keep. Old Wall Iron Story 58 Gareth Gareth has seen the iron coming out of Stonecap Keep's walls. Bring him 30 pieces of Old Wall Iron from the Crowncaps of the Inner Ward, and he will forge the next tier of equipment from it. A Draught for the Dust Story 60 Bram The dust of Stonecap Keep is giving the hunters who come back from it a cough. Bram wants 25 Spore Puff sacs to work out a draught for it, and will teach you the recipe. The Old Wall's Marks Story 61 Lottie Lottie has heard there are masons' marks on the stones of Stonecap Keep. Copy the marks on the keep's gate and on the west and east towers of the Battlements for her notebook. The Inner Ward Story 63 Hale Hale wants the way through the Inner Ward of Stonecap Keep cleared before anyone goes further. Defeat 100 Wallcreeper Caps and Crowncaps, and 3 of them that are Disturbance-touched. Meg's Count Story 66 Meg Meg is keeping count in the Inner Ward, and she wants your number in her book next to hers. Defeat 150 of the Inner Ward's Wallcreeper Caps and Crowncaps. What Drove It Out Story 68 Hale Hale has wondered all year what drove old Mano out of the woods. The answer is at the top of Stonecap Keep. Reach the foot of the Crown Tower at the far end of the Inner Ward. Said Out Loud Story 70 Hale Bring the Cap King down at the top of the Crown Tower, then go and see Meg: Hale has something he wants her to hear. The Keep Bounty Repeatable 55 Hale Ranger Hale pays a bounty for keeping Stonecap Keep in hand: defeat 80 monsters on the Battlements or in the Inner Ward. He will pay it again, any time.

docs.title: Midbarium
docs.text: Quest Kind Level From Summary Boggles on the Road Side 14 Corwell Corwell's caravans come up later every month, and the Dust Boggles on the Canyon Road are part of why. Hunt 40 of them. Traders from the Woods Side 18 Corwell The Fairy Forest traders come up the Northern Woodland Trail, and the Snapping Lizards of the Young Woods have been snapping at them. Hunt 40. Boggle Dust Side 14 Harra Harra pays in cheese for Boggle Dust, which the Tolmach rub into hides against moth. Collect 25. Cheese for the Road Side 16 Harra Harra is sending a wheel of her best cheese to Corwell, who will pretend it is too dear. Take it to him, and hunt 30 Ridge Stumps on the South Path on the way. The Canyon Cairns Side 15 Ennek The Tolmach mark the canyon road with cairns, and Ennek wants three of them checked. Hunt 30 Dust Boggles while you are down there. Sure Footing Side 20 Ennek Ennek teaches the Tolmach way of walking ledges to those who will follow him along the narrowest ledges of the South Path. Walk behind him, three ledges, and learn Sure Footing. The North Ridge Patrol Side 16 Skarra Skarra sends a patrol over the North Ridge every day, and today it is short a pair of hands. Hunt 40 Ridge Stumps on the North Ridge and report at the Trail Watch post. Letters to the East Side 17 Odda Odda writes to an old friend in Fairy Forest each spring, and the letters go east along the Northern Woodland Trail. Hunt 40 Edge Lizards in the Edgewood so they get there. The Trail Watch Bounty Repeatable 15 Skarra Skarra pays the trail watch's bounty to anyone who keeps the roads clear: 50 of the roads' monsters, any time. Walk the Patrols Story 20 Hask The Old One asks you, who belong to none of the four families, to walk the trail watch's patrols and tell him the truth about them. Go to Skarra on the Uskari Rim. Red Dots Story 20 Skarra Skarra marks every sighting on her hide map with a red dot. Reach the newest dots on Windworn Hill and the Long Ridge, and hunt 40 Gnarled Stumps on Windworn Hill. A Safe Pasture Story 22 Sennu Sennu has kept the herds close to town all summer, and the near ground is eaten to the root. Scout the high pasture on the Long Ridge and clear 50 monsters there. A Word for Tavi Story 22 Sennu Sennu needs the trail watch on the ridge path the morning the herds go up, but she and Tavi will not speak to each other. Carry her word to Tavi. Three Goats' Tracks Story 23 Yarrek Last month three of Yarrek's goats strayed down a gully below the Long Ridge and came home wild. Follow their old tracks and hunt 40 Axe Stumps in what they ran from. The Worst Stretch Story 25 Tavi Tavi walks the worst stretch of the patrols personally: out along the Broken Ground to the far canyon bridge. Walk it together, look at the bridge, and hunt 60 Dark Axe Stumps on the way. Old Gnarl Story 28 Tavi The oldest of the ridge trees, Old Gnarl, has rooted on Howling Peak, and the stumps of the ridges grow thick around it. Tavi will take you up. End it. The High Pasture Story 28 Sennu The ridge pasture can be used again, and Mabbu wants to see it with her own eyes, though she has not climbed that far since her knees gave out. Walk her up slowly to the high pasture on the Long Ridge. The First Report Story 29 Hask You have walked the High Ridges from the North Ridge to Howling Peak. Tell the Old One the truth about them. Wood for the Fire Side 21 Ulm Ulm has kept the council fire for forty years and never let it burn low. Bring him 30 Dark Bark from the ridges, which burns slow and hot. Wedges for the Scaffold Side 24 Dorrek Dorrek climbs the highest scaffold himself before any mason goes up, and he wants it wedged tight. Bring him 30 Ridge Bark for wedges. The Cistern Count Side 21 Gorra Gorra keeps the stone cisterns that water the terraces, and it is time for her count. Check the four cisterns on the west terraces for her. A Stair of Her Own Side 22 Brakka Brakka dreams of carving the first new stairway down the cliff in a hundred years. Bring her 25 Dark Bark for her trial wedges, and look at the bare cliff on the Long Ridge where the stair's rock comes out of the mountain. The Tallest Ledge Side 20 Korrin Korrin swears the trail watch's scouts climb to the very top ledge of the North Ridge. Climb there and tell him what you can see. New Lashings Side 26 Vosk Twice this season Vosk has found the far canyon bridge's ropes gnawed half through. He is doubling the lashings at the anchors and needs stakes: bring him 20 Giant Firewood. Where Did You Come From? Side 20 Kesh Kesh asks everyone where they came from and what the road was like. Walk down to the Canyon Road so you can tell him properly. The Hard Bargain Side 30 Harra Fewer lowland traders make the climb every year, and Harra means to make the ones who come pay well. Bring her 20 Wild Boar Teeth, which the lowlanders prize. Twisted Wood Side 30 Zirra Zirra's best staves come from twisted trees, and her stock is at its lowest in a lifetime. Bring her the Gnarlwood that Old Gnarl drops. Spring Letters Side 30 Odda Odda's letter to her old friend in Fairy Forest is sealed. Take it to Corwell for the next caravan east. The Ridge Bounty Repeatable 21 Skarra Skarra pays the trail watch's bounty for the High Ridges: 60 of the ridges' stumps, any time. Touched on the Ridges Repeatable 22 Skarra Some of the ridges' stumps are Disturbance-touched: bigger, harder and shimmering. Skarra pays well for each one put down. The Second Stick Story 30 Kesh Kesh keeps two notched sticks: one for eagles, one for things he cannot name. Ask Korrin about the two notches on the second. The Boys' Lookout Story 30 Korrin Korrin and Kesh have a lookout above the terraces nobody knows about. Look out from it, then go and look at the far canyon bridge up close on the Broken Ground. What Hallek Did Not See Story 31 Hallek Hallek, the mason bitten on the far canyon bridge this spring, will tell what bit him, or what little there was to see. Take the account to Lessa. What Bites Story 32 Lessa Lessa wants to know the beast behind the bites she treats. Hunt 30 Cliff Gnawers at the Far Anchor and bring her 10 Gnawed Rope Ends so she can match the teeth. The Night Watch Story 33 Vosk Vosk will keep watch on the far canyon bridge after dark, with Brakka and with you. Hold the anchors at the Far Anchor through the night. Fresh Cable Story 34 Corwell Corwell has a coil of fresh lowland cable for Vosk. Carry it to him, and clear 50 Wild Boars from around the anchor stakes at the Far Anchor before the next gnawing. Grey and Bitter Story 35 Lessa Lessa's rimwort is nearly gone, and the Uskari have not brought any home since the hunts stopped. Gather 15 Rimwort on the Far Slopes and take it to Odda to dry. A Message for the Old One Story 36 Zirra Zirra has a message for Hask that she would rather die than deliver herself. Carry it to him, and hunt 60 Scarred Boars on the way. The Split Drum Story 37 Thrun The great drum's hide has split and only a great horned beast's hide could replace it. Thrun asks only that Vosk check the drum's stand. Wide Tracks Story 39 Skarra Goats are being taken from the edges of the herds. Inspect three raider tracks on the Ironback Flats for Skarra, and hunt 60 Flint Hogs there. The Raider Story 42 Bekk Bekk wants to track the herd raider, and his mother has forbidden him to go alone. You agreed to go with him at first light, but at dawn he was gone. Tell Skarra. Find Bekk Story 42 Skarra Bekk went after the raider alone. Find him on the Hot Rocks and get him out: hunt 40 Iron Boars, then see him home. Follow the Tracks Story 46 Bekk This time Bekk goes with leave, and with you. Follow the raider's tracks over the Hot Rocks (three places) and clear 80 Iron Boars from the way. Grimhorn Story 48 Bekk The raider is Grimhorn, a great horned beast on the Ash Mesa. Bekk waits at the edge; the fight is yours alone. Defeat it and bring Grimhorn's Hide to Thrun. The New Hide Story 48 Thrun Vosk and Thrun will fit Grimhorn's hide to the great drum. Fetch Vosk to the hall, then come back to Thrun for the drum's first beat. The Second Report Story 49 Hask The far bridge is held and the herds are safe from the raider, for now. Report to Hask. The Wild Goats Side 40 Yarrek Yarrek's three wild goats still bite and will not eat from his hand. Bring him 15 Rimwort to try on them. Back on the Bridge Side 40 Hallek Hallek is ready to go back to work on the far canyon bridge, if the gnawers are fewer. Hunt 60 Cliff Gnawers at the Far Anchor. Old Verses Side 45 Ahvi Ahvi is troubled by an old verse about beasts growing wild. Ask Odda and Thrun what verses they remember from the oldest part of the long songs. The Herds Go Out Side 46 Sennu With the bridge held, Sennu wants to take the herds out to the old far pastures. Hunt 80 Wild Boars on the Boar Runs before they go. More Bites Side 44 Lessa Lessa is setting more bones than ever, and her splints keep cracking. Bring her 20 Iron Boar Armor plates from the Hot Rocks to bind them. Kragvar Stone Side 40 Dorrek The masons wear out their hammers on the hard Kragvar stone. Bring Dorrek 30 Flint Hooves to make new hammer heads. A Quiet Word Side 35 Hask Hask wants to know what the families would say about the patrols, if he asked them in council. Have a quiet word with Zirra, Ulm and Odda. Far Slopes Bounty Repeatable 31 Bekk Bekk pays a Trail Watch bounty for 80 monsters of the Far Slopes, gnawers, boars and hogs alike. He will pay it again, any time. Far Slopes Elites Repeatable 32 Bekk Now and then a beast of the Far Slopes is touched by the Disturbance and grows fiercer. Bekk pays well for each such Elite brought down. The Greywater Story 50 Ennek Ennek has something to show you halfway down the South Path, at the Greywater Cleft. Go and look at the spring. Tell Your Mother Story 50 Ennek Ennek has to tell Sennu that the Greywater is dry, before somebody else does. Go with him to her tent in the Tolmach Camps. The Old Springs Story 52 Mabbu Mabbu remembers every spring that ran in the driest year. Check three old springs on the Dry Hills and hunt 80 Swollen Stumps there. A Shimmering Night Story 53 Imre Imre wants you on the highest terrace on a shimmering night, to see what Imre sees, and then out on the Weathered Rocks, where a dry storm is breaking. Dates and Dots Story 54 Tavi Imre left a book of dates with Tavi, and Tavi laid it beside Skarra's hide map. Carry Imre's book to Ahvi in the Brenna House. Hold the Old Camp Story 55 Skarra Skarra wants a Trail Watch post at the Old War Camp. Clear 100 monsters on the Weathered Rocks, then reach the camp. New Staves Story 56 Zirra Zirra needs new bow staves, and the canyon valleys are closed to her. Bring her 10 Sound Staves cut from the Swollen Stumps of the Dry Hills. The Old Walls Story 58 Brakka Brakka wants to know how the first Kragvar cut stone. Inspect three old walls in the War Camp Ruins and hunt 100 War Masks or Bone Hounds. Follow the Springs Story 62 Ennek The dying springs lead west and down. Go to the Red Ravine, look closely at three of the roots that run into the rock, and hunt 100 Stone Hulks. The Rootdrinker Story 66 Ennek In a hollow under the Red Ravine, a vast dead tree is drinking the highland springs dry. Ennek knows the way down: clear the Rootdrinker. The Greywater Runs Story 68 Ennek Go and look at the Greywater Cleft again. Then tell Sennu, and take the news to Mabbu. The Verse Story 68 Odda Ahvi has waited all summer for Odda's word on whether to sing her old verse at a gathering. Hear Odda out, then take her answer to Ahvi. The Gathering Story 69 Hask Hask has called the four families to the Great Hall. Hear Thrun's drum and Ahvi's verse, then sit in council and tell the Old One the truth he asked you for. By the Fire Side 60 Ulm Ulm wants someone to sit up by the council fire with him tonight. What he says there, he will not say in council: carry it to Hask. The Old North Stair Side 55 Dorrek Dorrek wants the patch on the old north stair checked, where his uncle Baruk fell. Inspect it on the North Ridge. The Founders' Trickle Side 60 Gorra Gorra can hear water running somewhere under the Founders' Cistern. Follow the trickle down the terraces and bring her 20 Swollen Wood to seal the leak. The Long Song Side 50 Neffa Neffa always stumbles on the same verse of the long song: Old One Varra's. Ask Ahvi, Thrun and Odda what Varra was like, and bring their answers back to Neffa. A Name in the Song Side 60 Neffa Deep in the oldest part of the long song is a chieftain who held the western edge 'behind a wall of faces'. Bring Neffa a Carved War Mask Shard from the War Camp Ruins and tell her what it was. The Beast Verse Side 62 Ahvi Ahvi wants to know whether her old verse about beasts grown wild is true. Hunt 60 Bone Hounds in the War Camp Ruins and tell her what you saw. Star Verses Side 58 Imre Imre is quietly gathering the Brenna names for the stars. Ask Ahvi, Thrun and Neffa what they call them, and do not say what it is for. Withered Reach Bounty Repeatable 51 Tavi Tavi pays a bounty for every hundred monsters of the Withered Reach, and will pay it again any time. Withered Reach Elites Repeatable 52 Tavi Tavi pays for every Elite of the Withered Reach brought down: the stirred ones, bigger and meaner than their kind. A Withered Reach Epic Repeatable 55 Tavi Now and then the Reach throws up something far worse than an Elite. Tavi pays well for every Epic brought down. The Canyon Stretch Story 20 Skarra There is a stretch of the watch's canyon trail Ketta will not walk. Go to the head of the rope-way at the east edge of the Uskari Rim and look down at it. Earn Her Trust Story 20 Ketta Ketta goes quiet whenever the cave comes up. Bring her 20 Boggle Dust and a Goat Cheese, and maybe she will talk. Let Ketta Lead Story 21 Ketta Ketta has decided to tell Tavi about the cave herself. Go with her to Tavi. Back into the Dark Story 22 Ketta Ketta is ready to see the cave again. Go down into the Dustfall Cave with her, as far as the Cold Draught. A Venom Gland Story 24 Lessa Lessa has been cleaning drake bites from the watch's canyon trail and guessing at each one. Bring her 5 Drake Venom Glands from the Frost Drakes of the Chill Caves. Hollowmaw Story 25 Ketta At the bottom of the Dustfall Cave, the great drake Ketta saw rules a lake in the dark. Go down with her and clear the cave, Hollowmaw and all. The Cave Is Held Story 25 Ketta Hollowmaw is dead. Go with Ketta to tell Tavi that the Dustfall Cave is held. Drakes of the Dustfall Repeatable 22 Ketta The drakes of the Dustfall Cave keep breeding. Ketta pays for every 60 brought down, any time.

docs.title: Fairy Forest
docs.text: Quest Kind Level From Summary Lights on the Hem Side 8 Ondine Carters from Kaldemor say the Forest's Hem is crawling with bubblings. Thin them out so the travelling lights get through. Dew from a Far Grove Side 11 Tansy The near leaves have run dry, and Tansy's dew tea needs dew. Bring her Glimmer Dew from the slimes of the Glimmer Path. Herbs from the Glimmer Path Side 10 Hesper The Glimmer Path is too dangerous now for Hesper's gardeners. Gather marjoram there for her. The Council's Letters Side 12 Ilwen Ilwen needs the Grove Council's letters carried down the Eastern Forest Road to Mayor Tobin of Kaldemor. Harvest Carts Side 9 Kestrel Kestrel's parents' harvest carts need the Forest's Hem clear. Clear it with her. Road Patrol Repeatable 10 Kestrel The roads never stay clear for long. Kestrel pays for every patrol. A Colour Like Dusk Side 12 Faelan Faelan needs glimmerwing dust for coloured glass. It is a secret. From Linnet especially. Water for a Secret Side 13 Linnet Linnet wants clear water and soil from a Bloomwood glade for her secret seedling home. A Flower from the Bloomwood Side 14 Halcy There is a flower in a corner of the Bloomwood that Halcy can no longer safely reach. Counting Glimmerwings Side 15 Juniper Juniper wants to know whether the glimmerwings have spread since last year. Count them the hard way. Letters for the Capital Side 15 Ilwen The Council's letters for the capital must reach the royal road's last waystone, where the Selsior couriers collect them. The Night Diggers Story 20 Merrow Merrow's seedling beds keep being dug up in the night. Find out what is doing it. Sitting Up with Ailo Story 20 Ailo Sit up one night in the Herb Gardens with Ailo and watch the seedling beds. Past the Last Lantern Story 21 Seren Seren will let you past the last lantern if you stand a night watch with Thorne first and keep him from charging into the dark. Bitter Water Story 22 Hesper The churned soil smells bitter. Bring Hesper water from Shimmerwater so she can find out why. A Cleansing Draught Story 24 Hesper Hesper means to cleanse the slimes' poison with a draught of lake reed from the third Shimmerwater path. Something Grey at the Lakehead Story 26 Seren Seren's guards have seen something huge and grey at the head of the lake. Find the way up to it. The Blightstone Story 28 Seren Defeat the Blightstone at the Lakehead so the lake can heal. The Beds Stay Whole Story 29 Merrow The seedling beds have stayed whole. Merrow wants to walk out to the last lantern himself, for the first time in years. The Shimmerwater Watch Repeatable 22 Seren The lake creatures are still sick and savage. Seren pays for every watch kept on the Shimmerwater paths. Touched by the Disturbance Repeatable 24 Seren The worst of the lake's creatures are Disturbance-touched. Seren pays well for each one put down. A Safer Way to See Side 22 Lumi Liri means to sneak past the last lanterns to see a monster. Lumi wants a safer way, so nobody has to tell on anybody. The Plant from Near the Edge Side 23 Ailo Celandine wants a plant that grows only near the Forest Edge. Ailo would rather she did not have to go. The Trick That Works Side 21 Orla Orla has decided Thorne needs to laugh more. Help plan the trick that finally works. Catching the Trickster Side 22 Thorne Thorne is going to catch whoever keeps moving his things. He wants help setting a trap, and something to do while he waits. The Swarming Shore Story 30 Kestrel Creatures are spilling up out of Shimmerwater onto the High Shore. Clear it with Kestrel. Kestrel's Report Story 31 Kestrel Kestrel is hurt and too stubborn to come in. Carry her report to Seren. Ironbark Shafts Story 33 Seren The watch's spears are snapping on the new hides. Seren wants ironbark from the Hollow Oak's deadfall for new shafts: wood the forest can spare. Something That Would Rather Not Be Drawn Story 35 Juniper Juniper wants to draw the sharpened Lupins in the Hollow Oak's boughs. They would very much rather she did not. The Lost Season Story 38 Juniper Juniper lost a notebook last autumn, climbing out of the ravine below the oak with something large below her. She thinks it ended up high in the oak. The Back of the Seed Book Story 40 Hesper More hurt travellers, with wounds that should not have come from the animals that made them. Hesper is ready to show her list to the seal scholars. Three Kinds, Sharpened Story 42 Caelum Caelum needs fresh evidence to set beside Hesper's list: samples from three kinds of sharpened creature on the Hollow Oak. Before Dark Story 45 Seren Juniper has gone up the Hollow Oak alone. Bring her back before dark. Old Grizzlemane Story 46 Juniper The ape in the Hollow Oak's crown drives everything below it down and out. And it has Juniper's notebook. Not Wrong Yet Story 49 Caelum With Hesper's list, Juniper's notebooks and the lost season, Caelum has built his thirty-second theory. It needs checking. He needs sleep. Shore and Oak Patrol Repeatable 32 Kestrel The shore and the oak never stay clear. Kestrel pays for every patrol. The Touched of the Oak Repeatable 34 Seren Disturbance-touched creatures nest in the Hollow Oak. Seren pays well for each one put down. Oriel Lingers Story 50 Niv Oriel seems worried and lingers in the oldest homes. Niv wants to know why, so Niv can help. The Homes That Will Not Wake Story 51 Oriel A handful of the very oldest homes woke late this spring, with thin sap and cold rooms. Help Oriel examine one without alarming the family inside. Something for Aspen to Point At Story 52 Linnet Aspen must not notice the sleeping homes, or everyone will know by supper. Linnet has a plan. Soil and Root-Water Story 53 Oriel Oriel needs soil and root-water from where the forest's great roots break the surface in the Deepening. Further Out Story 55 Oriel Something further out is choking the root. Oriel wants the Deepening cleared enough to follow it. What the Wind Says Story 57 Sorrel Walk with Sorrel to the outer lanterns at dawn and tell him honestly what you hear. Then follow it. The Farthest Lantern Story 59 Ondine The western outer lanterns keep dimming. Ondine needs one replaced too far out for the workshop to reach safely. Spring-Glow Story 61 Ondine Ondine wants spring-glow from the Twilit Wood's springs for a stronger glow-oil. Nineteen Years of Lanterns Story 63 Ondine Ondine has written down how bright she made the outer lanterns every autumn for nineteen years. It is time the Eldest read it. The Watch Goes Out Story 64 Seren With her new guards, Seren takes the watch out into the Twilit Wood with you. Keep Thorne from charging into the dark. Following the Root Story 66 Oriel Oriel comes out himself, for the first time in years, to follow the root to where it is being strangled. The Knotbriar Story 68 Oriel A vast, deeply touched bramble is knotted round the forest's oldest root at the Hidden Spring. Cut it free. The Sap Rises Story 69 Oriel After the Knotbriar, the sap rises in the oldest homes, late but green. See who else felt it. The Gloaming Watch Repeatable 52 Seren The Gloaming never stays quiet. Seren pays for every watch kept out there. The Deeply Touched Repeatable 56 Seren The worst of the Disturbance-touched are deeply touched. Seren pays dearly for each one. The Gap in the Numbering Story 20 Wynne Wynne found a gap in the numbering of one old seal record: leaves removed long ago, cleanly and skilfully. She wants help searching the oldest shelf lists. The Shelf List Before the Shelf List Story 21 Ilwen In the oldest shelf list, beside the seal record, is a note in a hand nobody knows. Faelan's First Lantern Story 22 Faelan The old wing has had no light in living memory. Faelan wants to make the lantern that goes in. Corisande's Key Story 23 Corisande Corisande keeps the key to the old wing, as her mother and grandmother did. Nobody has ever asked her to open it. The Rootbound Wing Story 24 Corisande Go through the old wing to its heart and find whatever was kept apart there. Whom to Tell Story 25 Wynne The fragments' leaf numbers fall inside Wynne's gap. She has decided, at last, whom to tell. Still Enough Side 30 Sorrel Sorrel teaches Blink to any traveller who can sit through one of his listening lessons without fidgeting. Rest for the Scholars Side 26 Calyra The Eldest wants her seal scholars to rest, and knows they will not listen to her. A Spring Basket Side 40 Calyra An old friend among the Brenna of Midbarium visits Calyra each spring. Calyra wants a basket ready, and the roads made safer for the visit. A Discrepancy Side 18 Thessaly Thessaly's ledger and Ilwen's minutes disagree about one promise. Thessaly does not tolerate disagreement in records. The Promise to the Gardens Side 24 Thessaly The Council promised the Herb Gardens a new well, and Thessaly means to see it kept. The well needs stone, and the stone is on the roads. A Sealed Letter Side 27 Isaura Isaura needs a sealed letter carried to the Eldest. It must not be opened on the way. Quiet Shelves Side 45 Isaura Since the old wing was opened, Isaura wants its loose pages gathered before they are lost for good. The Pane Ondine Hasn't Noticed Side 23 Faelan Faelan broke a pane on the outer path. He needs to replace it before Ondine notices it is out. The High Bridge Side 28 Linnet A storm cracked a high branch-bridge. Linnet wants it mended before nightfall, with deadfall wood the forest can spare. The Day the Expedition Came Home Side 12 Aspen Aspen wants to tell someone the story of the day the Great Expedition came home. All of it. Old Friends Side 54 Aspen Aspen has noticed Oriel working late in the old homes. He has decided not to tell anyone, which is a first. The Lost Verse Side 16 Lyra One of the old songs about the Balrog War has a hole in it. Lyra wants the missing verse. A Song Nobody Asks For Side 33 Lyra There is one old song nobody has requested in years. Lyra wants to sing it for someone who asks. Cakes for the Heart Tree Side 19 Tansy A scholar has not left the Heart Tree in three days. Tansy is sending cakes, whether they like it or not. A Week Without Galen Side 21 Aurel Aurel loves his brother. Aurel would also love one week of lessons without Galen dropping by. The Lost Lesson Notes Side 14 Aurel Aurel has lost his lesson notes. Again. Before the bell. Again. A Stubborn Seedling Side 15 Amaryl Amaryl needs a stubborn seedling for her lessons: one that will not grow easily, so her students learn to coax. Practice Without Watching Side 20 Amaryl Amaryl wants Siora to practise somewhere nobody watches. Siora must not realise Amaryl arranged it. The Hazel That Answered Side 25 Siora Once, a hazel answered Siora's spell. She wants to find it again and learn why. The Truer Letter Side 32 Siora Siora writes cheerful letters home every month. This month she wants to write a true one, and needs courage first. A Quarter of an Hour Side 12 Liri Liri needs to sit still through Sorrel's listening lesson for a quarter of an hour. She would rather fight a monster. A Drawing of a Real Monster Side 26 Liri Since the last lantern, Liri wants a proper drawing of a real monster for her wall. Juniper draws them. What Came Out at the Carts Side 17 Alder Something came out of the dark at the carts on Alder's road to the forest. He will not talk about it. He wants to know. The Smell of the Sea Side 29 Alder Alder misses the sea. The nearest thing to it in the forest is the lake at Shimmerwater. Tea and a Little News Side 11 Briony Briony wants a pot of tea and a carefully chosen piece of news carried to her sister. A Quarrel Before It Reaches the Council Side 38 Briony Two families of the Lantern Paths are quarrelling over a shared branch-bridge. Briony wants it settled over tea, not in the chamber. Questions for Grown-Ups Side 13 Lumi Lumi has questions that grown-ups won't answer. Lumi wants you to ask them instead. A Story from Far Away Side 15 Sefa Sefa wants a story from a far town for the great collection: Kaldemor's, from the mayor himself. True or Not? Side 35 Sefa Sefa has a story about the Hollow Oak's crown. Sefa will not say whether it is true. Go and see. Standing Quietly Side 18 Niv Niv stands at the edge of the glade every day. Niv would like company, if it is quiet company. A Trick for Siora Side 24 Orla Orla thinks Siora is far too serious about her fizzling spells. A gentle trick might help. A Newcomer Who Is Struggling Side 30 Halcy Halcy helps newer arrivals find their way. One is struggling, and Halcy thinks Niv could help. The Watch Drill Repeatable 20 Thorne Thorne runs a drill every night. It mostly involves him charging at things. He wants a partner.

docs.title: Urbanograd
docs.text: Quest Kind Level From Summary The Table Argues Story 20 Rook A tunnel under the walls is a way into the city no gate guards, and the only door to it is the locked iron door under the Great Hall. Rook puts the question to the Open Table: hear Bastian and Quint, then come back for the Table's answer. The Undercroft Story 20 Leland The iron door under the Great Hall is open, and Leland is its keeper. Go down into the Undercroft, the old keep's buried halls, and clear the dust drifters and creeping slimes that have had the place to themselves for a hundred years. The Floodwells Story 22 Leland Below the Undercroft lie the Floodwells, the fortress's old cisterns, flooded halls crossed by narrow walkways. Leland needs them crossed and the floodwell eels thinned before he can chalk the way on. The Warm Quarry Story 25 Leland With Ferro's grate across the tunnel mouth, the only way left is down: the Warm Quarry, where the Aristocrats cut Old Grad's dark stone. Something huge stands in it. Defeat the Warmstone Colossus and bring Leland back a chip of the stone. Low Grad Rounds Repeatable 20 Leland The Warm Quarry does not stay quiet. Every so often Leland hears stone moving down there again. Go down, put the Warmstone Colossus down once more, and come back up. He will ask again, any time. Letters to the Queen Side 22 Rook Rook's fortnightly letter to Queen Aveline is late. Take it by way of Nana Gristle's bench, who always has something to add, to Perch's loft on the Crooked Tower, then tell Rook it has flown. The Quiet Ones Side 40 Rook The carters and small traders who used to sit quietly at the back of the Open Table are out on the Walkers' Road, waiting on caravans the boars keep stopping. Thin the bristle boars and ironhide hogs of the Bristlewood so they can come home and be heard. Octopus Ink Side 20 Dimity 'Inkpot' Ash Dimity 'Inkpot' Ash is copying the Table's oldest record book before it crumbles, and the city's ink is too thin to last. Bring her pool octopus tentacles from the Halfway Stone for a darker, longer-lived ink. The Oldest Volume Side 24 Dimity 'Inkpot' Ash Dimity has finished a first bundle of fair copies from the Table's oldest record book. She and Ozzie Lantry agreed to tell each other first about anything old; carry the copied pages to Ozzie's corner of the Great Hall. Reading Slowly Side 22 Quint Every Walkout Day Quint reads the Open Charter before the play, and every year Dina Finch says he reads too slowly. Ask Dina how she times the cart's first entrance to his reading, and bring her answer back to Quint. The Cedar Case Side 36 Quint The lining of the cedar case that keeps the hall's copy of the Open Charter is cracking, and damp is the scroll's worst enemy. Quint wants dry, springy moss-bark from the barkbacks of the Bristlewood to reline it. Measure the Gap Side 23 Bastian 'Bellows' Krell Bastian 'Bellows' Krell wants numbers for his covered bridge over Lantern Square. Ask Vane, the rooftop bridge-builder, how wide the gap is and how much timber the bridge would need. Bastian Gives His Time Side 35 Bastian 'Bellows' Krell Bastian has talked over Rivet twice at the Open Table and is mortified. He means to give up his own time at the next gathering so Rivet can speak about the second lift, but Rivet must not know. Make sure Rivet comes. Tentacle Stew Side 20 Mags Fewer farm carts reach the city, and Mags's great pot, never emptied since her grandmother's day, needs feeding. Bring her pool octopus tentacles from the Halfway Stone for the stew. Rooftop Greens Side 26 Mags More of the great pot's greens come from the rooftop gardens every season. Go up to Old Parsnip's tubs near the Crooked Tower and ask what he can spare Mags this week. A Stove That Does Not Smoke Side 44 Mags The Great Hall's kitchen chimney is as old as the fortress and fills the hall with smoke on cold nights. Carry Mags's challenge to Margo 'Sparks' Venn, ask Bastian about a bellows to help the draught, and bring the ironhide hog tusks Margo needs for her grate. The First Winter Side 21 Ozzie Lantry Ozzie Lantry's history of Urbanograd has a hole in its middle: not one account of the Walkers' first winter. Ask the city's keepers of old things, Nana Gristle, Hambone and Thimble, whether they ever heard a word of it. Marguerite's Bobbins Side 33 Ozzie Lantry Nana Gristle said the bobbins packed around her mother on the Long Walk were blue, and Ozzie Lantry has never heard that before. Ask Nana about the lace bobbins again, and bring Ozzie boar bristle to bind his swelling notes. Empty Corners Side 34 Moth Moth's hat of names grows thinner every night: the salt sellers, wool carters and spice peddlers are not getting through. The bristle boars on the Tusk Path drive the traders off the road. Thin them. Counting Names Side 48 Moth The reed-lurkers of the Reedwater Bottoms have stopped the carts on the far road. Moth has an idea that breaks the old rule of the hat: save the best corners for outside traders. Clear the reed-lurkers, then take the idea to Rook as a question for the Table. The Twelfth Keeper Side 20 Lux Lux, the twelfth Keeper of the Lanterns, sends you along the evening round: to Perch's loft on the Crooked Tower, and to Tinsel's furnace about amber glass. The Aristocrat Lock Story 20 Hex The Open Table has agreed to open the iron door under the Great Hall, but nobody has ever opened its Aristocrat lock. Ask Leland, the old well-digger who watches the door, to show you the lock, and bring Hex the description. Good Red Side 19 Ochre Ochre needs good red for the Walkers' oldest pictures, and good red is made from a red earth dug outside the walls. The dark stumps of the Western Descent carry it in their roots: bring Ochre 25 Clods of Red Earth. Something That Bounces Side 20 Jinx Jinx wants juggling balls that bounce back, to delight the children of Lantern Square. Margo says dried seep toad spawn turns wonderfully rubbery: bring Jinx 15 Seep Toad Spawn. Brown Chalk Side 20 Figgy Figgy has every colour of chalk except a good brown. Ochre says bog-lurcher mud dries to a fine brown: bring Figgy 10 Mud Clumps from the Seepwater Foothills. Good Rope Side 21 Rivet Good rope from outside is getting scarce, and Rivet's lift runs on rope. Twisted adder skin makes a strong cord: bring Rivet 25 Adder Skins. Roofs to Avoid Side 21 Nana Gristle Nana Gristle warned Kite about the rotten gutter on the north end of the long roof over the Night Market. Kite jumped it anyway, and something happened. Nana wants Kite to admit she was right. Salve Base Side 21 Ivo Sable The salves that come in from outside are scarce, so Ivo is making his own. Cold seep toad spawn makes a cooling base for burn salve: bring Ivo 20 Seep Toad Spawn. A Washtub Side 21 Drum Drum wants something bigger and louder to beat on. Hambone, at the Old Barracks Yard, has an old washtub from the theatre. The Smashers Story 22 Lux Lux wants to know what breaks the outer lanterns. Follow the smashers into the Outworks, thin out the lampbats and find where they roost: the cellars under the outer towers. The Fifth Notebook Side 22 Edgar Penhallow Edgar has started a fifth notebook and does not yet know what it is about. He would like one rule of work from each of the two makers he admires most on the Row: Rivet and Cobble. New Panes Story 23 Tinsel The outer lanterns have lost their glass. Carry a crate of Tinsel's new panes from the furnace through the crowded Night Market to Lux before the outer lanterns go dark. The Secret Drawings Side 23 Bolt Bolt has one question about counterweights that only Rivet can answer, and cannot bear to ask it himself. Ask Rivet for him, without saying why. The Well Winch Side 23 Rivet Leland's old well shaft drops straight into Low Grad, and Rivet wants to rig a rope winch down it. Bring 15 more Adder Skins for the line, and ask Leland where the shaft can take the bolts. The Iron Grate Story 24 Ferro A tunnel in the Deep Roads runs out under the hills to an open mouth: a way into the city that no gate guards. Ferro will forge an iron grate for the Watch to set across it, but needs red clay for the forge: bring 15 Clods of Red Earth. Jinx Checks the Bucket Side 24 Jinx Before Tinder's show tonight, Jinx filled and checked Tinder's water bucket, three times, the way Tinder does. Now Jinx wants to know whether Tinder noticed, and cannot bear to ask. Lamp Oil Side 24 Tinder Tinder's fire-eating fuel smokes and stings. Lampbat wings are waxy with the oil of the lanterns they swarm; pressed, they give a clean-burning oil. Bring Tinder 20 Lampbat Wings. A Chip of Warm Stone Story 25 Tinsel Tinsel wants the chip of warm stone from the Warm Quarry for the glowing-glass experiments. Bring it to the furnace on Workshops Row. The Awl by the Door Side 25 Cobble Cobble left a scrap of hide and an awl by the shop door to see what Edgar would do with them. Both are gone. Cobble will not ask Edgar; you can. The Rhythm Outside Story 26 Drum For the first time, Drum plays the monster-rhythm outside the gate, on the Outworks' edge. Hunt the lampbats in the outer ditch while it plays, and see whether they scatter. A Tune for the Outer Wall Side 27 Saffi Saffi wants her tenth street tune to be the Outer Wall, but has never heard what the Outworks sound like at dusk. Go out to the Outer Ditch and listen for her. The Rain Rule Side 28 Figgy Someone told Figgy that a drawing washed away by rain is a drawing ruined, not finished. Figgy wants the matter judged properly, by Nana Gristle, who judges everything. Testing Springs Side 29 Bolt Bolt set a row of test spring-traps along the outer ditch to see how springs hold up in the damp. The ditch rats keep setting them off and making off with the bait. Clear 40 of them so the test counts. A Wall for Figgy Side 30 Ochre Ochre has secretly found a wall for Figgy: the low wall under the Fiddler's Crossing, right below one of Splash's bridges. Carry one pointed remark to Splash and bring one back, then tell Figgy the wall is hers. The Middle of the Square Side 30 Tinder Tinder wants to play one big show right in the middle of Lantern Square, the biggest in years. Ask Jinx to warm up the crowd and keep it back, and tell Ivo the first coins of the night are his. A Letter Home Side 31 Edgar Penhallow Edgar is writing his report home to the guild, and it must be exact about the rooftop boot. He needs one detail of the sole from Cobble. The Returned Box Side 32 Hex Hex cannot remember the trick of an old walnut puzzle box that came back unopened. Something rattles inside. Hex thinks a good ear might hear the sequence: take the box to Drum. The Basket Side 32 Nana Gristle Nana Gristle has remembered something about her mother's basket on the Long Walk: a ribbon. She wants Ozzie Lantry, the Walkers' historian, to write it into his history properly. The Thin Whistler Side 33 Saffi A thin person with a tin whistle haunts the edge of Lantern Square whenever Saffi plays, and never plays a note. Saffi wants to know why. The whistler is Piper, the troupe's songwriter. Names on the Tang Side 35 Ferro Ferro has a throwing knife back from the Gate Walk to mend, and a question nobody has ever asked out loud. Go and see Shade, the road guide who carries Ferro's knives. The Caravan Wounds Side 36 Ivo Sable Travellers keep coming to Ivo's awning with tusk wounds from the Bristlewood road. Thin out 40 bristle boars along the road, then ask Patch at the Gate Walk what she uses for tusk wounds. Spark Powder Side 38 Margo 'Sparks' Venn Margo's spark lamp needs a powder that flashes bright and burns clean. Ground ironhide tusk, she has decided, is the answer: bring her 15 Hog Tusks. The Spark Lamp Story 40 Margo 'Sparks' Venn The spark lamp is ready for real boar. Go with Zip: she takes the lamp, you thin the bristle boars and ironhide hogs while she tests it, and then she brings it back to Margo, as she promised. A Boar-Spear Head Story 45 Ferro Hatch is planning a hunt at the Wallow, and Ferro will forge the boar-spear head for it. Ferro wants the hog's own tusks for the crossbar that stops a charging boar: bring 30 Hog Tusks. The Newest Lens Story 54 Tinsel Kite is laid up, and Starling needs Tinsel's newest lens tonight. Carry it up through the crowded evening streets to Starling's roof. The Beacon Ruins Story 57 Lux Lux wonders whether the old Aristocrat beacons on the downs could carry a light again. Clear the downs howlers from the Beacon Line so Lux can look. Good Hides Side 58 Cobble Good hides reach the city less and less, and Cobble hoards the best for the rooftop runners. The downs howlers on the Beacon Downs grow thick, tough pelts: bring Cobble 20 Howler Pelts. The Refused Message Story 50 Perch Perch's pigeons refuse to carry a message east over the downs. Walk it over the Lower Downs and release a young pigeon on the far side, past where the birds turn back. What Waits at Dusk Story 51 Perch The routes Perch's birds refuse at dusk they will fly at noon. Something hunts along them when the light goes: thin the duskhawks of the downs. Kite Laid Up Story 53 Kite Kite has twisted an ankle and cannot run. An urgent message from the gate has to reach Perch's loft on the Crooked Tower before dusk, over the Rooftops. A Flicker Night Story 55 Starling The new lens is in, and Starling thinks tonight is a flicker night. Borrow Perch's list of refused routes and watch the eastern horizon from Starling's roof. The Lower Beacon Story 57 Starling Starling has only ever seen the flicker from the Rooftops. Go to the Beacon Line, watch again from one of the lower beacons, and thin the duskhawks while you wait. The All-Hours Route Story 60 Perch A few routes Perch's birds refuse at every hour, and all of them cross the Ram Hills. Clear the rams and howlers along the route and bring back the great feathers the rams carry in their fleece. Across the Crest Story 63 Perch The great feathers come from the Crest. Climb across it toward the Highbeacon and bring down three of the Disturbance-touched duskhawks that guard the way. The Highbeacon Story 65 Perch Perch wants to know when the thing on the Highbeacon leaves its tower and when it sleeps. Ask Starling to watch it through the telescope. Stormcrest Story 66 Perch Stormcrest sleeps at noon on the Highbeacon, and the routes over its tower have been dead for years. Go up and face it. Dates and Lists Story 67 Starling Starling's flicker dates and Perch's list of refused routes go to Rook, who writes to Queen Aveline every fortnight. Perhaps somebody in Selsior knows what they mean. Earth for the Tubs Side 19 Old Parsnip Every handful of soil on the Rooftops was carried up the stairs, and more people want seed than ever. Old Parsnip needs the black mud of the bog-lurchers to fill new tubs. Rooftop Dash Side 20 Kite Kite teaches Rooftop Dash only to legs that have done the roofs: touch the ridge, the gutter run and the chimney stack on the Rooftops, in that order, then come back. Lines for Pounce Side 21 Rue Rue rehearses Juna's lines to Pounce the cat, who yawns at the best one. See whether Pounce is listening at all, then ask Dex what Rue is doing wrong. Bad News Side 22 Scrap Scrap found a cracked lantern pane in a gutter under the outer towers and named it Bad News. Lux keeps the lanterns and ought to see it. A Hat My Size Side 23 Sprout Sprout wants to play the grandee one day, mostly for the hat. Ask Thimble whether she could make one his size. The Funniest Year Side 24 Dina Finch Dina Finch is sure this year's play will be the funniest in a decade. The words of Juna's play never change, so ask Dex and Rue what they would do to make it funnier. A Red That Lasts Side 24 Splash Whoever paints the heron under the Fiddler's Crossing has run out of red, Splash says, and only raw red earth from outside the walls lasts. The dark stumps of the Western Descent carry it in their roots. The Crooked Tower Run Side 26 Kite Kite dreams of a run from the top of the Crooked Tower to the fortress gate without touching a stair. Run the line first, while Kite times it from outside. A Serious Role Side 26 Dex Dex has played the grandee for fifteen years and wants a serious role, just once, but whenever he says so everybody laughs. Tell Dina Finch he means it. The Third Play Side 27 Pip Marrow Pip Marrow has a finished play in a drawer that she thinks is only good. Ask Dina, in general and without saying whose it is, whether a play that is only good belongs on a cart. Seed from Kaldemor Side 28 Old Parsnip Old Parsnip's oldest vegetable varieties came from Kaldemor's farms long ago, and his seed drawers are running empty. Rue grew up on a farm out that way. Mother's Cake Side 29 Rue Rue's mother sends a cake from the farm every Walkout Day. This year's came on the cider cart and vanished from the theatre yard gate, and Hambone has been humming very loudly ever since. Sneaking on Shade Side 30 Scrap Scrap has sneaked up on everybody in the city except Shade. Keep Shade talking at the gate while Scrap creeps up from behind. The Oldest Jacket Side 30 Thimble Thimble keeps a scrap of every green Juna jacket she has sewn, but the very first jacket has never been found. Ask Ozzie Lantry whether any Walker paper mentions it. The Grandee's Fall Side 31 Sprout Sprout once did the grandee's fall off the Great Hall's table and landed on his elbow. Ask Dex how to do it properly, loudly, while Sprout listens from behind the curtain. The Walker Songs Side 33 Piper Piper keeps the Walker songs Ozzie Lantry once sang, all but the third verse of the fiddler's song. Ask Ozzie for it. Short of Timber Side 34 Vane Timber is scarce, so Vane binds the rooftop bridges with soaked bark instead. The Gutter Queen needs new strapping before the autumn winds: bring mossy bark from the Bristlewood's barkbacks. Seasoned Wood Side 34 Hambone Hambone wants seasoned wood, the kind that does not warp on a wet Walkout Day, and swears it is for the shed and not for any wheel. The barkbacks of the Bristlewood carry heartwood under their moss. The Walker Stars Side 35 Starling Starling's old star chart has the Walkers' names for the stars, but one name has faded away. Ozzie Lantry knows the Walkers' songs; perhaps one of them knows the stars. The Cart Must Roll Side 36 Dina Finch Dina knows about the cracked wheel Hambone has been hiding since spring. Tell Hambone, gently, that the cart must roll on Walkout Day, and find out what he means to do. Seen from the Gate Walk Side 36 Splash Splash wants to paint one picture travelers can see from the Gate Walk, and has decided that Kite gets to know what it is first. Carry the folded note to Kite, unread. Lark's Song Side 40 Dex On her day each year, Dex and Sprout sing one of Lark's songs on the Rooftops, and this year Dex lost the middle verse. Piper writes everything down; ask about the swallow song. Play with Saffi Side 40 Piper Saffi has heard the whistle parts Piper wrote for her street tunes, and now Piper cannot go near Lantern Square. Ask Saffi whether Piper may play with her, once. A New Rim Side 42 Hambone The cart's oldest wheel has new spokes, but its rim is split, and Hambone cannot bear to replace it. Ask Ferro whether an iron band could hold the old wood together. Scrap and the Roads Side 44 Vane Scrap has started asking about the roads, and Vane cannot test a road by jumping on it. Ask Shade at the Gate Walk what Scrap is really learning. A New Comedy Side 45 Pip Marrow Pip is writing a new comedy she will show nobody, and she needs something only Ozzie Lantry has, or rather does not have: the story of Juna's first winter. Feathers for a Small Hat Side 52 Thimble Thimble has secretly kept the grandee hat's trimmings in case a smaller hat is ever wanted. A small hat deserves better feathers: the duskhawks of the downs have the right ones. Tell nobody, especially Sprout. The Watch's Slate: the Road Repeatable 14 Brindle The Gate Watch pays a standing bounty from Brindle's slate: defeat 40 of the Walkers' Road's monsters, stack rats, pool octopi, verge adders or young gloomeyes. Every round raises Urbanograd's regard for you, and Brindle will pay it again, any time. The Late Egg Cart Side 14 Knox Knox knows every regular on the Walkers' Road, and the egg woman's cart is two days late. Clear the stack rats round the Halfway Stone so she can come through. Proof for the Notebook Side 15 Tick A traveler told Tick about a ford whose water ran backwards for an evening, and the pool octopi at the Halfway Stone have been crawling out of their pools ever since. Tick wants proof, one way or the other: defeat 25 pool octopi and tell him what you saw. Eyes by the Stackyards Side 16 Dagny 'Two-Lamps' Roe Dagny sees pairs of eyes in the dark beyond the road every night now, low in the stackyards below the gate. Hunt 30 young gloomeyes in the Gate Meadows and find out if those are the eyes. Meadow Herbs Side 16 Patch Patch's jars are emptying and Brindle will not let her into the fields alone. Thin out the verge adders in the Gate Meadows and bring back 10 bundles of the herbs they nest in. The Wool Carts Side 17 Torvi Brask The highland wool carters are late, stuck on the rotten boardwalks of the Seepwater Foothills where the bog-lurchers have come up out of the reeds. Torvi asks you to clear 30 of them. The Highland Traveler Side 18 Knox The old button-seller from the highlands walks down Stonefang Pass every season, and he has not come. Knox asks you to walk the Western Descent and clear the dark stumps from the switchbacks. A Count for the Slate Side 18 Brindle Brindle keeps a weekly slate of sightings by the gate, and Stonefang Pass has gone uncounted since the carters stopped reporting. Hunt 20 seep toads and 20 dark stumps along the pass and bring Brindle a count. The Night Watch Story 20 Brindle Brindle asks you to stand the night watch at the gate beside Dagny, then go down into the Outworks at dusk and hunt the gloomeyes whose eyes she sees in the dark. Morning Prints Story 21 Dagny 'Two-Lamps' Roe Every morning there are prints in the dust by the road below the gate. Dagny wants a proper count of the gloomeyes that make them: hunt 40 in the Outworks and report to Brindle's slate. Bite Herbs Story 24 Patch The lampbats' bites go bad if they are not cleaned, and Patch's jar of bite-cleaning herb is empty. It grows only in the Outworks' ditches, where the ditch rats drag it into their nests. Bring her 15 sprigs. Under the Fallen Tower Story 28 Brindle The lampbats roost under the Fallen Tower, and something leads them. Talk with Lux about what lives in the flooded vault, then come back to Brindle to plan the way in. The Gloamwing Story 28 Brindle Go into the flooded vault under the Fallen Tower and defeat the Gloamwing, the Disturbance-touched bat that leads the lampbats against the outer lanterns. Brindle will open the way. The Wanderer's Story Story 20 Tick Tick's notebook holds the story of a frightened wanderer who sheltered in a tunnel mouth in the hills, followed it underground and came out running with a stone that would not cool. Tick thinks Brindle should hear it. A Way In Story 20 Brindle If a tunnel runs under Old Grad's walls, it is a way into the city that no gate guards. Brindle will not act on it alone: take it to Rook, the Caller of the Open Table. The Deep Roads Story 24 Brindle Below the Floodwells, long sally tunnels run out under the hills. Somewhere along them is the tunnel mouth the wanderer came in by. Brindle wants it found: hunt 40 tunnel bats in the Deep Roads and reach the tunnel mouth. The Watch's Slate: the Outworks Repeatable 20 Brindle Brindle's slate pays for the Outworks too: defeat 50 lampbats, gloomeyes or ditch rats in the ruined defences under the walls. Every round raises Urbanograd's regard for you, and Brindle will pay it again, any time. The Eyes That Do Not Blink Repeatable 22 Dagny 'Two-Lamps' Roe Some of the gloomeyes in the Outworks are Disturbance-touched: bigger, bolder, eyes that never blink. Dagny wants them gone before they come up to the gate. Defeat 2 Elite gloomeyes. She will ask again, any time. Falling Lessons Side 22 Shade Shade once taught Scrap, the rooftop scamp, how to fall from a low wall without breaking anything. Shade wants to know whether the lesson took, without Scrap knowing who is asking. Go and watch Scrap fall. Beat the Record Side 22 Tick Tick means to beat Kite's record from the Gate Walk to the Great Hall, running by the streets instead of the roofs. He wants to know what Kite says about that. Ask Kite. Forty Lights Side 24 Prism Prism wants to paint the Long Walk in lights over Lantern Square on Walkout Day, but forty lights are the most Prism has ever held, and the square's lanterns drown them out. Ask Lux whether the lanterns can be dimmed for the show. What Bravery Costs Side 26 Zinnia 'Zip' Calloway Zip has heard that Torvi once said bravery was wasted on her, and she wants to know if Torvi still thinks so. She will not ask herself. Ask Torvi for her. Reading Tracks Story 30 Hatch Hatch is too old to hunt alone and wants someone worth teaching. His first test: at Bristlewood Edge, among the tracks of half a dozen beasts, follow only the bristle boars and bring down 30 of them. A New Route Story 33 Shade The hill path Shade used to bring caravans in by has tracks on it too large for any boar. Shade needs a new way past the Tusk Path: hunt 40 beasts along it and reach its far end. The Lost Notes Story 36 Hatch When his knees gave out, Hatch left his last camp in the Bristlewood in a hurry, and his notebook with it. The barkbacks have been through the camp since. Go to Hatch's Camp and find his notes. Zip's Bank Story 40 Torvi Brask Last spring Torvi saw tracks at the top of the stream bank where Zip fell, larger than any boar's. Go back to Zip's Bank at the edge of the Reedwater Bottoms, hunting reed-lurkers on the way, and measure them. The Rare Root Story 43 Patch Patch's best fever root grows only in the Silent Cutting, the wooded road Shade no longer walks. The barkbacks there grub it up and carry it in the moss on their backs. Bring her 5 Silent Roots. The Hunt at the Wallow Story 46 Hatch Hatch has a plan, a boar-spear from Ferro and a name for the beast: Hackleback. He cannot go himself. Make sure Torvi keeps Zip back from the Wallow, hear Zip out, then come back to Hatch for the way in. Hackleback Story 47 Hatch Go down into the Wallow at the heart of the Reedwater Bottoms and bring down Hackleback, the deeply touched boar that drives the lesser ones onto the road. Hatch will show you the way in. The Fourth Version Story 48 Tick Zip's broken arm is in Tick's notebook three times, in three versions, each with a bigger monster. Now that the beast is down, Tick wants the true story: hear it from Zip and from Torvi, then bring it to him. Hatch's Bounty: the Bristlewood Repeatable 30 Hatch Hatch collects a bounty from the caravans for every beast cleared from the Bristlewood and passes it on to whoever does the work: defeat 60 bristle boars, barkbacks, ironhide hogs or reed-lurkers. Every round raises Urbanograd's regard for you, and Hatch will pay it again, any time. The Touched Boar Repeatable 35 Torvi Brask Disturbance-touched bristle boars charge the caravans in the Bristlewood and do not turn aside for anything. Torvi asks you to put down 2 Elite bristle boars, and will ask again, any time. Owls for the Watch Side 30 Knox Knox wants to carve an owl for every post on the gate, and the best carving wood is the moss-cured bark of the Bristlewood's barkbacks. Bring him 10 pieces of Mossy Bark. The Long Walk in Lights Side 44 Prism Prism cannot hold hundreds of lights alone, but lights can rest on something: a frame of woven reeds, the way the forest weavers hang lanterns on the branch-bridges. Bring Prism 20 Reed Bundles from the Reedwater Bottoms. When to Run Side 50 Zinnia 'Zip' Calloway Zip stayed home from the Wallow, and it was the hardest thing she has ever done. Now she wants Torvi to tell her whether that counts as learning to run. Carry the question. Torvi's Bounty: the Downs Repeatable 50 Torvi Brask The caravans that cross the Beacon Downs pay Torvi to keep the high road open, and Torvi shares the purse: defeat 60 duskhawks, downs howlers or millstone rams. Every round raises Urbanograd's regard for you, and Torvi will pay it again, any time. Hawks That Hunt Late Repeatable 55 Shade Shade brings travelers in over the Downs, and the Disturbance-touched duskhawks stoop on them long after the others have gone to roost. Defeat 2 Elite duskhawks. Shade will ask again, any time.

docs.title: Bain Harbour
docs.text: Quest Kind Level From Summary Wolves in the Copses Side 12 Halloran The carters coming down the royal road say the scrub wolves are bold in the Chalk Downs' copses. Halloran wants them thinned. Pelts for the Tanner Side 12 Tully Tully knows a tanner who takes scrub wolf pelts as part-payment, and every coin goes towards his boat. Carts on the Hill Side 14 Garrow The bluff wildcats of Baysight Hill leap onto the cargo carts coming down to the docks. Garrow wants them gone. Hooks for Merriwether Side 15 Tully Merriwether pays well for good hooks, and wildcat claws make fine ones. Tully needs a little more for his boat. The Drying Racks Side 16 Cobb The coast families dry their catch on racks along the Dune Reach, and the dune cats raid them. Cobb asks for help. A Letter to Marram Cove Side 16 Brisa Brisa's midwinter letter to her parents travels inland by way of Marram Cove. She asks you to carry it there, and the road is full of dune cats. The Prettiest Shells Side 18 Bree Bree has heard the Long Sands' tide line has the prettiest shells on the island. The grey toms there are in the way. The South Shore Verse Side 18 Lorcan Lorcan needs a verse for the race shanty's stretch along the south shore. He sends you to walk the Long Sands and tell him what it is like. Watch Bounty: The Roads Repeatable 14 Jowan The Harbour Watch pays a bounty for the roads' monsters, again and again. Sea Legs Side 20 Garrow Garrow teaches sea legs to anyone who works his docks: keep your footing on a moving deck, and get up fast when you go down. A Crab With No Name Story 21 Bree Bree has caught a crab in her rock pools she cannot name: the shell is too hard and the wrong colour. She wants to know where it came from. Back and Bigger Story 22 Keziah The crabs Keziah and Tristram cleared below the headland in her first week are back, bigger, and coming up the Old Cut. Thin them and follow their cast shells. Stings in the Casebook Story 24 Clemence Clemence has written down two stings that match no jellyfish she knows. The glass jellies in the Old Cut's basins might be the answer. Kit on the Lock Gate Story 26 Alwyn Kit has gone up the Old Cut to see a sea creature, and the tide has filled the lock behind him. Find him on the lock gate at the Timber Ponds, clear the crabs and bring him home. The Bootbreaker Story 28 Keziah The great crab moulting in the Pinch is where the bootcrabs come from. Keziah asks you to put it down. A Claw Over the Bar Side 29 Keziah Keziah wants the Bootbreaker's claw hung over the bar at the Salt and Bread, and she has asked Delphine already. Logs in the Ponds Side 23 Dunstan Dunstan's seasoning timber floats in the Old Cut's timber ponds, and nobody can get to it for the crabs and jellies. Fourteen Knots Side 20 Kit Kit can tie fourteen knots, but he has forgotten the name of the last one Wilmot taught him. He sends you to ask. The Shell in the Pinch Side 27 Kit Kit wants proof that what he saw in the Pinch was real. He asks you to look at the cast shell he saw by the lock wall. Finch Wants to See One Side 21 Finch Finch has heard every sailor's story about the deep water, and he wants to see a sea creature with his own eyes. A snapjaw tooth would do for proof. Barley Sugar for the Watch Side 25 Finch Finch wants to thank Brisa for not telling Garrow about the outer pier, and Barnaby keeps barley sugar in his coat. A Lesson from the Cut Side 22 Maren Maren would like to know what has come up the Old Cut before she makes a lesson of it. Drawing the Old Cut Side 21 Poppy Poppy wants to draw the Old Cut as a chart, the way Ambrose would. She asks you to look at two places she cannot reach. A Barge in the Locks Side 22 Marisol A barge of Marisol's spices is stuck at the First Locks, its crates scattered by bootcrabs. She wants them back. Bolt Rope and Gnawed Canvas Side 20 Tegan Tegan needs bolt rope from Wilmot, and the snapjaws have been gnawing the canvas stored by the Old Cut's water doors. A Child for the Wheel Side 20 Wilmot Wilmot needs a child to turn the rope walk's wheel for a day, and fewer children come every year. Ballast for the Model Side 23 Peregrine Peregrine wants to tow his half-model again in the rock pools, properly weighted this time. Ironback claws are heavy and even. Watch Bounty: The Old Cut Repeatable 22 Jowan The Harbour Watch pays a bounty for the creatures coming up the Old Cut, again and again. A Touched Bootcrab Repeatable 24 Tristram Tristram pays for every Disturbance-touched bootcrab put down in the Old Cut. The Nicks on the Boat-Hook Side 20 Mabyn Mabyn wants to know whether Jowan and Quenna still remember the stories of Old Bain's boat-hook. A Strip of Net Story 31 Wenna Wenna has kept a strip of Cobb's torn net rolled in her basket, and shown it to nobody. She lets you carry it to someone who might know what made the tear. Long Straight Tears Story 32 Tegan The sails that come back from deep water carry the same long straight tear as Cobb's net. Tegan wants proof of what makes it, from the sea half of the Old Cut. The Shelf of Beach Finds Story 35 Maren Maren's grooved driftwood matches the sawbills' bites. She lends you a hand lens and asks for one whole sawbill bill so she can label her shelf at last. What Tears the Nets Story 37 Cobb Cobb has not been past the middle of the bay since his nets came up torn. He meets you on the Sea Locks and sets a net across the Cut to see what comes. The Sea End Story 39 Nerissa Nerissa's reef lies just outside the broken sea gates. She teaches you how the tide runs in through them, and asks for oysters from the old gate stones. The Night Run Story 41 Seraphine The Bright Morrow sails a night run past the headland, and Keziah cannot face it. Sail it in her place, and keep the leaping sawbills off the deck. Proof for Dunstan Story 44 Alwyn Alwyn wants his father to see what the sawbills do to a hull. Carry a sawbill bill and the scored plank from the night run to Dunstan's workbench. The Ripsaw Story 47 Cobb The sawbills follow one great fish, and Tristram has seen it lying up under the broken sea gates. Cobb asks you to put it down. A Tooth for a Needle Side 48 Tegan Tegan says a sailmaker could make something of a tooth the size of the Ripsaw's. Bring her its saw. The Long Scrape Side 36 Clemence One page of Clemence's casebook is a dockworker's long, straight, shallow scrape on the calf. She wants to compare it with a sawbill's bill. Cargo by the Sea Gates Side 34 Marisol Marisol's captains want to try the Old Cut again, now it runs salt to the sea. She wants the Salt Reach cleared first. Figures for the Vault Side 31 Ottilie Ottilie compares her ledgers with Hobart's chalk tallies every season. She asks you to carry the comparison down to the warehouses. The Dues Ledger Side 42 Ottilie Corwin and Annis argue about harbour dues at every council meeting. Ottilie asks you to fetch both captains' figures so the ledger can settle it. A Bag for the Heron Side 31 Lowen Lowen sails on the Heron soon, and his gran sewed him a kit bag after calling him a fool to the whole market. He is too embarrassed to fetch it. Stars on the Night Watch Side 38 Lowen Caspian promised to teach Lowen the night sky from the Heron's deck. Lowen wants the star chart Caspian keeps in Maren's old lesson book. Bearings on the Cut Side 34 Caspian Caspian wants exact bearings for the Old Cut's sea half, in case the Heron ever comes in that way. The Race Navigator Side 42 Caspian Caspian wants to navigate the race boat this summer. He has not dared ask the Harbour Master, and he asks you to sound her out. Tiller Work Side 33 Thaddeus Thaddeus has advice for young Lowen's tiller work, and Lowen goes the long way round his bench. Carry the advice. The Old Race Side 40 Thaddeus Thaddeus lost the summer race by a boat's length thirty-three years ago. He wants to know whether Annis still says she would have won. Salt Over the Stern Side 36 Annis Annis throws a pinch of salt over the stern every time she casts off. The salt barrel is low, and the best salt crusts on the Sea Locks' old stones, where the spitting sawbills nest. A Letter for Ossie Side 35 Morwenna Morwenna sails on the Saltlark tomorrow and wants a letter to reach Ossie at the lighthouse path. Waste Not Side 32 Corwin Corwin hates waste. Sawbill scales fetch a fair price for buttons and inlay, and the Salt Reach is thick with them. A Harpoon at the Bow Side 45 Corwin Corwin pays Tristram to stand the Heron's bow, and grumbles at every council about the cost. He wants Tristram's opinion of the Cut before the Heron tries it. The Swordfish Scar Side 34 Barnaby Barnaby swears the scar on his hand is from a swordfish. Nobody believes him. A sawbill's bill would be proof enough for the Salt and Bread. Faster Through the Cut Side 38 Peregrine Peregrine wants to tow his half-model in real current. The Salt Reach runs straight and strong. Heavier Timber Side 46 Dunstan Dunstan wants the heavy oak out of the far stack, and the sawbills nesting in the Sea Locks' timber are in the way. The Boat Under the Sailcloth Side 40 Tully Tully has looked at the narrow boat under a sailcloth on the beach below the Waterfront, and wants to know whose it is. A Second Pier Side 35 Garrow Garrow wants a second pier, and the council always says next year. He asks you to sound out the Harbour Master and Marisol. Two Endings Side 36 Lorcan Delphine told Lorcan to write two endings to his race shanty. He has written the winning one five times and the losing one never. Bread for the Bar Side 33 Delphine Bryony's bread comes to the Salt and Bread every morning. This morning it did not, and Delphine has a room full of sailors. Faster Than Finch Side 37 Brisa Brisa hears Finch has been asking about the Sea Locks. She wants to know what is there before he goes looking. Drawing the Outer Cut Side 35 Poppy Poppy's chart of the Old Cut stops at the Pinch. She asks you to look at the sea half for her. Old Bain's Goat Side 38 Mabyn Mabyn has never decided whether Old Bain's goat is true. Thaddeus claims his grandfather knew someone who knew. Watch Bounty: The Outer Cut Repeatable 36 Jowan The Harbour Watch pays a bounty for the sawbills of the Old Cut's sea half, again and again. A Touched Sawbill Repeatable 38 Tristram Tristram pays for every Disturbance-touched sawbill put down in the Outer Cut, and more for a deeply touched one. The Outer Pier Story 51 Halloran Halloran has stood the outer pier's night watch himself since spring. He asks you to stand it with him, and on the boards, at last, he tells someone what he found. Under the Pier Story 52 Halloran Halloran wants someone to look at the outer pier's pilings at the lowest tide. He has looked from above for months. Everyone Who Writes Things Down Story 53 Halloran Halloran has finally decided to ask for the notes. Half the harbour writes down what it sees, and nobody has put the pages together. Keeping the Light Story 55 Ysolde Ysolde's knees will not manage the hundred and seventeen stairs tonight. She asks you to keep the light, and to watch the water past the headland from the Holm Wood's cliff edge. The Blue Logbook Story 56 Ossie Ossie has something in his blue logbook he has told no one about. He wants you to check his dates against his gran's log. The Locked Chart Story 57 Ambrose Ambrose keeps a separate chart in a locked drawer, of every mark the captains have brought him. He will open it, with the Harbour Master's leave and with Jowan there. Where the Keel Was Brushed Story 59 Annis Annis gave Ambrose the mark the morning after something brushed the Saltlark's keel, bow to stern, on a still night in deep water. From the Cliff Edge you can see that water. What Seraphine Saw Story 61 Barnaby Barnaby wants Seraphine to see the scored keel timber. She has refused to describe what she saw in the deep water to anyone. Checking the Marks Story 63 Ambrose Ambrose's newest marks lie under the headland. From the Holm Wood's Old Fellings and the Rim, where the pale light comes up through the trees, they can be checked. The Ledge She Was Reaching For Story 65 Nerissa Nerissa stopped diving after something moved below the shelf at the reef's edge. She asks for a pearl from the ledge she was reaching for, and then she will tell. To See It Once Story 67 Tristram Tristram wants to see the thing in the deep water once, with his own eyes, not to kill it. Go with him at night to the rim of the Lantern Deep. The Deep Lantern Story 68 Quenna The Harbour Master takes it to the council. The thing in the sea-hole has a name now, and the harbour asks you to put it down. In Ink, Not in the Margin Side 69 Ysolde With the Deep Lantern gone, Ysolde writes the lights into the lighthouse log properly. She wants you there. The Council Hears It Side 70 Quenna The harbour council wants to thank you, loudly, as Quenna promised. Each of them wants a word. Birds for Miss Maren Side 58 Ossie Ossie wants Maren to see the bird page of his logbook. He is shy about it. The Ledger of Tales Side 58 Delphine Delphine has thought for years of showing her ledger of sea tales to Ambrose. Now that the drawer is open, she asks you to take it. Entry Sixty-Five Side 57 Brisa Brisa wants entry sixty-five in her list to be something she saw herself. The Crossways' whipshades will do. Welts in the Casebook Side 60 Clemence Clemence wants to compare the round welts in her casebook with the hooks of salt mist the shades leave behind. At the Wheel Side 62 Morwenna Morwenna had the Saltlark's wheel the night the keel was brushed. She has not told her mother or her son. Now she wants to. A Blank Chart Side 63 Seraphine Seraphine keeps a blank chart sheet in her cabin for waters past Ambrose's charts. Now she wants Ambrose to have what she saw. A Schoolhouse, One Day Side 60 Maren Maren brings the children's work to every council meeting and asks for a schoolhouse. This year she has a lesson about the Old Cut to show them. The New Marks Side 64 Poppy Poppy has drawn every new mark Ambrose put on the chart as you reported them. She wants him to see her copy. Twine for the Saltlark Side 50 Wenna The Saltlark's nets need mending before she sails deep again, and Wenna needs twine from Wilmot's rope walk. Watch Bounty: The Holm Wood Repeatable 55 Jowan The Harbour Watch pays a bounty for the Holm Wood's dusk wolves and lanternshades, again and again. A Touched Shade Repeatable 57 Tristram Tristram pays for every Disturbance-touched creature put down in the Holm Wood. The Stamp Story 20 Hobart Hobart has four iron-bound crates in the back of the oldest warehouse that nobody has ever claimed, and a stamp burned into their lids that nobody can name. Every Plank of Her Story 20 Kenwyn Kenwyn draws you a map of the Saltgrace and sends you down the salvagers' steps to see her mark with your own eyes. The Purser's Strongbox Story 22 Kenwyn A trading ship's purser kept her papers in an iron strongbox. Kenwyn knows where the Saltgrace's is, and what the mimics have made of the Holds around it. The Last Verse Side 22 Wilmot Wilmot learned an old song of homecoming as a boy, all but its last verse. Kenwyn swears the whole song is carved into the Saltgrace's forecastle beam. The Long Way Home Side 22 Lorcan Lorcan has heard that Wilmot has found the last verse of 'The Long Way Home', and he wants it sung at the Salt and Bread by the man who remembers the tune. The Holdfast Story 24 Kenwyn Kenwyn finally tells you what he saw in the Saltgrace's lowest hold this spring, and why the whole ship creaks. Seasoned Timber Side 25 Alwyn Alwyn wants old seasoned oak and iron out of the Saltgrace for the deep-water hull he has been drawing, and Kenwyn says she is safe to salvage now. Clearing the Wreck Repeatable 20 Kenwyn Kenwyn pays for every creature cleared out of the Saltgrace, so the salvage can go on.

docs.title: Goa Harbour
docs.text: Quest Kind Level From Summary Quiet Approaches Side 14 Ruan Ruan wants the approaches to the town kept quiet. Thin out the Ribbon Pigs and Ditch Eyes on the Gorse Downs. The Timber Carts Side 16 Haldor Haldor's timber carts use the Saltwood Road. Walking stumps and grave-grey mushrooms have taken to standing in it. The Carters' Road Side 16 Teague Teague brings his wool down the Western Merchant Road. Crabs walk the Seaward Woods and Lupins pelt the carts. Pelts from the Woods Side 17 Caddoc Caddoc needs proper skins for his traps' hinges, and the Seaward Woods and Dusk Ford have them. Dusk Ford Side 18 Esk Esk takes paid work on the merchant road. The carters' ford is crowded with Ligators and Jr. Neckis, and somebody has to clear it. The Gullwalk Side 18 Moira Moira would rather be out on the coast than on the stairs. She wants the Gullwalk clear of the kestrels and crabs that crowd its path. Lashings Side 20 Kestra Kestra checks the lashings of every bridge each morning. She will show you how she gets down the ropes so fast. The First True Map Story 20 Lachlan Lachlan wants to make the first true map of the sea caves under the cliffs. Gwenna has old maps, and she has always said no. Ronan at the Mouth Story 20 Lachlan Lachlan's rope is gone from the coves, and so is Ronan. The A Mark Story 22 Lachlan Deep in the Long Echo there is a tide mark scratched beside a letter. Lachlan wants to know who made it. Before the Still Pool Story 24 Lachlan Lachlan has something to tell you before the last chamber. The Inkmother Story 25 Lachlan Something vast breathes in the Still Pool. Lachlan's map ends there. Bethoc's Board Story 20 Torva Every morning Bethoc's sighting board says the same thing: the Strandwood. Torva wants the timber crews' edge cleared. The Night Trap Story 22 Caddoc Something has been springing Caddoc's biggest cage trap every night without being caught. He wants someone to sit up beside it with him. A Better Trigger Story 24 Caddoc Caddoc means to build a trigger the old fox cannot learn, from the Strandwood's own creatures. The Far Rocks Story 26 Brigid Brigid gathers sea-herbs on the far rocks at low tide, and the Strandwood's creatures come down to the water there now. She has found something. The Cub Story 28 Caddoc The new trap caught something: a cub. The old fox is still out there, and Torva and Kenna mean to go after it. Old Brushtail Story 28 Torva Old Brushtail's earth lies under the roots of a fallen pine at the end of the Strandwood. Torva will take you in. The Board: the Strandwood Repeatable 22 Bethoc Bethoc's sighting board always has the Strandwood on it. The Gap Inn pays for every forty. Lanterns to the Landings Story 30 Ruan Ruan wants lanterns on the high landings before dark, and the climbers on the Saltface thinned. The Unlit Stretches Story 33 Moira Moira has noticed the climbers keep to the stretches no lantern reaches. She knows where they gather. The Wake Story 40 Dougal Dougal has watched the lowest quay steps for thirty years. Something has been leaving tracks there. Below the Anvil Story 40 Gorm Gorm promised Iska a new stair to the far cove before the race. His crews will not work the lowest landings after dark. The Chewed Ropes Story 43 Kestra Something chews the ropes of the highest bridge from below. Kestra means to catch it, and she thinks Fionn knows more than he says. What Leads Them Story 46 Ruan Ruan has put the tracks, the scratches and the ropes together before the First Warden. Iska wants to know what leads the climbers. The Gapclaw Story 48 Torva The first climber, the one that scarred Torva's jaw, survived its fall. It leads the others from a hollow behind the Wrack Ledges. The Board: the Saltface Repeatable 34 Bethoc The climbers on the Saltface are on Bethoc's board most mornings now. The Greystrand Story 50 Brigid Brigid wants to show you the Greystrand beyond the Forest Jaw, and then she has something to tell Elspeth. Agna's Notch Story 54 Agna Agna cut a notch in the cove rocks as a girl, at the highest spring tide anyone remembered. Her knees will not take her out to it now. Marks Where the Boats Cannot Go Story 58 Ailsa Eilidh's slate, Agna's notch and the dead pines agree with Ailsa's pages. She wants tide marks driven where the wardens' boats cannot go. The Hour the Water Forgets Story 58 Cormac Cormac has only ever sung the first line of the gap verse. Morven had the ending, and Calder heard it. Timber for the Boat Story 58 Calder Calder will sing Morven's ending of the gap verse once he has keel timber from the Greystrand's drowned pines. The Verse and the Page Story 60 Cormac The verse is a Savage song. Ailsa's oldest page is Magician writing. With one, she might read the other. Where the Eddy Turned Story 62 Varro Varro will go out to the Forest Jaw at slack water and show you where the eddy turned, and where it turns now. Under the Jaw Story 65 Iska At the Wardens' table, the First Warden gives her charge: at the lowest spring tide, go under the Jaw. The Undertow Story 67 Iska Something great lies in the Scour under the Forest Jaw, and it holds the slack back and leans the run against the forest cliff. Not All of It Story 68 Ailsa The next day's slack comes on its hour. Ailsa has written something in the margin. The Board: the Forest Jaw Repeatable 54 Bethoc The fishing boats see things on the Forest Jaw. Bethoc's board says so. Fionn's Shortcuts Side 20 Fionn Fionn will show you the quickest ways round the Cliff Stairs: the high landing, then the foot of the stairs, then the head of the Long Stair. The Magpie's Box Side 20 Ronan Ronan wants the feathers of the birds that hang level with the Gullwalk, for his treasure box. Bring him 15 Kestrel Feathers.
