  • Bring me 15 Slime Bubbles from the Slimes of the The Hedge Lanes, outside the Tree Gate.
  • Good. Mind they do not burst in your pack.
  • Then I shall polish with what is left, and thin. The dais will not mind. I will.
  • You carry (how many you carry) of 15 Slime Bubbles. The The Hedge Lanes, past the Tree Gate.
  • Good. Good bubbles, these. Tomorrow at dawn the dais will shine the way it shone for the coronation.
  • My thanks, Player. Not many people care for a duty most of the city has forgotten.

docs.title: The Buried Street
docs.text:
Below the cisterns, fresh claw-cut tunnels break through old walls into a buried street of the first city. Ida wants it walked and the rat packs there cleared.

Town Selsior Category Story Given by Ida Level 28 After The Cistern Sluice Leads to Bats Under the Walks, Where Nip Won't Go, Digging Behind the Vault

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Reach The Buried Street
  • Defeat 30 Black Drain Rat in The Buried Street

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 7,000 EXP
  • 560 mesos
  • Orange Potion x10
  • +30 standing with Selsior
  • +120 standing with Ida
Dialogue
  • Tancred opened the sluice, and the water showed us something. Under the cisterns there's a street. A whole street, walled over, older than the quarters above it. Doorways. Lamp brackets.
  • And new tunnels through the old walls, cut by claws. Go down to the The Buried Street, follow them as far as you can, and clear 30 Black Drain Rats. They run in packs there.
  • My father's map stops at the cisterns. From here on you're drawing it.
  • Then we wait. I don't like waiting with that thing digging.
  • The Buried Street, and thirty black drain rats.
  • The tunnels all run one way. North and down, toward the palace end of the city. (She looks at her father's map for a long time.)
  • That's the first fortress-town under our feet, Player. And something is digging through it. I'll tell the Captain tonight.

docs.title: The Delver
docs.text:
Wulfric heard the digging behind the Royal Vault's deepest corridor, and the burrow is there. Defeat the Delver, the thing in the drains, then report to Captain Rhys.

Town Selsior Category Story Given by Ida Completed with Rhys Level 30 After Digging Behind the Vault

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Clear The Delver

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 11,440 EXP
  • 600 mesos
  • Orange Potion x10
  • Elixir x5
  • +40 standing with Selsior
  • +150 standing with Ida
Dialogue
  • It's found. Behind the vault's deepest corridor, a raw hollow in the earth, a wall's thickness from the Crown's own strongroom. The scratching I've heard for months. That's where it lives.
  • Captain Rhys wants it ended, and so do I. When you're ready, ask me and I'll take you down to the burrow. Defeat the Delver, then report to the Captain at the Knights' Court.
  • Ask me when you're ready. I'll be at the grating.
  • It's waited this long. One more night.
  • Defeat the Delver. Ask me to take you down to the burrow. Then report to Captain Rhys.
  • Ida says you came up out of the grating at dawn and she walked straight home to tell her husband the old quarters are safe. That is the best report I have had this year.
  • What drove the beast up, nobody can say yet. But it will scratch under no one's lane again. Well done, Player. The Guard thanks you, and so do I.

docs.title: The Pushed-Up Grating
docs.text:
The grating in Steps Lane was found pushed up from below. Ida takes her father's old map of the drains and asks you to go down: see the Old Drains for yourself and clear the rats.

Town Selsior Category Story Given by Ida Level 20 Leads to Rats in the Lower Stacks, The Extra Brace, The Wall Under the Stage, Bites for the Book, The Gnawed Ledgers, Hold the Lantern, Scratching in the Cellars, The Empty Box, Wings for a Bat, A Wing on the Sill

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Reach The Old Drains
  • Defeat 20 Drain Rat in The Old Drains

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 2,600 EXP
  • 400 mesos
  • Orange Potion x10
  • +30 standing with Selsior
  • +120 standing with Ida
Dialogue
  • Player. Come and look at this. The grating in Steps Lane. Iron, a hand thick, and it's sitting crooked in its frame. Pushed up. From below.
  • My father mended these drains. Here: his map, his chalk marks. Go down into the The Old Drains, walk the first channels, and clear 20 Drain Rats. Tell me what it sounds like down there.
  • Follow the chalk. It still shows where the old channels join. Tancred will hold the grating.
  • Then I'll go down alone tonight. Not ideal.
  • The Old Drains, then twenty rats. Follow the chalk marks.
  • Scratching, deep down, and the rats running past you, not at you? (She nods slowly.) Yes. That's what I hear every night.
  • The rats are leaving, Player. Something's below them. I'll report it to the Captain. Keep the map's lessons. We'll need them.

docs.title: The Council's Letters
docs.text:
Ilwen needs the Grove Council's letters carried down the Eastern Forest Road to Mayor Tobin of Kaldemor.

Town Fairy Forest Category Side Given by Ilwen Level 12 Leads to Letters for the Capital

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Talk to Tobin

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 428 EXP
  • 264 mesos
  • Town Return Scroll x2
  • +60 standing with Ilwen
  • +15 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • The Council's letters for Kaldemor, Player: sealed, sorted and addressed in order of importance. I would carry them myself.
  • Unfortunately, I cannot be in two places, and one of the places is here.
  • Carry the letters down the Eastern Forest Road to Tobin in Kaldemor, and bring back his answer.
  • Thank you. The Mayor's reply goes on page nineteen.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • Mayor Tobin, in Kaldemor. Down the Eastern Forest Road, through the Hem and on through the fields.
  • Mayor Tobin's reply. Page nineteen. Thank you, Player.
  • Here, two return scrolls, for the next time somebody needs to be in two places.
  • Letters from the Grove Council? Splendid! Calyra always writes such short letters. I admire that.
  • Tell Ilwen we'll keep the road clear on our side. And give my regards to the Eldest.

docs.title: Letters for the Capital
docs.text:
The Council's letters for the capital must reach the royal road's last waystone, where the Selsior couriers collect them.

Town Fairy Forest Category Side Given by Ilwen Level 15 After The Council's Letters

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Look at the courier's waystone in The Bloomwood, South

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 821 EXP
  • 330 mesos
  • Town Return Scroll x3
  • +60 standing with Ilwen
  • +15 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • More letters, Player. These ones for the capital. The Selsior couriers collect from the last waystone on the royal road.
  • Yes, I could send them with a carter. No, I would not sleep.
  • Leave the letters at the courier's waystone, at the far end of the Bloomwood's southern stretch (examine it).
  • Thank you. I shall add you to page twenty.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • The last waystone, at the far end of the Bloomwood, where the road opens onto the plain.
  • They've been collected. I had word by bird. Page twenty.
  • Three return scrolls. It is the least the Council can do. I checked.

docs.title: The Shelf List Before the Shelf List
docs.text:
In the oldest shelf list, beside the seal record, is a note in a hand nobody knows.

Town Fairy Forest Category Story Given by Ilwen Level 21 After The Gap in the Numbering Leads to Faelan's First Lantern

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Look at the oldest shelf list in The Old Records
  2. Talk to Wynne

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 3,202 EXP
  • 630 mesos
  • +60 standing with Ilwen
  • +25 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • Wynne asked for the oldest shelf list, and I don't ask why. But I will tell you where it is, which is not the same as asking.
  • It's in the Old Records, on the lowest shelf by the door. Read the line beside the seal record. Then tell Wynne what it says.
  • Read the oldest shelf list in the Old Records (examine the lowest shelf), then tell Wynne.
  • Gently with it. It is the only one.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • The lowest shelf by the Old Records' door.
  • 'Kept apart, in the old wing.' In a hand I don't know. I know every hand in the Old Records, Player.
  • The old wing. Behind the Grove School. It's been sealed longer than anyone remembers.
  • 'Certain leaves kept apart, in the old wing.' That's all it says?
  • That's the gap. It must be. The old wing of the Grove School. Nobody's been in it in... nobody's been in it.

docs.title: A Shimmering Night
docs.text:
Imre wants you on the highest terrace on a shimmering night, to see what Imre sees, and then out on the Weathered Rocks, where a dry storm is breaking.

Town Midbarium Category Story Given by Imre Level 53 After The Old Springs Leads to Dates and Dots, Star Verses

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Look at Imre's place on the high terrace in Midbarium
  2. Reach The Weathered Rocks

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 31,000 EXP
  • 1,060 mesos
  • Travel Ration x10
  • +40 standing with Midbarium
  • +30 standing with Imre
Dialogue
  • Oh, Player, good, you're awake! Everyone else is asleep or pretending. Tonight is one of the still, cold nights, and I need a second pair of eyes before I start to doubt my own.
  • Come up to the highest terrace, stand where I stand, and look low toward the island's heart. Then, if what I think will happen happens, go out to The Weathered Rocks and tell me what the sky is doing there.
  • Up the stair past the Great Hall, to the very top. Don't look at the bright ones. Look low, just above the far ridges.
  • Of course, of course. The stars will be there tomorrow. Mostly.
  • First the high terrace, looking low toward the island's heart. Then out to The Weathered Rocks, past the Dry Hills.
  • A dry storm, all night, over the Weathered Rocks? Lightning and wind and not one drop of rain? Then it happened again.
  • And you saw them waver, low down, like stars seen over a cooking fire? I have no table for that. Nothing in the Scholars' Quarter ever described it, and I have looked.
  • I've been writing the dates in my book, every shimmering night this year. The Trail Watch keeps dates too. I'll take the book up to the rim in the morning, before I lose my nerve.
  • Thank you for looking with me. It is much less lonely not to understand something together. Here, I forgot dinner again, and you probably did too.

docs.title: Star Verses
docs.text:
Imre is quietly gathering the Brenna names for the stars. Ask Ahvi, Thrun and Neffa what they call them, and do not say what it is for.

Town Midbarium Category Side Given by Imre Level 58 After A Shimmering Night

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Talk to Ahvi
  • Talk to Thrun
  • Talk to Neffa

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 24,000 EXP
  • 1,160 mesos
  • Travel Ration x10
  • +20 standing with Midbarium
  • +30 standing with Imre
Dialogue
  • Can you keep a secret? Of course you can, you've kept the one about the shimmering nights. This one is a happier secret. I'm making a song.
  • A star song, for a gathering, if they ever let me recite at one. Lowland names on one side, Brenna names on the other, and the sky in between. I have the lowland names. I need the Brenna ones, and I can't ask Ahvi without giving the whole thing away.
  • Ask for me? Ahvi, Thrun and little Neffa. Ask what they call the stars. Just say you're curious. You are curious, aren't you?
  • Remember everything, even the silly ones. Especially the silly ones.
  • Oh. Well. The song will wait; the stars are very patient.
  • Star names from Ahvi, Thrun and Neffa. And don't say what for!
  • Star names? You have been talking to Imre. No, do not tell me why. I can wait.
  • The bright one over the Great Hall in winter is the Fire-Keeper's Eye. The cluster low in the south is the Herd Gone Home. The red one that never sets is Old Stubborn, and the Kragvar insist it is named after them.
  • Star names! Ha, I only know the drummer's ones.
  • The three in a row are the Drumsticks, and the round one beside them is the Drum, and when they rise together in autumn it's time to feast. That's all a drummer needs. Who's asking? No, don't tell me, I can see it on your face.
  • Ahvi taught me the song names. But I have one of my own.
  • The little faint one under the Herd Gone Home is called Restart, because you have to look away and look again to find it. I named it. Whoever is asking may use it.
  • The Fire-Keeper's Eye. The Drumsticks. Restart! Oh, Restart is perfect.
  • Did any of them guess? They all guessed. Of course they did. Well, then it isn't a secret any more, it's a surprise everybody has agreed to keep.
  • Thank you, Player. When it's finished, you'll hear it first, before Ahvi, though Ahvi must never know that. Here, some of the rations Corwell leaves me. I forget to eat them.

docs.title: The Rootbound Wing
docs.text:
Go through the old wing to its heart and find whatever was kept apart there.

Town Fairy Forest Category Story Given by Corisande Level 24 After Corisande's Key Leads to Whom to Tell

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Clear The Unbound
  • Bring 5 Torn Leaf Fragment (taken)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 4,742 EXP
  • 720 mesos
  • Bound-Page Pendant x1
  • +150 standing with Corisande
  • +60 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • The door's open. Oh, it smells of old paper and wet leaves. Faelan's lantern will light the way.
  • Whatever's in there has been alone a long time. Be gentle with it. Unless it isn't gentle with you.
  • Go through the Rootbound Wing to the inner door, face what waits behind it, and bring back 5 Torn Leaf Fragments.
  • I'll be right here. With the key. In case.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • The old wing. Fragments, if there are any.
  • You came back! And with... pages? Scraps of pages?
  • Wynne will want these. Take them to her. And thank you, dear. For asking.

docs.title: Quiet Shelves
docs.text:
Since the old wing was opened, Isaura wants its loose pages gathered before they are lost for good.

Town Fairy Forest Category Side Given by Isaura Level 45 After Whom to Tell

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Bring 6 Unbound Page (taken)
  • Defeat 40 Book of the old wings (Snapping Book, Flying Book, Ink Imp)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 20,872 EXP
  • 990 mesos
  • Elixir x3
  • +150 standing with Isaura
  • +15 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • The old wing's pages are blank or ruined. I know. I want them anyway. A blank page from that wing is still a page from that wing.
  • Bring me what the books leave behind.
  • Bring 6 Unbound Pages from the Rootbound Wing, and quiet 40 of its books.
  • Carefully.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • (how many you carry) of 6.
  • Blank. All blank. Good. Blank is honest.
  • They'll rest in the dark with the rest of the Old Records now.

docs.title: A Sealed Letter
docs.text:
Isaura needs a sealed letter carried to the Eldest. It must not be opened on the way.

Town Fairy Forest Category Side Given by Isaura Completed with Calyra Level 27 After Past the Last Lantern

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Deliver 1 Isaura's Sealed Letter
  • Defeat 40 Creature of Shimmerwaters (Firefly Slime, Shimmer Slime, Water Sprite, Forest Sprite)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 4,612 EXP
  • 594 mesos
  • +120 standing with Isaura
  • +15 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • This goes to the Eldest. Sealed. It does not get opened, read, held to the light, or 'accidentally' dropped near Caelum.
  • And while you are out, clear the Shimmerwater paths. My scholars' couriers use them.
  • Carry Isaura's Sealed Letter to Calyra unopened, and clear 40 creatures from the Shimmerwater paths.
  • Unopened.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • The Eldest. Unopened.
  • The seal is whole. Good.
  • Thank you. You may find you are trusted with more, now.

docs.title: The Old Mark
docs.text:
The Sea Slaters have eaten the tar off the old leading mark in the Saltface. Clear 60 of them from the Wrack Ledges so a crew can tar it fresh.

Town Goa Harbour Category Side Given by Iska Level 45

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 60 Sea Slater in The Wrack Ledges

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 19,000 EXP
  • 1,800 mesos
  • Sea-Herb Salve x10
  • +30 standing with Goa Harbour
  • +150 standing with Iska
Dialogue
  • A pilot coming in on a grey day lines up two marks, Player: the cairn on the clifftop, and the old mark below it, painted on the rock at the head of the Wrack Ledges.
  • The mark was black tar with a white band. The Sea Slaters have eaten the tar off it. On a clear day you do not need it. On a grey day it is gone, and a grey day is when you need it.
  • Clear 60 Sea Slaters out of the Wrack Ledges, so a crew can get in and tar it fresh. I would go myself. Halvard has eleven ships on my list.
  • The Wrack Ledges are past the Saltface and the Undercliff, off the Gullwalk south of the town. Mind the tar on your boots.
  • Another day, then. The mark has stood since my mother's time. It can wait. The ships cannot.
  • Sixty Sea Slaters, on the Wrack Ledges. The mark is at the mouth.
  • Done? Good. I will have a crew down there with a tar bucket before the week is out.
  • I took a ship in on that line at sixteen, in a fog, with my mother shouting the marks from behind me. I would like to show Arlo it is still there. Take these. You will want them on the cliffs.

docs.title: The Undertow
docs.text:
Something great lies in the Scour under the Forest Jaw, and it holds the slack back and leans the run against the forest cliff.

Town Goa Harbour Category Story Given by Iska Level 67 After Under the Jaw Leads to Not All of It

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Clear The Undertow

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 125,000 EXP
  • 2,700 mesos
  • Elixir x5
  • +80 standing with Goa Harbour
  • +300 standing with Iska
Dialogue
  • It is longer than any ship that comes through the gap. Grey above, pale beneath, curved teeth: so the bull-seal hunters say, who have seen its back off the Skerries. The verse only calls it a sleeper.
  • When you are ready, ask me to take you to the Scour.
  • Defeat the Undertow in the Scour. Ask Iska to take you there.
  • Watch the ripples. It rises where the water moves first.
  • When you are ready. The tide will come round again.
  • Ask me to take you to the Scour when you are ready.
  • It is gone. Out to the deep, or dead, and either way gone.
  • Go to Ailsa tomorrow and ask her about the slack. I want to hear it from her page, not my hope.

docs.title: Under the Jaw
docs.text:
At the Wardens' table, the First Warden gives her charge: at the lowest spring tide, go under the Jaw.

Town Goa Harbour Category Story Given by Iska Level 65 After Where the Eddy Turned Leads to The Undertow

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Defeat 4 Elite Disturbance-touched bulls (Grey Bull) in The Skerries
  • Defeat 1 Epic Deeply touched golem (Wrackgolem) in The Skerries
  • Bring 5 Skerries Shell (taken)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 68,000 EXP
  • 2,600 mesos
  • +50 standing with Goa Harbour
  • +200 standing with Iska
  • Unlocks boss.undertow
Dialogue
  • The first wardens drove it out. We are wardens. We read the water, and the water says it is back in the Scour.
  • At the lowest spring tide the Scour uncovers under the Jaw. The touched creatures of the skerries stand between us and the way down. Clear them, and bring back what they guard, and I will take you under.
  • Defeat Disturbance-touched bulls and a deeply touched golem on The Skerries, and bring 5 Skerries Shell.
  • We go at the lowest tide. Not before.
  • The tide does not wait, Player. Neither will I, for long.
  • The skerries. The touched ones.
  • Five. Weed-wrapped shells, all from the same reef. The touched ones guard them like eggs, and I do not want to know why.
  • The way into the Scour is open. Tell me when you are ready to go under the Jaw.

docs.title: Salve Base
docs.text:
The salves that come in from outside are scarce, so Ivo is making his own. Cold seep toad spawn makes a cooling base for burn salve: bring Ivo 20 Seep Toad Spawn.

Town Urbanograd Category Side Given by Ivo Sable Level 21 Leads to The Caravan Wounds

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Bring 20 Seep Toad Spawn (taken)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 2,880 EXP
  • 1,870 mesos
  • +50 standing with Ivo Sable
  • +15 standing with Urbanograd
Dialogue
  • My burn salve jar is scraping bottom, and the carts that bring it are late again. Half the Row burns its fingers every week, and Tinder burns hers on purpose.
  • Henna used to make her own, with a cold jelly base from the seep toads up in the foothills. It holds the herbs and cools the skin. I've the herbs. I haven't the toads.
  • Could you bring me 20 Seep Toad Spawn? The Seep Toads are up in the Seepwater Foothills, on Stonefang Pass. Mind the bog-lurchers on the boardwalks.
  • Thank you. Keep it cool if you can. It doesn't mind the walk, but it does mind the sun.
  • Of course. I'll stretch what I have. I'm good at stretching. Bandages, salve, the truth about how bad it is.
  • (how many you carry) of 20 Seep Toad Spawn. Seep toads, the Seepwater Foothills.
  • (Ivo works the spawn into a pot with crushed herbs, humming the whole while, then dabs a little on the back of his own hand.) Ah. Cold as a stream. Henna would be proud. She'd say so in a very rude way.
  • That's a season of burns seen to. Thank you, Player. If you ever singe yourself, the first jar's yours.

docs.title: The Caravan Wounds
docs.text:
Travellers keep coming to Ivo's awning with tusk wounds from the Bristlewood road. Thin out 40 bristle boars along the road, then ask Patch at the Gate Walk what she uses for tusk wounds.

Town Urbanograd Category Side Given by Ivo Sable Level 36 After Salve Base

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Defeat 40 Bristle Boar
  2. Talk to Patch

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 22,200 EXP
  • 5,040 mesos
  • +70 standing with Ivo Sable
  • +20 standing with Urbanograd
Dialogue
  • Three carters this week, all with the same wound: a tear low on the leg, ragged, deep. Tusks. They all came in off the Walkers' Road where it skirts the Bristlewood. The boar have been coming right down out of the trees.
  • I can stitch a tusk wound. What I can't do is keep it clean afterwards; they fester. Patch at the Gate Walk sees more road wounds than I do. She'll have something.
  • Two things, then. Thin out 40 Bristle Boars near the road, so fewer carters come in torn. And ask Patch what she packs a tusk wound with. Tell her the tenor asks. She'll know.
  • The boar are thick at Bristlewood Edge, through the Outworks' far end. Patch is at her herb house, just inside the gate.
  • All right. I'll keep stitching. Hum something for the next one, would you?
  • 40 Bristle Boars by the road, and Patch's answer for tusk wounds.
  • Tusk wounds? Hold still while I tell you, I'm counting. (Patch scolds a jar into order.) Wash it with boiled willow water, pack it with crushed yarrow, change it morning and night, and don't let the patient talk you out of the night one.
  • Here: a pouch of yarrow, enough for a dozen. Tell Ivo the tenor still holds his needle too tight. And tell him to come by for supper, he's thin as a broom.
  • Willow water and yarrow, morning and night. Of course. And she sent yarrow. And she says I hold my needle too tight. She's said that for fifteen years.
  • Fewer boar on the road, and the right packing for the ones that get through. Thank you, Player. Tonight's first tune is for you. I'll hum it.

docs.title: Jinx Checks the Bucket
docs.text:
Before Tinder's show tonight, Jinx filled and checked Tinder's water bucket, three times, the way Tinder does. Now Jinx wants to know whether Tinder noticed, and cannot bear to ask.

Town Urbanograd Category Side Given by Jinx Level 24 After Something That Bounces

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Talk to Tinder

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 1,190 EXP
  • 1,440 mesos
  • +60 standing with Jinx
  • +20 standing with Tinder
  • +10 standing with Urbanograd
Dialogue
  • Okay. Okay okay okay. So. Tinder checks the water bucket three times before every show. Every show. Since forever. And tonight, before Tinder got there, I filled it. And checked it. Three times. Nobody told me to. I just did.
  • And now I don't know if that was a good thing or a nosy thing or a weird thing. And I can't ask Tinder, because I'll blurt something, I always blurt something, I'm terrible at not blurting.
  • Will you ask Tinder? Just casually. 'Hey, was the bucket all right tonight?' Don't say I sent you! ...Okay, you can say I sent you, I'll have told everyone by tomorrow anyway.
  • Tinder's in the middle of the square, away from the awnings. Casually! Be casual!
  • No, you're right, I'll just... not think about it. (Jinx is very visibly thinking about it.)
  • Did you ask Tinder yet? About the bucket? Casually? Middle of the square!
  • The bucket? (Tinder goes still for a moment, the swagger dropping right off.) Jinx filled it. I know. I got here early. I stood behind Ivo's awning and watched the whole thing. Filled, checked, checked again, checked a third time. Nobody asked Jinx to.
  • (Tinder looks at the bucket for a long breath, then picks up the torches and is all show again.) The bucket was full. Exactly as full as it should be. Tell Jinx that.
  • That's all. Tell Jinx the bucket was full, and that I watched. Nothing more. ...And do not let Jinx juggle anything lit before I say. I mean it.
  • Full? Exactly as full as it should be? And Tinder WATCHED? From behind Ivo's awning? The whole time? All three checks?
  • What does that mean? Does it mean something? It sounds like it means something. Tinder said 'nothing more', which is exactly what people say when there's more!
  • Okay. Okay. I'm going to fill it tomorrow too. And the day after. Every day. Not because of anything. Just because. Thank you, Player! Don't tell Tinder I'm this happy. Tell everyone else.

docs.title: Something That Bounces
docs.text:
Jinx wants juggling balls that bounce back, to delight the children of Lantern Square. Margo says dried seep toad spawn turns wonderfully rubbery: bring Jinx 15 Seep Toad Spawn.

Town Urbanograd Category Side Given by Jinx Level 20 Leads to Jinx Checks the Bucket

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Bring 15 Seep Toad Spawn (taken)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 2,160 EXP
  • 1,330 mesos
  • +50 standing with Jinx
  • +10 standing with Urbanograd
Dialogue
  • New act idea! I drop a ball, on purpose, the little ones gasp, and the ball comes BACK UP. Into my hand. Like magic. Except I don't have bouncy balls. I have apples. Apples do not come back up. Apples go splat.
  • I asked Margo, and Margo explained it three ways, and the third way was: seep toad spawn, dried slow on a warm stone, goes rubbery and bounces like anything. I don't know how Margo knows that. I didn't ask. I was scared of the answer.
  • Get me 15 Seep Toad Spawn, Player? The Seep Toads up in the Seepwater Foothills have loads. I'd go, but I'd juggle them, and then I'd be covered in toad.
  • Yes! Stonefang Pass, up past the Gate Meadows, the boggy bit. Bring a bag. Bring two bags. It's wobbly.
  • Aw. Okay. Back to apples. Splat.
  • (how many you carry) of 15 Seep Toad Spawn! Seep toads, Seepwater Foothills. Wobbly. Bring bags.
  • Ew. Ew! Perfect. (Three days later, on a warm stone by Ochre's wall, they have dried into green, glossy little balls. Jinx drops one. It bounces higher than Jinx's head.)
  • IT WORKS! Look at Figgy's face! I'm paying Figgy a copper every time one lands on her drawings, which is going to be ALL the time. Worth it. Thank you, Player!

docs.title: An Empty Slate
docs.text:
For one evening Joan wants every name off her slate. Thurstan is the last one out, at the Chalk Hives: clear the bees around him and tell him to come home for supper.

Town Selsior Category Side Given by Joan Level 27 After The Slate Behind the Bar

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Defeat 40 Chalk Hive Bee in The Chalk Hives
  2. Talk to Thurstan

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 4,800 EXP
  • 540 mesos
  • Orange Potion x10
  • +20 standing with Selsior
  • +150 standing with Joan
Dialogue
  • One name left on the slate, Player, and it's Thurstan's. He went to the The Chalk Hives without his partner, because of course he did.
  • Clear 40 Chalk Hive Bees round about him, and tell him supper's on and I'm counting. I want an empty slate tonight. Just once.
  • The Chalk Hives are past the Thyme Banks. Bring him home hungry. He always is.
  • Then I'll keep his bowl warm and the slate full.
  • Forty bees at the Chalk Hives, and a word to Thurstan.
  • (The cloth goes over the last name.) Empty. Look at that. I haven't seen it empty since spring.
  • Don't tell anyone I stood here staring at a blank slate. Here, take this, and come back to the Lantern whenever you like.
  • Joan sent you? Ha! I wasn't lost, I was hunting. There's a difference.
  • ...Supper's on, you say? Right. Coming. Tell her I'm coming.

docs.title: The Slate Behind the Bar
docs.text:
Joan wants the boar herds on the Thyme Banks thinned before her next lodgers go out, and asks you to tell Roland it is done: he worries as much as she does.

Town Selsior Category Side Given by Joan Level 24 After Three Days Too Long Leads to An Empty Slate

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Defeat 30 Downs Boar in The Thyme Banks
  2. Talk to Roland

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 2,410 EXP
  • 480 mesos
  • Orange Potion x10
  • +20 standing with Selsior
  • +100 standing with Joan
Dialogue
  • Three more lodgers want to try the downs this week. Boars, they say, easy money. I've heard that before.
  • Go ahead of them. Thin out 30 Downs Boars on The Thyme Banks. Then tell my father it's done. He won't say he worries, but he worries.
  • Good. Father's in his corner. Of course he is.
  • Then I'll double their suppers and hope.
  • Thirty boars on the Thyme Banks, then a word with Roland.
  • Father says you told him the whole thing twice, and he told it back to you bigger. That means he's pleased.
  • Here. You've earned a room's worth of thanks, and a little more.
  • Thinned the boars on the Thyme Banks, did you? Ha. In my day a boar there was a boar. One at a time, like a gentleman.
  • (He is quiet a moment.) Tell Joan I said thank you. No. Don't. She'll know.

docs.title: Three Days Too Long
docs.text:
A lodger's name has stayed on Joan's slate three days past his return. She asks you to walk out to Downs Edge, find his camp and clear the bees off the verge.

Town Selsior Category Side Given by Joan Level 21 Leads to The Slate Behind the Bar

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Reach the lodger's camp in Downs Edge
  • Defeat 25 Wild Bee in Downs Edge

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 1,600 EXP
  • 420 mesos
  • Orange Potion x10
  • +15 standing with Selsior
  • +80 standing with Joan
Dialogue
  • Player, a word. The lad in room six went out to Downs Edge after bees. He said three days. That was six days ago, and his name's still on my slate.
  • I can't leave the bar, and I won't send another lodger after one. Find his camp on the downs, and thin out 25 Wild Bees while you're there. Bring me word, any word.
  • Thank you. Out the Tree Gate, then east onto the downs. Mind the bees. They don't like company these days.
  • Fair enough. I'll leave the name up a while longer.
  • His camp, and twenty-five bees off Downs Edge. I'll be at the bar. I'm always at the bar.
  • Stung half to pieces and out of rations, but alive? Sitting by the dew pond feeling sorry for himself, you say?
  • (She picks up the cloth and rubs one name off the slate, slowly.) There. That's the best part of my day, Player. Supper's on the house.

docs.title: Jocelyn damp in the oldest room
Damp in the Oldest Room
docs.text:
The oldest records room is damp, and the vault sits over the cisterns of the first city. Clear the clogged channels of the Cisterns, then tell Wulfric.

Town Selsior Category Side Given by Jocelyn Level 25 After The Gnawed Ledgers

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Reach The Cisterns
  2. Defeat 30 Cistern Bubbling
  3. Talk to Wulfric

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 5,400 EXP
  • 500 mesos
  • Orange Potion x15
  • +20 standing with Selsior
  • +100 standing with Jocelyn
Dialogue
  • The oldest records room is damp. Damp! The back shelves, where the old boxes are.
  • The vault sits over the cisterns of the first city. If the water is rising, I need to know before the ink runs.
  • Go down to the The Cisterns and clear the Cistern Bubblings that clog the channels, 30 of them. Then tell Wulfric, so he can look at the room on his round.
  • Good. Quickly, please. Ink waits for nobody.
  • Then I shall move every box by hand. All of them. Tonight.
  • The The Cisterns, thirty Cistern Bubblings, then Wulfric.
  • Three times? He never told me it was two. Well. The shelves are drying, and I have relabelled the room 'dry'. Thank you, Player.
  • The cisterns are clear? Good. I will look at the oldest room tonight.
  • I walk past it twice a round already. For her box. ...Three times, then. Tell her three.

docs.title: The Gnawed Ledgers
docs.text:
Something has gnawed a ledger in the vault's lowest records room. Deal with the rats of the Old Drains and bring Jocelyn their tails to count.

Town Selsior Category Side Given by Jocelyn Level 22 After The Pushed-Up Grating Leads to Damp in the Oldest Room

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Defeat 30 Drain Rat in The Old Drains
  2. Bring 10 Drain Rat Tail (taken)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 3,200 EXP
  • 440 mesos
  • Orange Potion x15
  • +15 standing with Selsior
  • +80 standing with Jocelyn
Dialogue
  • Something has gnawed the corner of a ledger in the lowest records room. Gnawed. A ledger.
  • Wulfric says the rats in the old drains have stopped running from lanterns and are moving up. Up is us.
  • Go down through the grating in Steps Lane and deal with 30 Drain Rats in the The Old Drains. Bring me 10 Drain Rat Tails; I believe what I am told, but I prefer to count it myself.
  • Thank you. I have labelled a jar for the tails. Do not look at me like that.
  • Then the ledgers will be gnawed, and I shall write that down too.
  • Thirty Drain Rats, ten tails. The grating is in Steps Lane.
  • Ten. One, two... ten. It comes out the same twice.
  • Entered: 'drain rats, thirty, dealt with; tails, ten, received.' That is the most satisfying line I have written all week.

docs.title: A Collar for Ma
docs.text:
Jory's mother writes that the inland winters are cold, which means her back hurts. Bring Jory 20 Strand Fox Tails to trade with Greer for a fur collar.

Town Goa Harbour Category Side Given by Jory Level 28 After The Log Stack

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Bring 20 Strand Fox Tail (taken)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 4,700 EXP
  • 1,120 mesos
  • Gap Inn Stew x5
  • +30 standing with Goa Harbour
  • +200 standing with Jory
Dialogue
  • Ma's letter came! Listen. 'Dear Jory, the farm is very quiet, and the winters here are cold in a way the sea never was. My back is no worse. Do not row too hard.'
  • Cold in a way the sea never was. That's Ma saying her back hurts. Greer pays well for Strand Fox Tails and she'll make anything for a price. A fur collar, I thought. Before the winter.
  • Could you bring me 20 Strand Fox Tails from the Strandwood Rocks? I'll trade them to Greer and send Ma a collar, and I'll write that I'm not rowing too hard. Which is a lie, but a nice one.
  • The Strand Foxes are on the Strandwood Rocks, in packs. You'll hear them before you see them. Or you won't, and then they're behind you.
  • That's all right. I'll catch them myself. I'm fast. Well. I'm strong. That's nearly fast.
  • (how many you carry) of 20 Strand Fox Tails, from the Strandwood Rocks. For Ma's collar.
  • Twenty! Look at them, red and grey. Greer will swoon. Greer won't swoon. Greer will haggle.
  • Thanks, Player. I'm writing to her tonight. I'll tell her you helped. She'll ask if you row. Do you row? Never mind, I'll tell her you do.

docs.title: The Log Stack
docs.text:
A timber ship is waiting on a load of logs stacked at the Strandwood Edge, and Wrack Boars are rooting under the stack. Clear 50 of them so Jory can get the logs rafted round.

Town Goa Harbour Category Side Given by Jory Level 22 Leads to A Collar for Ma

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 50 Wrack Boar in Strandwood Edge

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 2,300 EXP
  • 880 mesos
  • Brodie's Smoked Fish x5
  • +20 standing with Goa Harbour
  • +150 standing with Jory
Dialogue
  • Player! Just the one! Do you want to hear about the race? Later. I'll tell you later. Twice.
  • There's a timber ship at the quay waiting on a load, and the load's in a stack at the Strandwood Edge where Haldor's crew cut it. Only the Wrack Boars have found it. They root under the logs, and nobody can get a rope round them.
  • Clear out 50 Wrack Boars on the Strandwood Edge? Then the logs get rafted round and onto the ship before she sails. I'll carry two at once. Watch me.
  • Off the Saltwood Road, down the Strandwood track. Mind the tusks. I'd come, but somebody has to carry everything.
  • No? Fine! I'll go and shout at them. It sometimes works.
  • Fifty Wrack Boars on the Strandwood Edge. The ship's waiting. So am I.
  • Done? Brilliant! The crew's rafting them round the point this afternoon, at slack.
  • Here, that's your share of the hauling fee. Now. The race. So: the gap at dawn, and Mhairi on the quay with her fiddle...

docs.title: Watch Bounty: The Holm Wood
docs.text:
The Harbour Watch pays a bounty for the Holm Wood's dusk wolves and lanternshades, again and again.

Town Bain Harbour Category Repeatable Given by Jowan Level 55

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 80 Holm Wood creatures (Dusk Wolf, Whipshade, Hookshade, Glimshade)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 20,646 EXP
  • 770 mesos
  • +20 standing with Bain Harbour

The first time you complete it instead: 30,969 EXP, 1,210 mesos, +30 standing with Jowan, +30 standing with Bain Harbour

Dialogue
  • The Watch's newest notice. The Holm Wood. I saw the drawer open. I saw the chart. I want to help.
  • 80 of the wood's creatures: dusk wolves, whipshades, hookshades, glimshades. The Watch pays every time.
  • For the report. And for the harbour.
  • Another time, then.
  • Eighty Holm Wood creatures, any kind.
  • Eighty. Report written. Captain Halloran signed it without a word. That's high praise.
  • Come back whenever you like.

docs.title: Watch Bounty: The Old Cut
docs.text:
The Harbour Watch pays a bounty for the creatures coming up the Old Cut, again and again.

Town Bain Harbour Category Repeatable Given by Jowan Level 22

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 60 Old Cut creatures (Bootcrab, Snapjaw, Glass Jelly, Ironback Crab)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 1,377 EXP
  • 308 mesos
  • +20 standing with Bain Harbour

The first time you complete it instead: 2,065 EXP, 484 mesos, +30 standing with Jowan, +30 standing with Bain Harbour

Dialogue
  • The Watch has a new notice up, for the Old Cut. I wrote it. It has a map. Not a very good map.
  • 60 of the Cut's creatures, any kind, anywhere on the Inner Cut. The Watch pays every time.
  • I'll put it in my report. Captain Halloran says my reports are 'thorough'. I think that's good.
  • Another time, then.
  • Sixty Old Cut creatures, any kind.
  • Sixty! Report written. Bounty paid.
  • Come back whenever the notice tempts you.

docs.title: Watch Bounty: The Outer Cut
docs.text:
The Harbour Watch pays a bounty for the sawbills of the Old Cut's sea half, again and again.

Town Bain Harbour Category Repeatable Given by Jowan Level 36

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 70 Sawbills (Sawbill Fry, Sawbill, Spitting Sawbill, Pale Sawbill)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 5,881 EXP
  • 504 mesos
  • +20 standing with Bain Harbour

The first time you complete it instead: 8,821 EXP, 792 mesos, +30 standing with Jowan, +30 standing with Bain Harbour

Dialogue
  • New notice! The Outer Cut. I've drawn the sawbills on it. Brisa says they look like boots with teeth.
  • 70 sawbills of any kind, anywhere on the Outer Cut. The Watch pays every time.
  • Report noted. Thoroughly.
  • Another time, then.
  • Seventy sawbills of any kind on the Outer Cut.
  • Seventy! That's going in the report. With a drawing.
  • Come back whenever the notice tempts you.

docs.title: Watch Bounty: The Roads
docs.text:
The Harbour Watch pays a bounty for the roads' monsters, again and again.

Town Bain Harbour Category Repeatable Given by Jowan Level 14

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 40 Road monsters (Scrub Wolf, Bluff Wildcat, Dune Cat, Grey Tom)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 366 EXP
  • 250 mesos
  • +20 standing with Bain Harbour

The first time you complete it instead: 549 EXP, 308 mesos, +30 standing with Jowan, +30 standing with Bain Harbour

Dialogue
  • The Watch keeps a bounty on the roads into Bain Harbour! Every carter and post rider is safer for it. I wrote the notice myself. Very thorough.
  • 40 of the roads' monsters: scrub wolves, wildcats, dune cats, grey toms, anywhere on the roads. Bring me the count and the Watch pays. Again, whenever you like.
  • I'll note it in my report. With your name spelled right.
  • Another time, then.
  • Forty road monsters, any kind, anywhere on the roads.
  • Forty! That's going in the report. Captain Halloran reads every one. I think.
  • Here's the bounty. Come back any time, the notice stays up.

docs.title: Counting Glimmerwings
docs.text:
Juniper wants to know whether the glimmerwings have spread since last year. Count them the hard way.

Town Fairy Forest Category Side Given by Juniper Level 15

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Defeat 30 Glimmerwing in The Bloomwood
  • Defeat 20 Crowned Glimmerwing in The Bloomwood, South
  • Bring 5 Crowned Glimmerwing Wing (taken)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 821 EXP
  • 330 mesos
  • +60 standing with Juniper
  • +15 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • Last year I counted the glimmerwings of the Bloomwood. This year I think there are more, and further south. I need to be sure.
  • Counting them means meeting them. Meeting them means they're usually trying to sting you. You see the problem.
  • Defeat 30 Glimmerwings in the Bloomwood and 20 Crowned Glimmerwings in its southern stretch, and bring me 5 Crowned Glimmerwing Wings to measure.
  • Excellent. Count carefully. Then count again.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • Counting still? I'll wait. I'm sketching.
  • More than last year. Further south. I thought so.
  • Into the notebook it goes. Page sixty-two. You're in the margin again.

docs.title: Something That Would Rather Not Be Drawn
docs.text:
Juniper wants to draw the sharpened Lupins in the Hollow Oak's boughs. They would very much rather she did not.

Town Fairy Forest Category Story Given by Juniper Level 35 After Ironbark Shafts Leads to The Lost Season

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Defeat 70 Sharpened Lupin in The Hollow Oak, Boughs
  • Look at Juniper's sketching spot in The Hollow Oak, Boughs

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 14,429 EXP
  • 1,050 mesos
  • +60 standing with Juniper
  • +25 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • The Lupins in the oak's boughs! I need them on paper. Size, colour, the way they throw. Last year's drawings show a Lupin half the size.
  • Problem: they throw things. Hard. I need someone to keep them busy while I sit very still and draw very fast.
  • Keep 70 Sharpened Lupins busy in the boughs, then meet me at my sketching spot on the middle bough (examine it) so I can finish.
  • Wonderful. I'll be the one in the tree trying not to be noticed.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • Keep them busy! I'm nearly done! I'm not nearly done.
  • Look at that. Look at the jaw on it. Half again as big as last year's.
  • You're in the margin again. Page ninety. With a star.

docs.title: The Lost Season
docs.text:
Juniper lost a notebook last autumn, climbing out of the ravine below the oak with something large below her. She thinks it ended up high in the oak.

Town Fairy Forest Category Story Given by Juniper Level 38 After Something That Would Rather Not Be Drawn Leads to The Back of the Seed Book

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Defeat 50 Gloomfur Lupin in The Hollow Oak, Heights
  • Reach the top of the Heights in The Hollow Oak, Heights

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 18,402 EXP
  • 1,140 mesos
  • +60 standing with Juniper
  • +25 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • I should tell you something. Last autumn I lost a notebook. A whole season of notes, from places I haven't been able to reach since.
  • I dropped it climbing out of the ravine below this oak, with something large below me. I think it took it. Up. Into the crown. Something up there collects things.
  • Climb to the top of the Heights, below the crown, and see what's up there. The Gloomfur Lupins guard the way; clear 50 of them.
  • Look, don't touch. Not yet.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • The top of the Heights. Under the crown.
  • A nest? In the crown? Of course. Of course it is.
  • Whatever tore the crown apart is living in it. And my notebook is in there with it.

docs.title: Clean Prints
docs.text:
Someone small follows the hunters to the last stump. Kenna wants the foxes thinned near the edge, and the prints in the mud there kept clear.

Town Goa Harbour Category Side Given by Kenna Level 28 After Something to Chalk

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Defeat 50 Strand Fox
  2. Look at the prints at the last stump in Goa Harbour

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 7,000 EXP
  • 1,120 mesos
  • Strand Fox Hood x1
  • +25 standing with Goa Harbour
  • +150 standing with Kenna
Dialogue
  • Someone follows us out to the last stump. Small boots. Thinks we can't hear him. Torva lets him come that far and no farther, and one of us always stands between him and the trees.
  • Lately the foxes come right up to the edge at dusk. I'll not have them at the last stump when he's there. Don't look at me like that. I'd say the same about anyone.
  • Bring down 50 Strand Foxes on Strandwood Rocks. Then go to the last stump and look at the mud. There should be prints there: fox, boar, a hunter's boot. Tell me if they're still clear.
  • And if he's there, you never saw me. You never heard any of this.
  • Forget I said anything. I didn't.
  • Fifty Strand Foxes on Strandwood Rocks, then the prints at the last stump. Clear, I said. Not smudged.
  • Clear? Good. I pressed them fresh this morning and named them out loud, in case anyone happened to be listening behind the stump.
  • He's good, you know. He reads a trail better than half the hunters, and he doesn't even know anyone's teaching him.
  • Here. Greer made this from a fox I brought in, and it fits you better than me. And Player, if you tell anyone I said he's good, I'll say you made it up.

docs.title: Something to Chalk
docs.text:
Kenna wants something on Bethoc's sighting board with her name beside it. Bring down 50 Wrack Boars and bring her 15 tusks to pick from.

Town Goa Harbour Category Side Given by Kenna Level 23 Leads to Clean Prints

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Defeat 50 Wrack Boar
  • Bring 15 Wrack Boar Tusk (taken)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 2,600 EXP
  • 920 mesos
  • Fish Cake x10
  • +15 standing with Goa Harbour
  • +150 standing with Kenna
Dialogue
  • Have you seen Bethoc's board? Boars. Stumps. Foxes. Nothing on it anyone would buy a round for. I'm going to put something on that board with my name beside it.
  • Torva has me on the dullest watch on the shore, so you'll do the hunting and I'll pick the trophy. The biggest tusk on the shore. Merrin will hear about it before supper.
  • Bring down 50 Wrack Boars on Strandwood Edge and bring me 15 Wrack Boar Tusks. One of them will be big enough. It has to be.
  • Don't let Torva see you bringing them to me. She'll say I'm meant to be watching. I am watching. I'm watching you.
  • Fine. Something bigger will come along. Bethoc says be careful what you wish for. I'm not.
  • (how many you carry) of 15 Wrack Boar Tusks, and fifty boars down. I'm counting, even if Merrin's the one with the tally.
  • Let me see. Small. Small. Chipped. Small...
  • This one. That's a tusk. Bethoc will chalk it up, and say 'a boar' in that voice of hers, and wipe it off at the end of the month.
  • It's not big enough. I know it's not. But it's on the board with my name beside it, and yours too if you like. Smaller.

docs.title: A New Hearth
docs.text:
The hearth lining of Selene's forge has cracked, and Kenric wants it relined before he forges his first sword. Quarry rubble from the Spoil Heaps holds the heat best.

Town Selsior Category Side Given by Kenric Level 51

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Bring 20 Quarry Rubble (taken)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 24,000 EXP
  • 1,020 mesos
  • White Potion x20
  • +25 standing with Selsior
  • +100 standing with Kenric
Dialogue
  • Oh! Sorry, Player, mind the doorframe. Look at this hearth. Cracked right across. Selene says a cracked hearth makes a lazy fire, and a lazy fire makes a soft blade.
  • If I'm going to forge my first sword this winter, it can't be in a lazy fire. The stone from the The Spoil Heaps holds the heat best, she says. Only now the stone gets up and walks about.
  • Bring me 20 Quarry Rubble from the Rubble Golems on the The Spoil Heaps, above the quarry landing.
  • Thank you! I'll have the old lining out by the time you're back. Hm hm hmm...
  • That's all right. I'll patch it. Patches always hold. Mostly.
  • (how many you carry) of 20 Quarry Rubble. The The Spoil Heaps, past the quarry landing.
  • Look at that stone. Grey right through. That'll hold a fire all night.
  • Selene says it's a proper hearth now. She said it twice, so she means it. Thank you, Player.

docs.title: Kenric ore for a first sword
Ore for a First Sword
docs.text:
Selene has judged Kenric ready. His first sword wants iron from the old seam in the Deep Cut, where the quarries' oldest workings are. Gather it.

Town Selsior Category Story Given by Kenric Level 62 After Powdered Golem Stone Leads to The Waves, The First Sword

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Gather 10 Iron Ore

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 75,000 EXP
  • 1,240 mesos
  • White Potion x20
  • Scroll for Gloves for ATT 60% x1
  • +40 standing with Selsior
  • +150 standing with Kenric
Dialogue
  • Player! She said yes. Selene said I'm ready. This winter, start to finish, my own sword.
  • Only it has to be the right iron. There's an old seam in the The Deep Cut, the first workings, and the iron there is the best the quarries ever gave. Nobody cuts it now. The golems...
  • Gather 10 Iron Ore from the iron veins in the The Deep Cut or the The Terraced Cuts. The old seam's ore, if you can.
  • I'll draw it again while you're gone. I've drawn it on every scrap of paper in the loft.
  • No, I understand. It's dangerous up there. I'll wait. I'm good at waiting. I've been waiting three years.
  • Ten iron ore, from the veins in the The Deep Cut or the The Terraced Cuts.
  • Ten. Ten! Look at the grain in that. This is the iron the first keep's nails were made of, I bet.
  • I'm going to start tonight. Selene says I'm not, I'm going to sleep first. ... Thank you, Player. I mean it.

docs.title: The First Sword
docs.text:
Kenric's first sword is finished, balanced for a short arm. He wants it tried against something hard before Selene puts her mark beside his: an Elite golem of the Deep Cut. Then tell Wat.

Town Selsior Category Side Given by Kenric Level 66 After Ore for a First Sword

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Defeat 1 Elite Elite golem of the Deep Cut in The Deep Cut
  2. Talk to Wat

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 50,000 EXP
  • 1,320 mesos
  • Elixir x10
  • +40 standing with Selsior
  • +150 standing with Kenric
Dialogue
  • It's done, Player. My first sword. Balanced short, for a short arm. ... It's for Wat. When he's older. Don't tell him.
  • But before Selene puts her mark beside mine, it has to be tried. Not on a post. On something that hits back.
  • Take it up to the The Deep Cut and try it on an Elite golem. Then go and tell Wat his brother made a sword. Not who it's for. Just that it held.
  • Bring it back in one piece. Please. Hm hm... sorry. Nervous.
  • That's all right. It'll keep. Swords keep.
  • One Elite golem in the The Deep Cut, then Wat.
  • It held. Not a nick. Selene looked at it for a long time and then she put her mark beside mine. Beside mine, Player!
  • And Wat said what? "Took you long enough"? ... That's how he says it. Here. You earned this more than I did.
  • Kenric made a sword? A real one? And it held on a golem? ... Took him long enough. Tell him... tell him I said that. He'll know what it means.

docs.title: Clearing the Wreck
docs.text:
Kenwyn pays for every creature cleared out of the Saltgrace, so the salvage can go on.

Town Bain Harbour Category Repeatable Given by Kenwyn Level 20

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 60 creature of the Saltgraces (Cave Bat, Hull Louse, Barnacle Crab, Bilge Eel, Wreck Mimic)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 1,041 EXP
  • 280 mesos
  • +20 standing with Bain Harbour

The first time you complete it instead: 1,561 EXP, 440 mesos, +30 standing with Kenwyn, +30 standing with Bain Harbour

Dialogue
  • She fills up again, every tide. Bats at the mouth, lice in the timbers, crabs in the holds, eels in the hatches.
  • Clear 60 of them, any kind, anywhere in her, and I'll pay. Every time.
  • Every tide. I'm not joking.
  • Another time, then.
  • Sixty creatures of the Saltgrace, any kind.
  • Sixty. She'll be quiet for a tide or two.
  • Come back whenever she fills up again.

docs.title: Every Plank of Her
docs.text:
Kenwyn draws you a map of the Saltgrace and sends you down the salvagers' steps to see her mark with your own eyes.

Town Bain Harbour Category Story Given by Kenwyn Level 20 After The Stamp Leads to The Purser's Strongbox, The Last Verse

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Defeat 20 Cave Bat in The Main Deck
  2. Look at the mark on the mainmast's foot in The Main Deck

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 2,775 EXP
  • 600 mesos
  • +60 standing with Kenwyn
  • +25 standing with Bain Harbour
Dialogue
  • So Hobart's crates are hers. I'm not surprised. She carried half the harbour's trade once.
  • Here. I've drawn her for you. Every plank: the Main Deck, the Rigging, the Holds, the Galley, the Lower Deck, and the Captain's Cabin at the stern. Down the steps, through the cave mouth, and you're standing on her deck.
  • The bats have taken the cave mouth. Clear 20 Cave Bats off the Main Deck, then look at the foot of the mainmast. You'll see the mark. Then come and tell me I'm not an old fool.
  • The steps are slick. And whatever moves down there, it moves at your pace, not mine.
  • Another time, then.
  • Clear twenty cave bats off the Saltgrace's Main Deck, then look at the mark on the mainmast's foot.
  • The ship in the ring of rope. Burned in as deep as the day they cut it. You saw it.
  • Then I'm not an old fool. Or not about that. Now: there's something else down there Hobart will want.

docs.title: The Holdfast
docs.text:
Kenwyn finally tells you what he saw in the Saltgrace's lowest hold this spring, and why the whole ship creaks.

Town Bain Harbour Category Story Given by Kenwyn Level 24 After The Purser's Strongbox Leads to Seasoned Timber

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Clear The Holdfast

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 4,742 EXP
  • 720 mesos
  • Purser's Chain x1
  • +100 standing with Kenwyn
  • +25 standing with Bain Harbour
Dialogue
  • I told folk I came out with all my fingers because I'm not daft. That's true. It's not all of it.
  • This spring I went down to the Lower Deck for a length of her oak, and the bulkhead into the Captain's Cabin was stove in. Pushed out. Beyond it, the cabin floor's fallen into the flooded hold. And in the water, an eel. A conger, thicker than the mainmast, and its body runs through three decks.
  • It's got hold of her. It's never let go. That's what the creaking is. Go through the broken bulkhead at the Lower Deck's far end, or ask me for the salvagers' short way, and finish it. Watch the openings round the cabin. It strikes out of all of them.
  • Watch the hatches. When the water bulges, move.
  • Another time, then.
  • Defeat the Holdfast in the Saltgrace's Captain's Cabin (through the broken bulkhead on the Lower Deck, or ask Kenwyn for the short way).
  • It's let go. I heard it from here: the whole ship settled, like a sigh. Twenty years I've listened to her creak.
  • I'll be going down again for her oak and her iron, slow and careful, the way it ought to be done. Alwyn will want to hear. Thank you, Player. Here, from the purser's cabin. It's been waiting long enough.

docs.title: The Purser's Strongbox
docs.text:
A trading ship's purser kept her papers in an iron strongbox. Kenwyn knows where the Saltgrace's is, and what the mimics have made of the Holds around it.

Town Bain Harbour Category Story Given by Kenwyn Completed with Hobart Level 22 After Every Plank of Her Leads to The Holdfast

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Defeat 15 Wreck Mimic in The Holds
  2. Look at the purser's strongbox in The Holds

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 3,672 EXP
  • 660 mesos
  • +80 standing with Kenwyn
  • +25 standing with Bain Harbour
Dialogue
  • A trader's purser writes down every crate that goes aboard and every crate that comes off. The Saltgrace's purser kept his papers in an iron strongbox, bolted down in the Holds.
  • I opened it once, years back. There's an oilskin packet in it I never unwrapped. Not mine to read. But if anything says where Hobart's crates came from, it's that.
  • Mind the sea chests in the Holds. Some of them aren't chests. Clear 15 Wreck Mimics, find the purser's strongbox, and take the packet to Hobart.
  • If a chest looks at you, it's not a chest.
  • Another time, then.
  • Clear fifteen wreck mimics in the Saltgrace's Holds, find the purser's strongbox, and take its oilskin packet to Hobart at the Docks.
  • An oilskin packet. Dry inside, after all these years. Give it here. On the right.
  • A bill of lading. 'Four crates, iron-bound, landed at Bain from the Saltgrace, to be held at the harbour.' The week before she sailed her last. And here, my oldest ledger, first page, so faded you'd think it was blank: four crates, held. Same hand. Same week.
  • There's a line after it. Who they're held for. The sea's had it; I can't read a word. So they stay where they are, and they stay shut. Chalk says four. Chalk was right all along.

docs.title: The Second Stick
docs.text:
Kesh keeps two notched sticks: one for eagles, one for things he cannot name. Ask Korrin about the two notches on the second.

Town Midbarium Category Story Given by Kesh Completed with Korrin Level 30 After The First Report Leads to The Boys' Lookout

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 3,400 EXP
  • 600 mesos
  • Goat Cheese x5
  • +40 standing with Midbarium
  • +30 standing with Kesh
Dialogue
  • Player! You walked the whole of the ridges, everybody says so. Want to see my sticks? This one is for eagles. Forty-one notches. That is a lot of eagles.
  • This one is the other stick. It is for things I cannot name. It has two notches, and both of them are from the same place, after dark.
  • I am not allowed to say where. Korrin said we swore. But if you asked Korrin, and he told you, then I did not say it, did I? He is on the terraces, by his mother's cisterns.
  • Ask him about the second stick. Not about the eagles, he will talk about the eagles all day.
  • Fine. It is only a stick. A stick with two notches nobody can name.
  • Korrin is on the terraces. Ask him about the second stick, Player, not the first.
  • Kesh sent you? With the stick? Oh, he never can keep anything in. Fine. But swear first. Kragvar swear on stone, so put your hand on the wall.
  • We have a lookout. Above the terraces, a ledge with a wall we built ourselves. Nobody is supposed to know. Twice from up there we saw something moving on the far canyon bridge after dark. Not a person. Low, and quick, and more than one.
  • We did not tell anyone, because then they would ask where we saw it from. Will you come up and look? You know the bridge better than we do now.

docs.title: Kesh where did you come from
Where Did You Come From?
docs.text:
Kesh asks everyone where they came from and what the road was like. Walk down to the Canyon Road so you can tell him properly.

Town Midbarium Category Side Given by Kesh Level 20

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Reach The Canyon Road

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 1,050 EXP
  • 400 mesos
  • Goat Cheese x5
  • White Potion x10
  • +20 standing with Midbarium
  • +30 standing with Kesh
Dialogue
  • Hello! Where did you come from? Which road? What was on it? Did you see anything with horns? I have a kid called Lady Snort. She is a goat. Not a person.
  • Ennek tells me about the The Canyon Road but he always says it is just a road. It is never just a road. I am not allowed down there. I am allowed to the pen and the market and back.
  • Will you go down to the The Canyon Road and look properly? Then come back and tell me. With details. Lots of details.
  • I will be here! Or at the pen. Or running something to Harra. Or to Corwell. Somewhere here!
  • That is all right. You can tell me about a different road instead. Do you know any?
  • The The Canyon Road! Down the The South Path and out. Then come and tell me!
  • You went? What was it like? Red walls? A bridge that bounces? Dust boggles? Were they big? Did one bite you?
  • I am going to tell Korrin all of it. He will pretend he knew already. He did not.
  • Here, my mother's cheese. Do not tell her I gave you two of the good ones. Three. Five. Do not tell her.

docs.title: Lashings
docs.text:
Kestra checks the lashings of every bridge each morning. She will show you how she gets down the ropes so fast.

Town Goa Harbour Category Side Given by Kestra Level 20

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Reach the foot of the stairs in Goa Harbour

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 870 EXP
  • 800 mesos
  • Skill: Rope Slide
  • +15 standing with Goa Harbour
  • +150 standing with Kestra
Dialogue
  • Lashings work loose. Every morning I walk every bridge and check every knot, and I do not walk down afterwards. I slide.
  • Hands loose, feet off, let the rope do the work, catch yourself at the end. Do not look down. Never look down. Go on, try it.
  • Slide down from the Cliff Stairs to the foot of the stairs on Goa Harbour.
  • Go. Do not look down.
  • Suit yourself. The stairs are very long.
  • Down to the foot of the stairs. Slide.
  • There, you see? Now you will never take a stair again. Gorm will hate it.

docs.title: The Chewed Ropes
docs.text:
Something chews the ropes of the highest bridge from below. Kestra means to catch it, and she thinks Fionn knows more than he says.

Town Goa Harbour Category Story Given by Kestra Level 43 After Below the Anvil Leads to What Leads Them

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Talk to Fionn
  2. Talk to Tarran
  3. Look at the highest bridge in Goa Harbour
  4. Defeat 60 Sea Slater in The Wrack Ledges

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 25,000 EXP
  • 1,700 mesos
  • Cliff-Runner Boots x1
  • +40 standing with Goa Harbour
  • +200 standing with Kestra
Dialogue
  • Strand by strand, from below, on the seaward side, and only the highest bridge. I have never once seen it.
  • Fionn was up there one night. I know he was. Get him to tell you. And Tarran promised me a lantern for under the bridge. Get that too. Then sit out with me.
  • Get Fionn to tell what he saw, fetch Tarran's new lantern, sit out with Kestra on the highest bridge after dark (press Up there), then clear 60 Sea Slater in The Wrack Ledges.
  • Do not tell Gorm I sit out there. He forbids it.
  • Fine. I will keep splicing.
  • Fionn, Tarran's lantern, the bridge, then the Wrack Ledges.
  • The lantern showed them. Pale, flat, a hundred legs, all over the cliff under the bridge. Chewing tar off my ropes like it was honey.
  • It did not drive them off. It only showed them. And it cracked by morning, of course. Tarran swears the next one will not.
  • Take these boots. They grip a wet bridge. I would know.
  • You will not tell Hamish? Or Gorm? ...I was on the highest bridge. After sunset. Once.
  • Something was on the cliff under it. Pale and low and flat. Fast. Really fast. I ran. Do not tell anyone I ran.
  • Here it is! Brightest one yet. It lit the whole workshop white for a moment, then it settled.
  • It will not crack. Probably. Tell Kestra it is for under the bridge, like I promised.

docs.title: The Swarming Shore
docs.text:
Creatures are spilling up out of Shimmerwater onto the High Shore. Clear it with Kestrel.

Town Fairy Forest Category Story Given by Kestrel Level 30 After The Blightstone Leads to Kestrel's Report, Shore and Oak Patrol, The Touched of the Oak, A Spring Basket, A Song Nobody Asks For, The Truer Letter, A Quarrel Before It Reaches the Council, True or Not?

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 60 Evil Eye in The High Shore

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 9,152 EXP
  • 900 mesos
  • +60 standing with Kestrel
  • +25 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • You've been out past the Lakehead? Then you've seen the shore above it. Swarming. Evil Eyes, dozens of them, crawling out of the wet ground at the foot of the old oak.
  • And they're wrong, Player. Too big. Too bold. Juniper says 'sharpened'. I say 'insulting'.
  • Clear the High Shore with me: 60 Evil Eyes on its lower banks.
  • I'll take the east bank. Don't leave me any. That's a joke. Leave me some.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • Still swarming. Keep going.
  • That's the lower shore clear. For now.
  • Ow. No, I'm fine. That one bit. It's nothing.

docs.title: Harvest Carts
docs.text:
Kestrel's parents' harvest carts need the Forest's Hem clear. Clear it with her.

Town Fairy Forest Category Side Given by Kestrel Level 9 Leads to Road Patrol

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 40 Monster on the Hems (Slime, Bubbling) in The Forest's Hem

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 185 EXP
  • 198 mesos
  • +60 standing with Kestrel
  • +15 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • My parents' carts come up through the Hem every harvest. Apples, pears, a lot of very good cider.
  • Last week a slime got in a crate. You have never seen a pear look so offended.
  • Clear 40 monsters off the Forest's Hem with me. I'll take the north side.
  • Good. Don't leave any for me. That's a joke. Leave some for me.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • Still slimy out there. Keep going.
  • That's the Hem clear. The carts go through tomorrow.
  • You're all right on a road, Player. I'll say that to anyone who asks.

docs.title: Road Patrol
docs.text:
The roads never stay clear for long. Kestrel pays for every patrol.

Town Fairy Forest Category Repeatable Given by Kestrel Level 10 After Harvest Carts

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 50 Road monsters (Slime, Bubbling, Glimmerwing, Crowned Glimmerwing)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 137 EXP
  • 300 mesos
  • +15 standing with Kestrel
  • +20 standing with Fairy Forest

The first time you complete it instead: 274 EXP, 450 mesos, +15 standing with Kestrel, +30 standing with Fairy Forest

Dialogue
  • The roads never stay clear. Never. I clear them, and by the next morning something else has moved in.
  • So: a standing offer. Clear fifty off any of our roads and I'll pay you for it. Every time.
  • Defeat 50 monsters on the Hem, the Glimmer Path or the Bloomwood.
  • Off you go. Come back when it's done. Then do it again.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • Fifty. I count.
  • That's a patrol. Here's your pay. Same again tomorrow? There's no tomorrow on a road. Same again now.

docs.title: Shore and Oak Patrol
docs.text:
The shore and the oak never stay clear. Kestrel pays for every patrol.

Town Fairy Forest Category Repeatable Given by Kestrel Level 32 After The Swarming Shore

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 80 Creature of the shore or the oaks (Evil Eye, Curse Eye, Cold Eye, Sharpened Lupin, Gloomfur Lupin, Surgeon Eye)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 4,152 EXP
  • 960 mesos
  • +15 standing with Kestrel
  • +20 standing with Fairy Forest

The first time you complete it instead: 8,305 EXP, 1,440 mesos, +15 standing with Kestrel, +30 standing with Fairy Forest

Dialogue
  • Same deal as the roads. Clear eighty off the High Shore or the Hollow Oak and I'll pay you. Every time.
  • They'll come back. They always come back.
  • Defeat 80 creatures on the High Shore or the Hollow Oak.
  • Off you go.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • Eighty.
  • That's a patrol. Here's your pay.

docs.title: Kestrel's Report
docs.text:
Kestrel is hurt and too stubborn to come in. Carry her report to Seren.

Town Fairy Forest Category Story Given by Kestrel Completed with Seren Level 31 After The Swarming Shore Leads to Ironbark Shafts

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Deliver 1 Kestrel's Report

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 10,082 EXP
  • 930 mesos
  • +40 standing with Seren
  • +25 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • Don't look at my arm. It's a scratch. I'm staying out here.
  • But Seren needs to know what's on that shore, and if I go in she'll make me sit down. Take her my report. Tell her I'm fine.
  • Take Kestrel's Report to Seren at the Forest Edge.
  • And tell her I'm fine. Say it like you mean it.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • Seren. The Forest Edge. And I'm fine.
  • She's 'fine'. Of course she is.
  • This report... the hides on these things are thicker than any I've seen. My guards' spears won't hold.

docs.title: Back into the Dark
docs.text:
Ketta is ready to see the cave again. Go down into the Dustfall Cave with her, as far as the Cold Draught.

Town Midbarium Category Story Given by Ketta Level 22 After Let Ketta Lead Leads to A Venom Gland, Drakes of the Dustfall

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Reach The Cold Draught

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 2,300 EXP
  • 440 mesos
  • Travel Ration x5
  • +40 standing with Midbarium
  • +30 standing with Ketta
Dialogue
  • I dreamed about the lake again last night, and this time I didn't run. I woke up angry instead. I think that means I'm ready, or as near as I'm going to get.
  • The watch calls it the Dustfall Cave now; that's what my storm was, dust falling like rain. Come down with me: through the Mouth, down the Cliff Gallery, as far as the Cold Draught, where the wind starts coming up from below. Just that far, this time.
  • Tell me when you're ready and we'll take the rope-way down. Once we're in, stay where I can see you. The wind lies about where things are.
  • Fine. Fine! I'll go back to being angry in my sleep.
  • The Cold Draught, past the Mouth and the Cliff Gallery. Talk to me when you're ready to go down.
  • We did it. I stood in that wind, and nothing in me ran. My hands are shaking, look, but nothing ran.
  • The nests are further down, in the Chill Caves, and the lake past those. Next time. I want Lessa to know what she'll be patching first: drakes bite.
  • Thank you for walking behind me and not in front. Here, the watch's rations. They're terrible, but they're warm.

docs.title: Drakes of the Dustfall
docs.text:
The drakes of the Dustfall Cave keep breeding. Ketta pays for every 60 brought down, any time.

Town Midbarium Category Repeatable Given by Ketta Level 22 After Back into the Dark

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 60 Drake of the Dustfall Caves (Drakeling, Cave Drake, Frost Drake)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 6,500 EXP
  • 400 mesos
  • +20 standing with Midbarium

The first time you complete it instead: 6,500 EXP, 800 mesos, Orange Potion x10, +15 standing with Midbarium, +30 standing with Ketta

Dialogue
  • The nests in the Dustfall Cave don't empty just because we've been down there. Every week there are more young ones in the galleries.
  • Keep them down for me: 60 drakes in the cave, any kind, and I'll pay every time. It's the watch's bounty, but I asked to be the one who hands it out.
  • Talk to me when you want to go down. I'll hold the rope.
  • Then I'll go down myself. Not alone, Tavi says. Fine. Not alone.
  • Sixty drakes in the Dustfall Cave, any kind. Then come back to the rim.
  • Sixty! The galleries will be quiet for a few nights.
  • Your bounty. They'll be back; drakes always are. So will we.

docs.title: Earn Her Trust
docs.text:
Ketta goes quiet whenever the cave comes up. Bring her 20 Boggle Dust and a Goat Cheese, and maybe she will talk.

Town Midbarium Category Story Given by Ketta Level 20 After The Canyon Stretch Leads to Let Ketta Lead

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Bring 20 Boggle Dust (taken)
  • Deliver 1 Goat Cheese

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 2,200 EXP
  • 400 mesos
  • Goat's Milk x5
  • +40 standing with Midbarium
  • +30 standing with Ketta
Dialogue
  • Skarra sent you, didn't she? She's got that look, like a tracker who's found a footprint and is pretending she hasn't.
  • Tell you what. I'm restringing my old bow, and Boggle Dust is the best grip-dust there is. And I haven't had a decent piece of Goat Cheese since I got home, because Harra charges me double for having left.
  • Bring me 20 Boggle Dust off the Dust Boggles on the Canyon Road and a Goat Cheese from Harra, and I'll tell you a story. Maybe even the one you want.
  • Canyon Road for the dust, Harra's stall for the cheese. Tell her it's for me and watch her face.
  • Suit yourself. I'll tell you about my scar instead. A ram did it. Or a door.
  • (how many you carry) of 20 Boggle Dust, and a Goat Cheese.
  • Cheese. Real cheese. All right, Player. You went to the rope-way, you saw the cave mouth. Sit down. I'll tell it once.
  • Last spring, two days from home, a dust storm caught me in the canyons, and I went into that cave to wait it out. I went deeper than I should have, because it was cold and I was curious. There were nests along the walls, full of young drakes. And there was a lake, in the dark.
  • Something was drinking from it. A drake bigger than anything I met in three years on the road. It lifted its head and looked at me, and I ran, and I haven't stopped running since.
  • Promise me you won't go in there without me. I don't know when I'll be ready. But it's mine to face, and I'd rather not hear about it from Skarra's map.

docs.title: Hollowmaw
docs.text:
At the bottom of the Dustfall Cave, the great drake Ketta saw rules a lake in the dark. Go down with her and clear the cave, Hollowmaw and all.

Town Midbarium Category Story Given by Ketta Level 25 After A Venom Gland Leads to The Cave Is Held

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Clear Hollowmaw

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 5,000 EXP
  • 500 mesos
  • Orange Potion x20
  • +60 standing with Midbarium
  • +30 standing with Ketta
  • Unlocks boss.hollowmaw
Dialogue
  • Lessa says their bite is cold. Good. I know what cold feels like. I've had it in my chest since last spring.
  • The watch has started calling the big one Hollowmaw, because that's what the lake sounds like when the wind comes up out of it. Giving it a name helps. It makes it a thing that can be killed.
  • All the way down this time: the Mouth, the Gallery, the Draught, the Chill Caves, and the Sunken Pool. You fight it; I'll be at your back with every arrow Zirra ever made me. Clear the cave, Player.
  • Talk to me when you're ready. It breathes cold and it dives. When the roof shakes, watch the shadows.
  • Not today, then. It's waited a year. So have I.
  • All the way down the Dustfall Cave, to Hollowmaw in the Sunken Pool. Talk to me and we go.
  • It's dead. It's really dead. I watched it go under the water and not come up.
  • I'm not shaking. Well, I am, but it's a different kind. I think I've been holding my breath since I came home.
  • Thank you, Player. Take these. And let's go and tell Tavi, before I start crying in front of Skarra.

docs.title: The Cave Is Held
docs.text:
Hollowmaw is dead. Go with Ketta to tell Tavi that the Dustfall Cave is held.

Town Midbarium Category Story Given by Ketta Completed with Tavi Level 25 After Hollowmaw

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 2,000 EXP
  • 500 mesos
  • Highland Salve x5
  • +40 standing with Midbarium
  • +30 standing with Ketta
Dialogue
  • I've been on the rim all morning looking down at the cave mouth, and it's just a cave mouth now. A cold one, with drakes still in it, but a cave.
  • Come with me to Tavi. I want to ask for that stretch back: the canyon trail past the cave, the one I've been trading away.
  • Tavi will pretend not to be pleased. Watch the corner of the mouth.
  • Later, then. The stretch isn't going anywhere. Neither am I, for once.
  • Tavi is on the Uskari Rim. Ketta's coming with you.
  • Ketta, I heard. The whole rim heard. Bekk has told it four times, and it gets bigger every time.
  • The stretch is yours if you want it, and the watch will walk it with you. From today the canyon trail past the Dustfall Cave is on Skarra's board like any other, and the drakes in it are ours to keep down.
  • And the cave stays open to anyone the watch trusts to go down. Player, that's you. Ketta will want company.
  • Take this, from the Uskari. You walked behind Ketta when she needed it, and in front when she needed that instead. Not many know the difference.

docs.title: Back and Bigger
docs.text:
The crabs Keziah and Tristram cleared below the headland in her first week are back, bigger, and coming up the Old Cut. Thin them and follow their cast shells.

Town Bain Harbour Category Story Given by Keziah Level 22 After A Crab With No Name Leads to Stings in the Casebook

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Defeat 40 Bootcrab
  2. Defeat 15 Ironback Crab
  3. Reach The Pinch

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 3,672 EXP
  • 660 mesos
  • +60 standing with Keziah
  • +25 standing with Bain Harbour
Dialogue
  • Bree showed me her shells. Tristram and I cleared crabs like that off the rocks below the headland in my first week here. Smaller then. Much smaller.
  • They're back. And they've found the Old Cut. Since the sea gates broke, the tide runs right up it to the locks, and they've come with it.
  • Thin out 40 Bootcrabs and 15 Ironback Crabs, and follow the trail of cast shells up the Cut. I want to know where they lead. Tristram thinks the Pinch.
  • Three exits from every lock. Remember where they are.
  • Another time, then.
  • Forty bootcrabs, fifteen ironback crabs, and follow the cast shells to the Pinch.
  • The Pinch. The deepest lock on the Cut. And cast shells all the way up to it, bigger every lock.
  • Something's moulting in there. Something big. Clemence will want to hear about the jellies too, while you're here. She's been asking.

docs.title: A Claw Over the Bar
docs.text:
Keziah wants the Bootbreaker's claw hung over the bar at the Salt and Bread, and she has asked Delphine already.

Town Bain Harbour Category Side Given by Keziah Level 29 After The Bootbreaker

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Deliver 1 Bootbreaker's Claw

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 5,693 EXP
  • 638 mesos
  • +40 standing with Keziah
