  • Tell her I did not write it. Tell her... tell her she is the finest Magician this Row will ever see. No. Tell her I did not write it.

docs.title: Rosemary for the Magician
docs.text:
Rosamund wants a crown of real rosemary from the downs for the play's Magician. For remembrance. And because silk flowers look like silk flowers.

Town Selsior Category Side Given by Rosamund Level 22 Leads to A Note from Percival

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Gather 10 Rosemary Flower

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 1,840 EXP
  • 440 mesos
  • Orange Potion x10
  • +15 standing with Selsior
  • +80 standing with Rosamund
Dialogue
  • The Magician I mean to play does not wear jewels, darling. She wears something that grows. Rosemary, for remembrance.
  • Silk flowers look like silk flowers from the third row. I will not be looked at like silk flowers.
  • Gather 10 Rosemary Flowers from the downs. Fresh ones. I want the smell to reach the gallery.
  • You are a darling. Mind the bees, they may want it too.
  • No? Then I'll wear silk. And suffer, beautifully.
  • Ten sprigs of rosemary, darling. Fresh.
  • Smell that. That is a war ending. That is remembrance.
  • Edith will make it a crown, and I will make it a legend. Thank you, darling.

docs.title: Rosa's Recipe
docs.text:
Rosa the baker needs 10 Mushroom Spores and 5 Blue Snail Shells for her famous mushroom bread.

Town Kaldemor Category Side Given by Rosa Level 3 Leads to A Loaf for Bram, A Pot for Rosa, Rosa's Standing Order

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Bring 10 Mushroom Spore (taken)
  • Bring 5 Blue Snail Shell (taken)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 250 EXP
  • Orange Potion x10
  • +200 standing with Rosa
  • +20 standing with Kaldemor
Dialogue
  • Oh, Player, you look like someone who is not afraid of mushrooms! My famous mushroom bread needs spores and a pinch of ground blue shell, and my usual supplier has gone to visit his sister.
  • Bring me 10 Mushroom Spores from the Shrooms in the woods, and 5 Blue Snail Shells from the blue snails in the meadow. I will pay you in Orange Potions.
  • Wonderful! The Shrooms live in the woods, west of the town square past the hills; the blue snails are in the meadow to the east.
  • No harm done, dear. The oven will keep.
  • You carry (how many you carry) of 10 Mushroom Spores and (how many you carry) of 5 Blue Snail Shells so far. Take your time.
  • Spores and shells, and not a one broken! You are a treasure.
  • Here are your Orange Potions, ten of them. Come by any time, Player, the bread is always warm.

docs.title: Rosa's Standing Order
docs.text:
Rosa's mushroom bread sells out every morning. She buys 10 Mushroom Spores whenever you bring them, and likes you better each time.

Town Kaldemor Category Repeatable Given by Rosa Level 5 After Rosa's Recipe

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Bring 10 Mushroom Spore (taken)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 100 EXP
  • 150 mesos
  • +20 standing with Rosa
  • +5 standing with Kaldemor
Dialogue
  • Player, the mushroom bread is gone by breakfast every day now! Could you keep me in spores? 10 Mushroom Spores from the Shrooms on Kaldemor Field, as often as you like, and I will pay for every batch.
  • You are a dear. The Shrooms keep to the field's top floor.
  • Of course, of course. The offer stands whenever you have a moment.
  • Ten spores, Player, and the morning bread is saved.
  • Ten, and every one of them plump! Tomorrow's bread is saved.
  • Here you are. And come by again: I always have another order.

docs.title: Placed, Not Swung
docs.text:
Rowena wants to see whether you place a blade or swing it. Defeat 40 reed ligators on the Reed Beds, where a swung sword sticks in the mud.

Town Selsior Category Side Given by Rowena Level 31 Leads to The Narrow Moment

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 40 Reed Ligator in The Reed Beds

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 6,800 EXP
  • 620 mesos
  • White Potion x10
  • +20 standing with Selsior
  • +80 standing with Rowena
Dialogue
  • You have been watching my class. You hold your sword as if it were heavy. It is not. Your idea of it is.
  • The The Reed Beds, upriver. The ground is mud; a swung sword sticks, a placed one does not. Defeat 40 Reed Ligators and come back with a clean blade.
  • Two fingers higher on the grip.
  • When you are ready. Not before.
  • Forty ligators on the Reed Beds. A clean blade.
  • Clean. Good.
  • That was one word of praise. Do not spend it all at once.

docs.title: The Narrow Moment
docs.text:
Rowena wants claws from the Long Reach's lorangs: a lorang's claw opens like a lock, and she means to show her pupils how narrow the right moment is. Bring 10, then tell Captain Rhys his class has a new lesson.

Town Selsior Category Side Given by Rowena Level 35 After Placed, Not Swung

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Bring 10 Bank Lorang Claw (taken)
  2. Talk to Rhys

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 10,000 EXP
  • 700 mesos
  • White Potion x15
  • Scroll for Gloves for ATT 60% x1
  • +20 standing with Selsior
  • +120 standing with Rowena
Dialogue
  • My father was a locksmith. He showed me that a lock opens at one point, and only that one. A lorang's claw is the same: there is a joint, and a moment.
  • Bring me 10 Bank Lorang Claws from the The Long Reach Banks. Then tell Rhys that the advanced class has a new lesson. He will want to know before Bertrand does.
  • Watch the joint, not the claw.
  • Another season, then.
  • Ten lorang claws, then the Captain.
  • Ten. My pupils will open them before they open a guard. The ones who see the moment will see it in a fight.
  • You saw it yourself, or you would not have brought them whole. Remember that.
  • A lesson with lorang claws. That is Rowena all over. A sword is only as good as the arm behind it, and she'll tell you the arm is only as good as the eye. She's right. Don't tell her I said so.

docs.title: Lanterns to the Landings
docs.text:
Ruan wants lanterns on the high landings before dark, and the climbers on the Saltface thinned.

Town Goa Harbour Category Story Given by Ruan Level 30 After Old Brushtail Leads to The Unlit Stretches, The Board: the Saltface

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Look at the high landing in Goa Harbour
  2. Look at the highest bridge in Goa Harbour
  3. Look at the head of the Long Stair in Goa Harbour
  4. Defeat 50 Climber on the Saltfaces in The Saltface

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 6,850 EXP
  • 1,200 mesos
  • +30 standing with Goa Harbour
  • +150 standing with Ruan
Dialogue
  • Three winters ago the first one came up the cliff face itself. Now they come more nights than not.
  • Gunna's lanterns are ordinary ones, she says, but they burn in any wind. Hang them on the high landings before dark. Then go down the Saltface and thin the climbers.
  • Hang a lantern at the high landing, the highest bridge and the head of the Long Stair (press Up at each), then clear 50 climbers on The Saltface. The way down leaves the Gullwalk, south-west of the quay.
  • Here are the lanterns. Hang them where I said.
  • Then the landings stay dark tonight.
  • Three lanterns, then the Saltface.
  • The landings are lit and the cliff is quieter. Moira has been saying something about the dark stretches. Listen to her, she is right more often than she lets on.

docs.title: Quiet Approaches
docs.text:
Ruan wants the approaches to the town kept quiet. Thin out the Ribbon Pigs and Ditch Eyes on the Gorse Downs.

Town Goa Harbour Category Side Given by Ruan Level 14

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Defeat 30 Ribbon Pig
  • Defeat 30 Ditch Eye

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 610 EXP
  • 560 mesos
  • Salted Fish x5
  • +15 standing with Goa Harbour
  • +100 standing with Ruan
Dialogue
  • The watch keeps the cliffs, Player. The downs are too far for us, and the carts and the drovers come over them all summer.
  • Pigs in the road, and those eyed things in every ditch. Nothing a carter cannot handle alone. Two of them together, though.
  • Clear 30 Ribbon Pig and 30 Ditch Eye on Gorse Downs, east along the royal road.
  • Good. Take the Saltwood Road out over the heath and keep going.
  • Then the drovers will manage. They always have.
  • The downs are past the Saltwood Road. You cannot miss the gorse.
  • The carters came in early today, and singing. That is how I know. Thank you.

docs.title: What Leads Them
docs.text:
Ruan has put the tracks, the scratches and the ropes together before the First Warden. Iska wants to know what leads the climbers.

Town Goa Harbour Category Story Given by Ruan Level 46 After The Chewed Ropes Leads to The Gapclaw

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Deliver 1 Dougal's Measure
  2. Talk to Iska
  3. Defeat 3 Elite Disturbance-touched climbers (Sea Newt) in The Wrack Ledges
  4. Bring 3 Climber's Sign (taken)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 24,500 EXP
  • 1,850 mesos
  • +40 standing with Goa Harbour
  • +150 standing with Ruan
  • Unlocks boss.gapclaw
Dialogue
  • Dougal's measure. Gorm's stone. Kestra's chewed rope. I have held them all for a season and never put them side by side.
  • Come with me to the Wardens' House. I am going to put them in front of Iska, and you are going to tell her what you saw.
  • Give Ruan Dougal's measure, go with him to Iska at the Wardens' House, then hunt the Disturbance-touched climbers on The Wrack Ledges and bring back what they carry.
  • Say it plainly. She does not like it dressed up.
  • Then I will go alone. I have put it off long enough.
  • Iska first. Then the Wrack Ledges.
  • Three of them, each with one of these in its jaws. Scraped stones, all from the same place. A hollow behind the Wrack Ledges, Torva thinks.
  • Whatever leads them lives there. Torva is going. So are you.
  • A measure. A stone. A rope. Ruan, you have had these all season.
  • No. You were right to wait until you had all three. One is a story at the Gap Inn. Three is a pattern.
  • Find what leads them, Player. Start with the touched ones on the Wrack Ledges: the others follow them.

docs.title: Lines for Pounce
docs.text:
Rue rehearses Juna's lines to Pounce the cat, who yawns at the best one. See whether Pounce is listening at all, then ask Dex what Rue is doing wrong.

Town Urbanograd Category Side Given by Rue Level 21 Leads to Mother's Cake

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Talk to Pounce
  2. Talk to Dex

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 1,600 EXP
  • 2,520 mesos
  • +40 standing with Rue
  • +10 standing with Urbanograd
Dialogue
  • Oh. You saw me. I was... rehearsing. To the cat. (Rue goes red to the ears.) He is the only one who does not stare.
  • But I do not think he is listening. I give him my best speech, the one where Juna tells the guild to haul away the cart and the city with it, and he yawns. Right at the best line.
  • Could you see whether Pounce is listening at all? And then ask Dex what I am doing wrong. Dex knows timing. I only know the words.
  • Pounce is usually in Perch's loft, or in Old Parsnip's catmint. Dex is at the theatre, being loud.
  • No, it is fine. It is silly. It is a cat.
  • See whether Pounce is listening, Player, and then ask Dex about timing.
  • You recite Rue's best line to Pounce. Pounce opens one eye. The tail lifts, flicks once at the tip, and settles again.
  • Then Pounce yawns, enormously, showing every tooth, and turns his back on you with great dignity. A purr starts up anyway, somewhere deep in the grey fur.
  • The cat yawns at the best line? Ha! Then the cat knows timing. (Dex booms with laughter, then stops.) No, listen. She rushes it. She is so afraid of the line that she says it fast to get it over with.
  • Tell her: say the line, then wait. Wait until it hurts. Wait until a cat yawns. The yawn is the laugh, Player. It means the audience was holding its breath.
  • Wait until a cat yawns. (Rue says the line, very quietly, and waits. Then waits some more.)
  • Oh. Oh, it is completely different. The quiet does half the work. Thank you, Player. And thank Pounce. No, do not thank Pounce. He will be unbearable.

docs.title: Mother's Cake
docs.text:
Rue's mother sends a cake from the farm every Walkout Day. This year's came on the cider cart and vanished from the theatre yard gate, and Hambone has been humming very loudly ever since.

Town Urbanograd Category Side Given by Rue Level 29 After Lines for Pounce

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Talk to Hambone

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 2,070 EXP
  • 1,740 mesos
  • +50 standing with Rue
  • +15 standing with Urbanograd
Dialogue
  • My mother sends a cake every Walkout Day. Honey and barley, wrapped in a cloth with geese on it. It came on the cider cart this week. The carter says he left it at the theatre yard gate.
  • It was not at the gate. It was not anywhere. And Hambone has been humming very loudly all morning and not looking at anybody.
  • Would you ask Hambone about it? If I ask, I will go quiet and he will go red, and we will both stand there until the lanterns come on.
  • Do not be cross with him. Whatever he did, he did it for a reason. Probably the reason is Sprout.
  • It is only a cake. It is only my mother's cake. It is fine.
  • Ask Hambone about the cake in the geese cloth, Player.
  • Cake? What cake? I have not seen any cake. There is no cake in the cart's prop box under the grandee's spare cloak. (Hambone hears what he just said, and sighs.)
  • I put it there so Sprout would not find it. He finds everything. Here, take it to her, and tell her nobody touched it, which is true, except for the corner, which was already like that. Mostly.
  • The geese cloth! And it is... mostly whole. (Rue laughs, properly, the way she laughs on stage and nowhere else.)
  • Tell Hambone thank you, and tell him he is the worst liar in the city. He will like that. Here, take a slice. My mother always sends too much, so that I have to share.

docs.title: Saffi a tune for the outer wall
A Tune for the Outer Wall
docs.text:
Saffi wants her tenth street tune to be the Outer Wall, but has never heard what the Outworks sound like at dusk. Go out to the Outer Ditch and listen for her.

Town Urbanograd Category Side Given by Saffi Level 27 Leads to The Thin Whistler

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Reach The Outworks: Outer Ditch

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 1,680 EXP
  • 1,620 mesos
  • +50 standing with Saffi
  • +15 standing with Urbanograd
Dialogue
  • Number ten. I want it to be the Outer Wall. Everyone in here plays the inside of the city. Nobody plays the outside of the wall. But I've never stood out there at dusk. I don't know what it sounds like.
  • And Brindle won't let a fiddler stroll out into the Outworks alone, which is fair, I'd play the whole time and something would eat me mid-chorus.
  • You go. Go out to The Outworks: Outer Ditch, under the wall, at dusk. Listen. Wind, water, wings, whatever. Then come back and tell me fast, before it fades.
  • Out the gate, the side path off the Gate Meadows. Listen with your whole head. Then run.
  • Fine! I'll write number ten about the Great Hall instead. It sounds like Bastian. It'll be very loud.
  • The Outworks: Outer Ditch. Stand under the wall at dusk and listen. Then come tell me. Quickly!
  • Wind in the brambles? Water dripping in the old tower cellars, slow, slow, slow, and then wings, all at once, fast? And the city's noise coming over the top of the wall, faint, like it's somewhere else?
  • (Saffi is already playing: a slow drip of plucked notes, then a sudden flurry of wings up the high strings, and behind it, very quietly, a scrap of the Night Market tune, as if heard through stone.)
  • THAT's it! That's the Outer Wall! It starts slow, can you believe it? Me! Slow! Only for the first bit. Thank you, Player. Number ten!

docs.title: The Thin Whistler
docs.text:
A thin person with a tin whistle haunts the edge of Lantern Square whenever Saffi plays, and never plays a note. Saffi wants to know why. The whistler is Piper, the troupe's songwriter.

Town Urbanograd Category Side Given by Saffi Level 33 After A Tune for the Outer Wall Leads to Play with Saffi

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Talk to Piper

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 3,030 EXP
  • 1,980 mesos
  • +70 standing with Saffi
  • +15 standing with Urbanograd
Dialogue
  • There's someone. Thin. Scarf. Tin whistle. Every time I play, there at the edge of the crowd, holding the whistle like it might bite. Never plays it. Not once. It's driving me mad.
  • I tried to go over last week and the whistler vanished round the theatre yard before I'd got my bow down. Ivo says it's Piper, from the Old Barracks troupe. The one who writes all the songs for the play.
  • Find Piper at the Old Barracks Yard and ask what that whistle's for. Nicely. I'd ask, but I'd ask fast and loud, and apparently that makes people run.
  • The Old Barracks Yard. Look for someone humming and pretending not to be. Go!
  • Fine. I'll keep playing and pretend I don't see the whistle. I see the whistle. I always see the whistle.
  • Piper, at the Old Barracks Yard. The whistle. What's it for?
  • Saffi sent you? Saffi knows I exist? Oh no. (Piper pulls out a bundle of papers tied in a ribbon.) The whistle's for these. A second part for each of her nine tunes. Written them all. I just... never asked. She plays so fast and so well.
  • Here. Listen. (Piper plays, very softly, a thin bright line that winds round the Night Market tune like a vine on a post.) That's the Night Market part. I've never played it out loud before.
  • Tonight, when Saffi plays the Night Market, I'll play this from the edge. Under it. Quietly. If she stops, I'll stop. Tell her that? No. Don't. Just let her hear.
  • You found out? Tell me! No, wait. Don't. Something happened last night. I played the Night Market, and halfway through, underneath it, a whistle. A second part. Thin and bright, all round my tune like it had always been there.
  • I didn't stop. I didn't dare stop. I played it three times through and the whistle kept up every time. Fast enough. Actually fast enough.
  • Nine second parts? Written and never played? (Saffi laughs, a little too loud.) Well. Somebody had better learn to ask. And it had better be quick. Thank you, Player.

docs.title: Said Out Loud
docs.text:
Bring the Cap King down at the top of the Crown Tower, then go and see Meg: Hale has something he wants her to hear.

Town Kaldemor Category Story Given by Hale Completed with Meg Level 70 After What Drove It Out

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Clear The Cap King

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 150,000 EXP
  • 12,000 mesos
  • +80 standing with Kaldemor
  • +100 standing with Meg
  • +100 standing with Hale
Dialogue
  • Bring the Cap King down, Player, and the ground will stop shaking. The snails will go back to being snails, and Wilbur's fields will be his own again. That is how it should be.
  • And when it is done, there is something I mean to tell Meg. Something I should have told her two years ago. I will find her at her parents' old rows; she clears them on her own, before anyone is up.
  • When the Cap King is down and I have said it, go and see her, would you? She will not stop talking for a week. Someone ought to listen.
  • The Crown Tower first. Then Meg, in the Park, I expect, telling the windmills.
  • Another time, then. She will still be talking.
  • The Cap King first, Player, at the top of the Crown Tower. Then go and see Meg in the Park.
  • Player! You will never guess. No, you will, you were there for all of it, but you will never guess this. Hale came out to the old holding this morning. He watched me clear a whole row. Then he said it.
  • He said: you are good, Meg. Just that. Once, out loud, with nobody else there. Then he nodded and went back to the gate as if he had said it was going to rain.
  • I did not say anything back. I could not. I just kept clearing the row. I am going to put turnips in it next spring, and I am going to write to my parents tonight and tell them both things.
  • One thousand, eight hundred and twelve, by the way. It went up again. And you are in my book, Player, right at the front. Not in a column. On the first page.

docs.title: Bad News
docs.text:
Scrap found a cracked lantern pane in a gutter under the outer towers and named it Bad News. Lux keeps the lanterns and ought to see it.

Town Urbanograd Category Side Given by Scrap Completed with Lux Level 22 Leads to Sneaking on Shade

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Deliver 1 Bad News

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 920 EXP
  • 1,320 mesos
  • +40 standing with Scrap
  • +10 standing with Urbanograd
Dialogue
  • Psst. Psst! Up here. No, here. You did not hear me sneak up, did you? Good. I am practising.
  • I keep a tin of lost things. This is Sir Wobble, he is a button. This is Lefty. And this one is Bad News. I found it in the gutter under the outer towers. It is a lantern pane, all cracked, and it smells like outside.
  • Lux keeps the lanterns. I think Lux should see Bad News, because lanterns should not be lying in gutters. But I am not allowed down to the gate on my own. Will you take Bad News to Lux in Lantern Square?
  • Be careful with him. He has sharp edges. That is why he is called Bad News.
  • Fine. Bad News can stay in the tin with Lefty. Lefty does not mind.
  • Bad News goes to Lux in Lantern Square, Player. Do not cut yourself. He bites.
  • Where did you get this? Under the outer towers... in a gutter. Scrap's tin, was it? Of course it was.
  • Outward side of the wall. The frame bent, the glass thrown clear. Just like the others. Something is breaking my lanterns where it thinks nobody will look.
  • Tell Scrap thank you. Tell Scrap it was well named. And tell Scrap to stay off the outer gutters, please, though I know how much good that will do.

docs.title: Sneaking on Shade
docs.text:
Scrap has sneaked up on everybody in the city except Shade. Keep Shade talking at the gate while Scrap creeps up from behind.

Town Urbanograd Category Side Given by Scrap Level 30 After Bad News

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Talk to Shade

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 2,290 EXP
  • 1,800 mesos
  • +50 standing with Scrap
  • +15 standing with Urbanograd
Dialogue
  • I have sneaked up on everybody. Kite. Old Parsnip. Perch, twice. Even Vane, and Vane never sleeps. Everybody except Shade. Shade always turns round just before.
  • You go and talk to Shade at the gate. Keep Shade busy. Ask about knives or roads or something boring. And I will come from behind, quiet as Pounce, and say BOO. Deal?
  • Talk slow. Talk long. Talk about the weather. Grown-ups love the weather.
  • You are scared of Shade too. It is fine. Everybody is, a little.
  • Go and keep Shade busy on the Gate Walk, Player. I will be right behind. You will not see me. That is the point.
  • The weather? You came all the way down to the gate to talk about the weather. (Shade does not turn round.) Good afternoon, Scrap.
  • Third chimney from the left, behind the water barrel. Better than last time: I heard the slate only once. Tell her to keep her weight on the balls of her feet, and the slates will not talk.
  • Shade said good afternoon. Without even looking! How? HOW?
  • ...The balls of my feet. Right. Right! Next time I get Shade, and you will be there, and it will be the best day of my whole life. Thanks, Player. That is free. Thanks are always free.

docs.title: A Story from Far Away
docs.text:
Sefa wants a story from a far town for the great collection: Kaldemor's, from the mayor himself.

Town Fairy Forest Category Side Given by Sefa Level 15 Leads to True or Not?

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Talk to Tobin
  • Defeat 30 Road monsters (Slime, Bubbling, Glimmerwing, Crowned Glimmerwing)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 821 EXP
  • 330 mesos
  • +120 standing with Sefa
  • +15 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • My collection needs a story from Kaldemor. A real one, from someone who's lived there all their life.
  • The mayor! Mayors always have a story. Go and ask him. The road's long; mind it.
  • Ask Tobin in Kaldemor for a story, clearing 30 monsters on the roads on the way.
  • Remember the exact words!
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • Kaldemor's mayor. A story.
  • The clock tower that stopped, and started again when someone cared enough to mend it? Oh, that's a good one.
  • Into the collection it goes. Under 'K'. Or under 'Mending'. I'll decide later.
  • A story for the Fairy Forest's collection? How flattering!
  • Well. Our clock tower stopped once, and nobody noticed for a week, and then everyone noticed at once. It started again because someone cared enough to mend it. That's Kaldemor's story. Tell Sefa that one.

docs.title: True or Not?
docs.text:
Sefa has a story about the Hollow Oak's crown. Sefa will not say whether it is true. Go and see.

Town Fairy Forest Category Side Given by Sefa Level 35 After A Story from Far Away, The Swarming Shore

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Reach the top of the Heights in The Hollow Oak, Heights
  • Defeat 60 Creature of the Heightss (Gloomfur Lupin, Surgeon Eye)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 9,920 EXP
  • 770 mesos
  • +150 standing with Sefa
  • +15 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • My newest story: at the top of the Hollow Oak there's a bough that's been broken since before the Balrog War, and it never rots.
  • Is it true? Go and see. I won't tell you. I never tell.
  • Climb to the top of the Heights and see, clearing 60 creatures there.
  • No peeking at the ending.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • The top of the Heights.
  • You saw the broken bough? Was it rotten?
  • Hmm. You'll never know if I knew. That's the best kind of story.

docs.title: A Safe Pasture
docs.text:
Sennu has kept the herds close to town all summer, and the near ground is eaten to the root. Scout the high pasture on the Long Ridge and clear 50 monsters there.

Town Midbarium Category Story Given by Sennu Level 22 After Red Dots Leads to A Word for Tavi

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Look at the high pasture in The Long Ridge
  2. Defeat 50 Long Ridge monsters in The Long Ridge

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 6,850 EXP
  • 440 mesos
  • Goat Cheese x10
  • Goat's Milk x10
  • +40 standing with Midbarium
  • +30 standing with Sennu
Dialogue
  • Look at the ground past the camps, Player. Brown to the root. I have kept the herds this close all summer because of what walks in the low valleys, and now they are eating the hills bare.
  • There is a pasture up on the The Long Ridge, on the very top, where my mother grazed her goats and her mother before her. Good grass, a wind that keeps the flies off. Nobody has taken a herd up there since the stumps came.
  • Go up and look at it for me. Look over the high pasture at the top of The Long Ridge and tell me if the grass is still there. Then clear 50 monsters on The Long Ridge, so the way up is a way up.
  • Count what you see twice. That is how herders count. The The Long Ridge is past Windworn Hill.
  • I understand. I will count the herd again and hope the grass grows.
  • The high pasture at the top of The Long Ridge, and fifty monsters on the ridge.
  • Still green? Knee-high, you say? Then the stumps did not want the grass, only the ground. That is something.
  • And fifty fewer of them between the camps and the top. I could take a herd up there. I could. If the watch walked the path that morning.
  • Cheese and milk from the camps, and my thanks. Do not go far, Player. I have one more thing to ask, and I do not like asking it.

docs.title: The Herds Go Out
docs.text:
With the bridge held, Sennu wants to take the herds out to the old far pastures. Hunt 80 Wild Boars on the Boar Runs before they go.

Town Midbarium Category Side Given by Sennu Level 46 After The High Pasture

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 80 Wild Boar in The Boar Runs

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 26,000 EXP
  • 920 mesos
  • Herder's Breeches x1
  • Goat Cheese x10
  • +20 standing with Midbarium
  • +30 standing with Sennu
Dialogue
  • The ridge pasture holds, thanks to you, but it is small, and the ground near town is grazed to the stone. My grandmother drove the herds across the far bridge to the slopes every summer. With the bridge held, I mean to try it again.
  • The Wild Boars on The Boar Runs will scatter a herd in a heartbeat. Kill 80 of them before we go out. Whatever is raiding the herd edges is Skarra's worry. Boars are mine.
  • I will count the herd twice tonight, and twice again in the morning. Habit.
  • Then the herds stay close and the ground near town gets thinner. Think on it.
  • Eighty Wild Boars on The Boar Runs, before the herds go out.
  • Eighty. My son would have whistled the whole way and called it easy. You did not whistle, I hope.
  • We go out at the next new moon. Here, Tolmach breeches: they will outlast your boots, and probably you. Thank you, Player.

docs.title: A Word for Tavi
docs.text:
Sennu needs the trail watch on the ridge path the morning the herds go up, but she and Tavi will not speak to each other. Carry her word to Tavi.

Town Midbarium Category Story Given by Sennu Completed with Tavi Level 22 After A Safe Pasture Leads to Three Goats' Tracks

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 1,400 EXP
  • 440 mesos
  • Travel Ration x10
  • +40 standing with Midbarium
  • +30 standing with Sennu
Dialogue
  • The herds need the watch on the ridge path the morning they go up. One morning, a few spears along the switchbacks. It is not a great thing to ask.
  • But I will not ask it. Tavi told the council last spring the Tolmach should keep closer to town, and I told the council the Uskari should keep their noses out of the herds. We have not said a word to each other since.
  • So you will say it for me. Go to Tavi on the Uskari Rim. Tell Tavi the herds go up to the The Long Ridge pasture at the next new moon, and the Tolmach would take it kindly if the watch walked the path that morning. Kindly, Player. Use that word.
  • And if Tavi laughs, do not tell me. I will know anyway.
  • No, I suppose it is not your quarrel. It is not really mine either. That is the trouble with it.
  • Tavi is on the Uskari Rim. The herds go up at the next new moon. Kindly.
  • Sennu sent you. With the word kindly in it? Sennu has not said kindly to me in a year.
  • Tell Sennu the watch will be on the switchbacks before the herds are, every spear Tavi can spare. And tell Sennu that Tavi said so first, before being asked twice. That part matters.
  • Now, you. You walked the The Long Ridge for Skarra and for Sennu both. There is a stretch further out I walk myself, and I could use someone who does not get tired.
  • Here, rations for the road. Come back to me when you are ready to see the worst of it.

docs.title: The Deeply Touched
docs.text:
The worst of the Disturbance-touched are deeply touched. Seren pays dearly for each one.

Town Fairy Forest Category Repeatable Given by Seren Level 56 After Oriel Lingers

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 1 Epic Deeply touched creature (Gloaming Wisp, Thorny Bramble, Forest Howlet, Night Howlet, Forest Glimmerfox, Night Glimmerfox, Blue Spring Sprite, Deep Spring Sprite)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 43,562 EXP
  • 2,520 mesos
  • +40 standing with Seren
  • +30 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • Out in the Gloaming there are worse than touched ones. Deeply touched. Enormous, strange, and they take a whole watch to stop.
  • Bring one down and the watch will pay you what it's worth.
  • Defeat a deeply touched creature in the Gloaming. They come when you have fought a long while in one place.
  • Carefully, Player.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • One of the deeply touched.
  • One deeply touched. The watch is in your debt.

docs.title: Touched by the Disturbance
docs.text:
The worst of the lake's creatures are Disturbance-touched. Seren pays well for each one put down.

Town Fairy Forest Category Repeatable Given by Seren Level 24 After Past the Last Lantern

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 3 Elite Disturbance-touched creatures (Firefly Slime, Shimmer Slime, Water Sprite, Forest Sprite)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 3,557 EXP
  • 1,080 mesos
  • +15 standing with Seren
  • +30 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • Some of what comes up from the lake is worse than the rest. Bigger. Harder to kill. Shimmering, some of them, like they've a shield on.
  • Disturbance-touched, people call them. I want every one of them gone.
  • Defeat 3 Disturbance-touched creatures at Shimmerwater.
  • They come when you stay and fight a while. You'll know them.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • Three of the touched ones.
  • Three. Good. That's three fewer.

docs.title: The Gloaming Watch
docs.text:
The Gloaming never stays quiet. Seren pays for every watch kept out there.

Town Fairy Forest Category Repeatable Given by Seren Level 52 After Oriel Lingers

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 120 Creature of the Gloamings (Gloaming Wisp, Thorny Bramble, Forest Howlet, Night Howlet, Forest Glimmerfox, Night Glimmerfox, Blue Spring Sprite, Deep Spring Sprite)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 17,480 EXP
  • 1,560 mesos
  • +15 standing with Seren
  • +20 standing with Fairy Forest

The first time you complete it instead: 34,959 EXP, 2,340 mesos, +15 standing with Seren, +30 standing with Fairy Forest

Dialogue
  • The Gloaming's the worst of it now. The watch can hold the lanterns. Past them, it's you.
  • A hundred and twenty out there, and the watch pays. Every time.
  • Defeat 120 creatures in the Deepening or the Twilit Wood.
  • Eyes open.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • A hundred and twenty.
  • A good watch. Here's your pay.

docs.title: Something Grey at the Lakehead
docs.text:
Seren's guards have seen something huge and grey at the head of the lake. Find the way up to it.

Town Fairy Forest Category Story Given by Seren Level 26 After A Cleansing Draught Leads to The Blightstone

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Defeat 60 Sprite of Shimmerwaters (Water Sprite, Forest Sprite)
  2. Reach the way to the Lakehead in Shimmerwater, the Third Path

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 6,002 EXP
  • 780 mesos
  • +60 standing with Seren
  • +25 standing with Fairy Forest
  • Unlocks boss.blightstone
Dialogue
  • My guards went to the lake's head last night. Something huge and grey is squatting over the spring there. Stone, they said. Stone that moved.
  • Whatever is souring that lake, it's sitting on it. I want you to find the way up and see it for yourself.
  • Clear 60 sprites from the Shimmerwater paths and find the way to the Lakehead, at the west end of the third path. The old listening tree there knows the way.
  • Go carefully. Look, don't fight, unless you're sure.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • The west end of the third path. The old tree.
  • A stone golem, wrapped in rotten wood. And the poison runs off it into the spring.
  • Then that's what we go after. The old tree will let you up to the Lakehead now.

docs.title: Ironbark Shafts
docs.text:
The watch's spears are snapping on the new hides. Seren wants ironbark from the Hollow Oak's deadfall for new shafts: wood the forest can spare.

Town Fairy Forest Category Story Given by Seren Level 33 After Kestrel's Report Leads to Something That Would Rather Not Be Drawn

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Bring 15 Ironbark Limb (taken)
  • Defeat 60 Eye at the oak's rootss (Cold Eye, Curse Eye) in The Hollow Oak, Roots

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 12,127 EXP
  • 990 mesos
  • Ironbark Spear x1
  • +60 standing with Seren
  • +25 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • The spears my watch carries were made for keeping visitors honest, not for these hides. Two snapped last night.
  • Ironbark makes the best shafts in the forest, and the Hollow Oak has been dropping dead limbs all season. Dead wood, mind. The forest can spare it. Nobody cuts a living branch for my spears.
  • Bring me 15 Ironbark Limbs from the deadfall at the Hollow Oak's roots. The Eyes there drag them about. Clear 60 of them while you're at it.
  • Mind the Eyes. They're thick at the oak's foot.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • (how many you carry) of 15 limbs.
  • Good, straight grain. Ondine's workshop will have these fitted by morning.
  • Take this one. It's the first. The watch walks the outer lanterns with ironbark from tonight.

docs.title: Before Dark
docs.text:
Juniper has gone up the Hollow Oak alone. Bring her back before dark.

Town Fairy Forest Category Story Given by Seren Level 45 After Three Kinds, Sharpened Leads to Old Grizzlemane

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Defeat 100 Creature of the Hollow Oaks (Sharpened Lupin, Gloomfur Lupin, Surgeon Eye)
  2. Talk to Juniper

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 30,359 EXP
  • 1,350 mesos
  • +60 standing with Seren
  • +25 standing with Fairy Forest
  • Unlocks boss.old_grizzlemane
Dialogue
  • Juniper's gone up the oak. Alone. Again. Kestrel saw her go at noon with a fresh notebook and that look.
  • I want her back before dark. You know the way.
  • Climb the Hollow Oak, clearing 100 creatures on the way, and find Juniper. Bring her back.
  • Before dark, Player.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • Juniper. The oak. Before dark.
  • She came in. Muddy, scratched and grinning. She sketched it, she says. Whatever it is.
  • Thank you. I'd go myself, but somebody has to keep Thorne at the lantern.
  • Player! Shh. Look up. No, further. There.
  • An ape. Grey. Grizzled. Big as a cart. It's torn the crown apart and made a nest of it, and my notebook is in the nest. I drew it. I'm coming, I'm coming. It's nearly dark anyway.

docs.title: The Watch Goes Out
docs.text:
With her new guards, Seren takes the watch out into the Twilit Wood with you. Keep Thorne from charging into the dark.

Town Fairy Forest Category Story Given by Seren Level 64 After Nineteen Years of Lanterns Leads to Following the Root

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Talk to Thorne
  2. Defeat 5 Elite Deeply touched creatures (Night Glimmerfox, Blue Spring Sprite, Deep Spring Sprite)
  3. Defeat 150 Creature of the Twilit Woods (Night Glimmerfox, Blue Spring Sprite, Deep Spring Sprite)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 86,368 EXP
  • 1,920 mesos
  • +150 standing with Seren
  • +25 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • Nineteen years I asked. Nineteen years. And now I have hands enough to take the watch past the lanterns instead of only standing at them.
  • We're going into the Twilit Wood. The deeply touched ones are thick out there. And Thorne is so excited he can't stand still.
  • Steady Thorne, then go out with the watch: put down 5 deeply touched creatures and 150 more in the Twilit Wood.
  • Watch, with me.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • Thorne, then the wood.
  • The watch came home. All of them. That's the best report I've ever written.
  • Thorne didn't charge once. He says it's because you stood next to him. He's probably right.
  • We're going OUT! Past the lanterns! With the whole watch! I've been waiting my whole life for this!
  • ...Stay with you. Not charge. Right. Right. I can do that. Probably. You'll be next to me? Then definitely.

docs.title: Past the Last Lantern
docs.text:
Seren will let you past the last lantern if you stand a night watch with Thorne first and keep him from charging into the dark.

Town Fairy Forest Category Story Given by Seren Level 21 After Sitting Up with Ailo Leads to Bitter Water, The Shimmerwater Watch, Touched by the Disturbance, A Safer Way to See, The Trick That Works, Still Enough, The Promise to the Gardens, A Sealed Letter, The Pane Ondine Hasn't Noticed, The High Bridge, A Week Without Galen, The Smell of the Sea, A Trick for Siora, A Newcomer Who Is Struggling

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Talk to Thorne
  2. Defeat 30 Firefly Slime in Shimmerwater, the First Path

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 3,202 EXP
  • 630 mesos
  • +60 standing with Seren
  • +25 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • Young slimes in the gardens. Ailo saw them. That means they're coming in along the outer paths, past my lanterns, at night.
  • I'll let you go out after them on one condition. Stand tonight's watch with Thorne, and keep him from charging into the dark. Then follow the trail.
  • Stand the watch with Thorne, then follow the slime trail west off the Bloomwood to the Shimmerwater paths and defeat 30 Firefly Slimes there.
  • Good. The trail leaves the Bloomwood heading west, toward the World Tree. You'll see the lake glowing at dusk.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • Thorne first. Then the trail.
  • Firefly slimes, from the lake. So that's where they're coming from.
  • You kept Thorne out of the dark, too. I heard. That's harder than any slime.
  • The night watch! With you! Brilliant. I'll take point. Out there. In the dark.
  • ...Seren said you'd say that. All right. All right! I'll stay by the lantern. But if anything comes, it's mine.

docs.title: The Shimmerwater Watch
docs.text:
The lake creatures are still sick and savage. Seren pays for every watch kept on the Shimmerwater paths.

Town Fairy Forest Category Repeatable Given by Seren Level 22 After Past the Last Lantern

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 60 Shimmerwater creatures (Firefly Slime, Shimmer Slime, Water Sprite, Forest Sprite)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 1,377 EXP
  • 660 mesos
  • +15 standing with Seren
  • +20 standing with Fairy Forest

The first time you complete it instead: 2,754 EXP, 990 mesos, +15 standing with Seren, +30 standing with Fairy Forest

Dialogue
  • The lake's creatures are sick and savage, and they'll stay that way a while yet. The paths need watching.
  • Keep a watch out there for me, and the watch pays. Every time.
  • Defeat 60 creatures on the Shimmerwater paths.
  • Eyes open.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • Sixty. Keep count.
  • A good watch. Here's your pay.

docs.title: The Touched of the Oak
docs.text:
Disturbance-touched creatures nest in the Hollow Oak. Seren pays well for each one put down.

Town Fairy Forest Category Repeatable Given by Seren Level 34 After The Swarming Shore

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 3 Elite Disturbance-touched creatures (Evil Eye, Curse Eye, Cold Eye, Sharpened Lupin, Gloomfur Lupin, Surgeon Eye)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 9,933 EXP
  • 1,530 mesos
  • +15 standing with Seren
  • +30 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • The worst of them are touched by the Disturbance: bigger, harder, some with a shimmer like a shield on them. The oak's full of them now.
  • Three at a time. The watch pays.
  • Defeat 3 Disturbance-touched creatures on the High Shore or the Hollow Oak.
  • Stay and fight a while. They come.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • Three of the touched.
  • Three. Good.

docs.title: Settling In
docs.text:
Tobin wants you to see the Market and meet Bram, the potion seller.

Town Kaldemor Category Story Given by Tobin Completed with Tobin Level 1 After Welcome Home Leads to Snail Trouble, A Head for Heights

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Reach the market in Kaldemor
  • Talk to Bram

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 20 EXP
  • Red Potion x5
  • +10 standing with Kaldemor
Dialogue
  • A good traveller knows where to shop. Would you visit the Market, down the east end of the main street, and say hello to Bram, the potion seller? Tell him I sent you.
  • Thank you, Player! Walk east along the main street and down the steps. Bram stands among the shops.
  • Of course, of course. Come back whenever you like.
  • Have you been to the Market yet? Walk east along the main street and down the steps; Bram stands among the shops.
  • Oh, Tobin sent you? Welcome, Player! Come back to me whenever you need potions. Tell the mayor that Bram says hello!
  • You met Bram? Splendid! I knew you would fit right in.
  • Please take these Red Potions. They will keep you going out in the fields. Good luck, Player!

docs.title: A New Route
docs.text:
The hill path Shade used to bring caravans in by has tracks on it too large for any boar. Shade needs a new way past the Tusk Path: hunt 40 beasts along it and reach its far end.

Town Urbanograd Category Story Given by Shade Level 33 After Reading Tracks Leads to The Lost Notes

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Defeat 40 Tusk Path beasts in The Tusk Path
  2. Reach the far end of the Tusk Path in The Tusk Path

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 36,240 EXP
  • 4,620 mesos
  • +50 standing with Shade
  • +20 standing with Urbanograd
Dialogue
  • Hatch sent you. Said you're slow. That's what Hatch says about everyone worth sending.
  • Three of my routes are gone. The ford: something waits there at dusk. The cutting: the birds stopped singing. The hill path: tracks the size of a cartwheel. Hatch walked all three before me. I don't take people where I can't see the end.
  • There's a way along the The Tusk Path, higher up the hill. Longer. Stranger. Might hold. I need someone to walk it ahead of me, clear what's on it, and tell me if the far end comes out where I think.
  • Hunt 40 of whatever lives on the The Tusk Path, and walk it to the far end. Then come back and tell me what you saw. All of it.
  • Keep to the high side. Look at the ground more than the trees.
  • Fine. I'll walk it myself. Takes longer.
  • Forty along the The Tusk Path, and the far end. High side.
  • Boar on the path, hogs on the slope, and the big tracks crossing it twice, going down toward the wet ground. Not along it. Across. Hm.
  • So the high side holds, if you move in the morning and keep walking. That's a route. Not a good one. A route.
  • Hatch will want to hear about those tracks. Go tell him. He'll pretend he isn't interested. He'll be lying.

docs.title: Falling Lessons
docs.text:
Shade once taught Scrap, the rooftop scamp, how to fall from a low wall without breaking anything. Shade wants to know whether the lesson took, without Scrap knowing who is asking. Go and watch Scrap fall.

Town Urbanograd Category Side Given by Shade Level 22

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Talk to Scrap

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 920 EXP
  • 1,320 mesos
  • +40 standing with Shade
  • +10 standing with Urbanograd
Dialogue
  • There's a child on the roofs. Scrap. Vane's girl. Follows me. Thinks I don't see her. I see her.
  • Last spring she came off a low wall wrong and nearly took her wrist with her. So I showed her how to land. Knees soft, roll on the shoulder, never put a hand out. Once. I haven't checked since. She'd know.
  • Go up to the Rooftops and find Scrap. Get her to show you a fall. Don't say I sent you.
  • She'll find you before you find her. Let her.
  • Fine. I'll keep not checking.
  • Scrap, on the Rooftops. Watch her land. Don't mention me.
  • Boo! Ha, you jumped. Everybody jumps. Except one person, and I am not saying who. What do you want? I am busy. I am practising being an adventurer.
  • A fall? Watch. Off this wall. Knees soft, and you go over on your shoulder like a barrel, and you never, ever put your hand out, because hands are for later. See? Not even a scrape. Again? Watch again.
  • Someone taught me. I am not saying who. It is a secret, and I keep secrets in my tin with my other things. One day I am going to sneak up on that someone, and that someone will not hear me at all.
  • Knees soft. Shoulder. No hand. Twice, without being asked. Hm.
  • She'll be on the roads one day. Can't stop it. Vane can't either. But she'll land right.
  • Thanks. If she asks who sent you, you were just passing. That's true enough. Most people are.

docs.title: Hawks That Hunt Late
docs.text:
Shade brings travelers in over the Downs, and the Disturbance-touched duskhawks stoop on them long after the others have gone to roost. Defeat 2 Elite duskhawks. Shade will ask again, any time.

Town Urbanograd Category Repeatable Given by Shade Level 55

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 2 Elite Duskhawk

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 18,800 EXP
  • 2,200 mesos
  • +40 standing with Shade
  • +30 standing with Urbanograd
Dialogue
  • Duskhawks roost when the light goes. Most of them. The touched ones keep hunting after dark, and they like a lantern. I have people to bring in over the Downs. 2 Disturbance-touched Duskhawks. Again whenever they come back.
  • Watch for the one still in the air when the rest are down.
  • Then I wait for daylight. It costs a day.
  • Two touched Duskhawks. The late ones.
  • Two. Good.
  • My travelers will never know your name. The Table will. That is the usual way of it.

docs.title: Shells for the Mayor
docs.text:
Mayor Tobin collects snail shells for the new fence. Bring him 15 Green Snail Shells.

Town Kaldemor Category Story Given by Hale Completed with Tobin Level 2 After Snail Trouble Leads to Strength of a Warrior, The Clock Stopped, Hale's Bounty, A Smith's First Bar, A Sharper Sword, Kaldemor's Pest Watch, The Snail King

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Bring 15 Green Snail Shell (taken)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 120 EXP
  • Wooden Buckler x1
  • +30 standing with Kaldemor
Dialogue
  • Well done with the snails, Player. Funny thing: the mayor wants their shells to grind into the mortar for the new fence. Would you bring 15 Green Snail Shells to Tobin? They drop from the green snails now and then.
  • Good. Pick up what the snails leave behind with Z, and carry the shells to Tobin in the town square.
  • Fair enough. The shells will keep, and so will I.
  • Fifteen Green Snail Shells for Tobin. You carry (how many you carry) so far.
  • Shells! Splendid, and so many of them. Hale told me you were reliable, Player.
  • Take this Wooden Buckler for your trouble. A fighter needs something to hold in the other hand.

docs.title: Shiny Things
docs.text:
The Hoarder Shrooms are carrying shiny things away through the Deepwood. Wilf wants to see what they take: collect 10 Stolen Trinkets from Hoarder Shrooms.

Town Kaldemor Category Story Given by Wilf Level 32 After Too Bold Leads to Quietly, for Dottie

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Bring 10 Stolen Trinket (taken)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 16,000 EXP
  • 4,000 mesos
  • +30 standing with Kaldemor
Dialogue
  • I went back in, Player, early, like I said. And I saw a thing. A Shroom went past me with a thimble on its head. A thimble! Then another with a spoon. They were not eating them. They were carrying them.
  • I want to see what they take. Bring me 10 Stolen Trinkets off the Hoarder Shrooms. Then I will know whether I am going daft or the woods are.
  • They hold on tight, so you will have to knock them loose. The The Humming Trail is thick with them, and a few wander into Windflower Glade.
  • Suit yourself. I will keep counting spoons on my own.
  • 10 Stolen Trinkets, Player. The Hoarder Shrooms carry them. Knock them loose.
  • A thimble. A button. Half a buckle, a bell off a goat, a tin spoon. None of it worth a copper, all of it shiny.
  • And here is the odd part. Every one I watched went the same way: deeper in, toward the far side of the woods. Not home to a nest. Away. As if something over there wanted them.
  • I do not know what to make of it yet. I will keep the trinkets in a jar, and keep watching which way they go. Here, for your trouble.

docs.title: Shiny Things, Found
docs.text:
Wilf always wanted to know where the Shrooms were carrying their shiny things. The answer is up the walls of Stonecap Keep. Collect 20 Stolen Trinkets from the Hoarder Shrooms on the Battlements.

Town Kaldemor Category Story Given by Wilf Level 56 After Up the Walls Leads to Brass and Tin

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Bring 20 Stolen Trinket (taken)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 70,000 EXP
  • 5,000 mesos
  • Elixir x3
  • +35 standing with Kaldemor
Dialogue
  • You again. Treading on things, I expect. Garrick came down from his ledge to tell me what you saw from the old keep, which is the most he has said to me in nine years.
  • The shiny things. Thimbles, buttons, spoons. The Shrooms carried them all toward the far side of the woods, and I said I would like to know where. Well, now I know. Up the walls. The Hoarder Shrooms run them up the Battlements like ants with crumbs.
  • Bring me 20 Stolen Trinkets back off the Hoarder Shrooms on the Battlements. Half of Kaldemor has lost a button this year. Somebody ought to give them back, and it is not going to be me up a wall with these knees.
  • Mind the ones on the high walk. They are quicker than they look, and they bite when you take things off them. I would too.
  • Suit yourself. The buttons are not going anywhere. Well, they are. Up.
  • Twenty Stolen Trinkets, Player, off the Hoarder Shrooms on the Battlements. Listen for the ones that clink.
  • Look at that. Mabel's thimble. A tin button off one of Wilbur's coats. Three spoons, all bent the same way. They did not want any of it to eat, you know. They just wanted it near whatever is in there.
  • I will take them round. Everybody gets their own back. And then I am going to stand in my damp hollow for a whole afternoon and not think about walls at all.
  • Here. For your trouble, and for finding out. That is one thing I wanted to know, and now I know it. That is rare at my age.

docs.title: Boots Never Collected
docs.text:
A pair of boots left at Simkin's bench months ago was never collected, the soles white with chalk and pocked with stings. He wants to know where they walked, and whether Gytha knows whose they are.

Town Selsior Category Side Given by Simkin Level 25 After Leather Off the Downs

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Reach the chalk bank in The Thyme Banks
  2. Defeat 30 Wild Bee in The Thyme Banks
  3. Talk to Gytha

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 2,670 EXP
  • 500 mesos
  • Orange Potion x10
  • +20 standing with Selsior
  • +100 standing with Simkin
Dialogue
  • See these? Left on my bench in spring, never collected. Chalk ground into the welt, and little holes in the leather. Stings. Through boot leather.
  • Chalk like that comes off the The Thyme Banks. Go and stand on the chalk bank there, clear 30 Wild Bees, and then ask my girl Gytha. She knows every shirt in the lanes. She'll know whose feet these were.
  • Go on. I'll keep them on the shelf. Next to the scorched one.
  • Hm. Then they'll sit there another season.
  • The chalk bank on the Thyme Banks, thirty bees, then ask Gytha.
  • A shepherd's lad from the downs, Gytha says, who came to town and went home in a hurry in borrowed shoes. Hm.
  • Then I'll mend these and send them back with a carter. If any carter will go. Thank you, Player. Don't let it go to your head.
  • Chalk boots, holes in the leather? Dad's still on about those?
  • There was a shepherd's lad lodging two lanes over in spring. His shirts came in full of stings. He went home to the downs in a borrowed pair. Tell Dad that, and tell him to eat something.

docs.title: Leather Off the Downs
docs.text:
The carters have stopped bringing good hide into the city, and Simkin's bench is short of leather. He wants ten boar hides from the downs.

Town Selsior Category Side Given by Simkin Level 22 Leads to Boots Never Collected

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Bring 10 Downs Boar Hide (taken)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 2,680 EXP
  • 440 mesos
  • Orange Potion x10
  • +15 standing with Selsior
  • +80 standing with Simkin
Dialogue
  • Hm. You. Your soles are worn, but honestly. Listen: the carters stopped bringing hide in from the farms. Afraid of the roads, the lot of them.
  • The boars on the downs have hide thick enough for a proper sole. Bring me 10 Downs Boar Hides from the Downs Boars and I'll see you shod.
  • Downs Edge and the Thyme Banks, out the Tree Gate. Mind the tusks. I can't mend a leg.
  • Fine. I'll stitch with what I've got. Badly.
  • Ten boar hides, Player. You have (how many you carry). Ten is more than that.
  • Thick, clean, cut right. Who taught you to skin? Never mind, don't tell me.
  • There. My bench is full again, and my fingers will complain all week. Here's your due.

docs.title: The Hazel That Answered
docs.text:
Once, a hazel answered Siora's spell. She wants to find it again and learn why.

Town Fairy Forest Category Side Given by Siora Level 25 After Practice Without Watching Leads to The Truer Letter

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Look at the hazel by the path in The Bloomwood, South
  • Defeat 40 Glimmerwings (Glimmerwing, Crowned Glimmerwing)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 3,677 EXP
  • 550 mesos
  • +150 standing with Siora
  • +15 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • Last spring, walking from Selsior, I tried a little spell by the road, and a hazel answered. Leaves moved. Just for me.
  • I want to find it again. It's somewhere in the Bloomwood's southern stretch. The glimmerwings are thick there now.
  • Find the hazel by the path in the Bloomwood's southern stretch (examine it), clearing 40 glimmerwings around it.
  • Thank you. I'll practise until you're back.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • The hazel. South Bloomwood.
  • It moved for you too? Then it wasn't just me.
  • Sorrel says hazels listen best. Maybe I just need to be listened to. Maybe that's it.

docs.title: The Truer Letter
docs.text:
Siora writes cheerful letters home every month. This month she wants to write a true one, and needs courage first.

Town Fairy Forest Category Side Given by Siora Level 32 After The Hazel That Answered, The Swarming Shore

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Defeat 50 Creature of the High Shore or the Oaks (Evil Eye, Curse Eye, Cold Eye, Sharpened Lupin, Gloomfur Lupin, Surgeon Eye)
  • Talk to Amaryl

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 7,613 EXP
  • 704 mesos
  • +150 standing with Siora
  • +15 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • I write home every month. Cheerful letters. 'Everything is wonderful.' It isn't always.
  • This month I want to tell them the truth. That it's hard. That it's getting better. I need to be brave first. Will you go out and be brave with me? Then I'll ask Amaryl if it's all right to say.
  • Clear 50 creatures on the High Shore or the Hollow Oak, then ask Amaryl for Siora.
  • Thank you. I'm writing the first line now.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • Be brave, then Amaryl.
  • I sent it. The true one. 'It's hard, and I'm getting better.'
  • My mother wrote back the same day. She said she knew. She said she's proud. I cried a little.
  • A true letter? Tell her yes. The truth is always the better letter.
  • ...And tell her I said her light stayed lit for a breath. Her mother should know that.

docs.title: Find Bekk
docs.text:
Bekk went after the raider alone. Find him on the Hot Rocks and get him out: hunt 40 Iron Boars, then see him home.

Town Midbarium Category Story Given by Skarra Completed with Bekk Level 42 After The Raider Leads to Follow the Tracks

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Look at Bekk's hiding place in The Hot Rocks
  2. Defeat 40 Iron Boar in The Hot Rocks

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 36,500 EXP
  • 840 mesos
  • Trail Watch Helm x1
  • Highland Salve x10
  • +40 standing with Midbarium
  • +30 standing with Skarra
Dialogue
  • The tracks run past the Ironback Flats onto The Hot Rocks. That is where he will be. I cannot leave the watch, and if I send anyone else they will go slow and careful, and he does not have slow and careful.
  • Find him, Player. Whatever is around him, clear it: 40 Iron Boars, more if you must. Then bring him home. Bring him home.
  • Low ground on The Hot Rocks, where the rock is broken. He climbs up when he is cornered. He always has.
  • Then I go myself and the watch goes without a captain. Think again, quickly.
  • Find Bekk on The Hot Rocks, then clear forty Iron Boars so he can get out.
  • Do not tell her I was out of arrows. Tell her anything else. All right, tell her that too, she will know anyway.
  • I was up on a rock with boars all around and nothing left to shoot. You came over that ridge like a falling stone. I owe you, Player. Mother sent a Trail Watch helm down with you for me, for next time. I think you need it more than I do. Keep it.

docs.title: Hold the Old Camp
docs.text:
Skarra wants a Trail Watch post at the Old War Camp. Clear 100 monsters on the Weathered Rocks, then reach the camp.

Town Midbarium Category Story Given by Skarra Level 55 After Dates and Dots Leads to New Staves

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Defeat 100 monsters in The Weathered Rocks
  2. Reach The Old War Camp

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 111,000 EXP
  • 1,100 mesos
  • Highland Salve x10
  • +40 standing with Midbarium
  • +30 standing with Skarra
Dialogue
  • Tavi showed you my map. Fine. Then you've seen the dots past the Dry Hills, and you know the watch can't keep walking out there and back in a day.
  • There's an old war camp beyond The Weathered Rocks, from the Age of Division, with one corner still standing. I want a post in it. Clear me a way, 100 monsters on The Weathered Rocks, then go and stand in The Old War Camp so I know it can be reached.
  • The Weathered Rocks are past the Dry Hills. The boars out there raid in packs. Keep your back to the rock.
  • Then the watch walks it the long way and comes home half dead. Your choice.
  • A hundred on The Weathered Rocks, then reach The Old War Camp. I'll send the first pair out when you're back.
  • You stood in it? Walls, a roof over one corner, room for a fire? Good. That's the first place out there my people can sleep.
  • The Savages held the highlands' western edge from that camp once. Now it holds a water skin and two of Tavi's scouts. Funny, how things go.
  • Here. Salve for the road, the watch's own. You'll need it out there more than we will here.

docs.title: The North Ridge Patrol
docs.text:
Skarra sends a patrol over the North Ridge every day, and today it is short a pair of hands. Hunt 40 Ridge Stumps on the North Ridge and report at the Trail Watch post.

Town Midbarium Category Side Given by Skarra Level 16 Leads to Red Dots, The Canyon Stretch

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Defeat 40 Ridge Stump in The North Ridge
  • Reach the Trail Watch post in The North Ridge

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 2,150 EXP
  • 320 mesos
  • Orange Potion x10
  • +20 standing with Midbarium
  • +30 standing with Skarra
Dialogue
  • You. You have the look of someone who can walk a day and still swing at the end of it. Good. The trail watch is short of hands, and the The North Ridge does not care how short we are.
  • Ridge Stumps. Dead wood off the ridge, walking about where it pleases. My patrol cuts them back every day and every night there are more.
  • Walk the patrol: 40 Ridge Stumps on The North Ridge, then report at the Trail Watch post on the ridge. They will know you came from me.
  • North gate, then up. The post is the stone shelter with our standard on it. Do not stop to admire the view until you get there.
  • Then someone else walks it twice. Fine.
  • Forty Ridge Stumps on The North Ridge, then the Trail Watch post.
  • The post says you came in with bark in your hair and nothing broken. That is a good patrol.
  • Potions, and the watch's thanks, which we do not give out often. Come back when you want more of this. There is always more of this.

docs.title: Red Dots
docs.text:
Skarra marks every sighting on her hide map with a red dot. Reach the newest dots on Windworn Hill and the Long Ridge, and hunt 40 Gnarled Stumps on Windworn Hill.

Town Midbarium Category Story Given by Skarra Level 20 After Walk the Patrols, The North Ridge Patrol Leads to A Safe Pasture, The Ridge Bounty, Touched on the Ridges

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Reach the red dot on Windworn Hill in Windworn Hill
  2. Reach the red dot on the Long Ridge in The Long Ridge
  3. Defeat 40 Gnarled Stump in Windworn Hill

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 4,950 EXP
  • 400 mesos
  • Orange Potion x10
  • Highland Salve x5
  • +40 standing with Midbarium
  • +30 standing with Skarra
Dialogue
  • This is the map. Hide, ochre, and ten years of my hand. Every red dot is a sighting, with its date beside it. Look at it, and then tell me I am wrong to worry.
  • These, up on the high ridges, are this summer's. Dots on ground where there were none when I became captain. Up there the old twisted trees have woken and walk, and the dark ones are the worst of them.
  • Before the next council I want the newest dots checked: the dot on Windworn Hill and the dot on The Long Ridge. And clear 40 Gnarled Stumps on Windworn Hill while you are up there.
  • The ridges leave from the top ledge of the The North Ridge. Climb, and keep climbing. And Player: whatever you see, the Old One hears it from you and not from me. That is what he asked for.
  • Then the dots stay unchecked another week. They do not get smaller.
  • The dots on Windworn Hill and The Long Ridge, and forty Gnarled Stumps on the hill.
  • Both dots, and stumps around both? Then I was right, and I wish I were not.
  • I will mark them again with today's date. Two dots where there was one. That is what the map has done all summer.
  • Take these. Salve for the scrapes; the dark bark cuts. You will be going higher than this before the summer is out.

docs.title: The Ridge Bounty
docs.text:
Skarra pays the trail watch's bounty for the High Ridges: 60 of the ridges' stumps, any time.

Town Midbarium Category Repeatable Given by Skarra Level 21 After Red Dots

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 60 High Ridges monsters (Gnarled Stump, Axe Stump, Dark Axe Stump)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 5,500 EXP
  • 420 mesos
  • +20 standing with Midbarium

The first time you complete it instead: 7,000 EXP, 840 mesos, Orange Potion x20, +15 standing with Midbarium, +30 standing with Skarra

Dialogue
  • The ridges grow stumps faster than the watch can cut them. The bounty is 60: Gnarled Stumps, Axe Stumps or Dark Axe Stumps, anywhere on the High Ridges. Bring me sixty and I pay. Again and again.
  • Good. Every one you cut is one less dot on my map. Well. One less dot next week.
  • Then the watch cuts them alone. As usual.
  • Sixty of the ridges' stumps: Gnarled Stumps, Axe Stumps or Dark Axe Stumps.
  • Sixty. The patrol on Windworn Hill will have a quiet night for once.
  • Your bounty. Come back when the ridges have grown another crop. They will.

docs.title: Touched on the Ridges
docs.text:
Some of the ridges' stumps are Disturbance-touched: bigger, harder and shimmering. Skarra pays well for each one put down.

Town Midbarium Category Repeatable Given by Skarra Level 22 After Red Dots

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 1 Elite Disturbance-touched stump (Gnarled Stump, Axe Stump, Dark Axe Stump)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 1,800 EXP
  • 440 mesos
  • +20 standing with Midbarium

The first time you complete it instead: 3,000 EXP, 880 mesos, Elixir x5, +15 standing with Midbarium, +30 standing with Skarra

Dialogue
  • My patrols come back with stories of stumps twice the size of the rest, wood that shimmers, axes that do not stop. Disturbance-touched, the lowlanders call them. My patrols call them something I will not repeat.
  • Put one down for me. One Disturbance-touched stump on the High Ridges, any kind. The watch pays for every one.
  • They come when you stay and fight a while. You will know one when it comes. Do not fight it on a ledge.
  • Sensible. Most of my patrol says the same.
  • One Disturbance-touched stump on the High Ridges.
  • One of the touched ones, down. The patrols will sleep better.
  • Your pay. And my thanks, which does not change no matter how many times you bring me one.

docs.title: The Canyon Stretch
docs.text:
There is a stretch of the watch's canyon trail Ketta will not walk. Go to the head of the rope-way at the east edge of the Uskari Rim and look down at it.

Town Midbarium Category Story Given by Skarra Level 20 After The North Ridge Patrol Leads to Earn Her Trust

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Look at the head of the rope-way in Midbarium

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 1,750 EXP
  • 400 mesos
  • Orange Potion x10
  • +40 standing with Midbarium
  • +30 standing with Skarra
Dialogue
  • Every patrol on my board gets walked, Player. Except one: the canyon stretch below the rim, past a cave mouth. The scout it belongs to keeps trading it away for night watches nobody wants.
  • I let her. Ketta's earned some room. But there's a new red dot on that stretch, and somebody saw drake sign in the dust at the cave mouth.
  • Go to the head of the rope-way at the east edge of the rim, where the watch goes down the canyon wall. Look down at that cave mouth and tell me what you see. Don't go down.
  • East edge of the rim, past Zirra's workshop. Lie flat if you're not used to the drop.
  • Then it stays a red dot. I don't like red dots.
  • The head of the rope-way, at the east edge of the Uskari Rim. Look down at the cave mouth.
  • Scales in the dust and a track wider than your arm? Drakes, then, and not small ones. Something is breeding down there.
  • That's the cave Ketta sheltered in on her way home last spring. She's never said a word about it, and I've never asked.
  • Maybe you should. She talks more easily to anyone who isn't her captain. Take these for the climb.

docs.title: The Trail Watch Bounty
docs.text:
Skarra pays the trail watch's bounty to anyone who keeps the roads clear: 50 of the roads' monsters, any time.

Town Midbarium Category Repeatable Given by Skarra Level 15

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 50 Road monsters (Dust Boggle, Ridge Stump, Edge Lizard, Snapping Lizard)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 2,000 EXP
  • 300 mesos
  • +20 standing with Midbarium

The first time you complete it instead: 2,600 EXP, 600 mesos, White Potion x10, +15 standing with Midbarium, +30 standing with Skarra

Dialogue
  • The watch pays a bounty for the roads, Player: 50 monsters of the canyon roads and the woodland trail. Boggles, stumps, the lizards in the woods, it is all the same to me. Bring me fifty and I pay. Bring me fifty more and I pay again.
  • Good. You do not need to tell me where. The road will tell me.
  • Then the watch walks it alone, as usual.
  • Fifty of the roads' monsters: Dust Boggles, Ridge Stumps, Edge Lizards or Snapping Lizards.
  • Fifty. The drivers will feel it before I do.
  • Your bounty. The roads will fill up again; they always do. Come back when they have.

docs.title: Wide Tracks
docs.text:
Goats are being taken from the edges of the herds. Inspect three raider tracks on the Ironback Flats for Skarra, and hunt 60 Flint Hogs there.

Town Midbarium Category Story Given by Skarra Level 39 After The Split Drum Leads to The Raider

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Look at the first track in The Ironback Flats
  2. Look at the second track in The Ironback Flats
  3. Look at the third track in The Ironback Flats
  4. Defeat 60 Flint Hog in The Ironback Flats

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 37,000 EXP
  • 780 mesos
  • Highland Salve x10
  • Travel Ration x10
  • +40 standing with Midbarium
  • +30 standing with Skarra
Dialogue
  • Something takes goats from the edges of the herds at night. One here, one there. Sennu counts twice and still comes up short. The dots on my map follow it out to The Ironback Flats.
  • I measured one of its tracks myself. I want three more, from different ground, so I know I did not dream the size. And the Flint Hogs out there charge anything that stoops, so kill 60 of them while you are at it.
  • Measure with your hand spread, thumb to little finger. Tell me how many hands.
  • Then I measure them myself, next time I can leave the rim. Which is never.
  • Three tracks on The Ironback Flats, and sixty Flint Hogs there.
  • Three hands across. And deep, as if the ground were wet, and it is not. That is what I measured too.
  • I will tell you something I have not said on the rim. Those tracks frighten me. I have seen every beast the slopes have, and I have not seen this one. Keep it to yourself, Player. A captain who is frightened makes a frightened watch.

docs.title: Snail Trouble
docs.text:
Snails are eating the town's gardens. Thin them out in the meadow, then see Ranger Hale at the park gate.

Town Kaldemor Category Story Given by Tobin Completed with Hale Level 2 After Settling In Leads to Shells for the Mayor

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 10 Snail

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 60 EXP
  • 100 mesos
  • +20 standing with Kaldemor
Dialogue
  • Ah, Player, just the one I wanted! The snails are back in the gardens and eat everything they can reach. Would you thin them out? Defeat 10 Snails in the meadow east of the square, then see Hale, the ranger at the park gate.
  • Thank you, Player! The meadow is through the portal on the east side of the square. Hale will be waiting at the park gate.
  • Another day, then. The snails are not going anywhere. That is rather the problem.
  • Still at it? Ten Snails, in the meadow east of the square. Then Hale at the park gate will see you right.
  • Mayor Tobin said you would come! Ten snails, and the gardens will be quiet for a week.
  • Here is your pay, Player. You have the makings of a fine hunter.

docs.title: Brodie's Favour
docs.text:
Two winters ago Sorcha let Brodie have a season's catch on credit, and he has never repaid it. Ask him about the favour, then bring Sorcha what he needs.

Town Goa Harbour Category Side Given by Sorcha Level 26 After Past the Point Leads to The Children

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Talk to Brodie
  2. Bring 20 Firewood (taken)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 3,750 EXP
  • 1,000 mesos
  • Steamed Crab x5
  • +20 standing with Goa Harbour
  • +150 standing with Sorcha
Dialogue
  • Player, you know Brodie? Big man, bigger voice, names his fish? Two winters ago his smokehouse roof fell in and I let him have a whole season's catch on credit.
  • He swore he'd repay it. He swears it every week. Go and stand at his stall and ask him about the favour, nicely, while his customers are listening. Then do whatever he says he needs. I want to see what he comes up with.
  • He's on the Lantern Market. You can't miss him. You can hear him from the coves.
  • No? Ah well. I'll remind him myself. Loudly. Again.
  • Did you see Brodie? Did he squirm? Tell me he squirmed. And whatever he wants, bring it here. You have (how many you carry) Firewood.
  • He said that? Smoke my whole catch for nothing, on his best racks? Well. Well! That's a proper repayment, that is.
  • I'll carry the wood round with the catch myself. I want to see his face. I'll miss shouting at him about it, mind. Here, for your trouble.
  • The favour! Sorcha sent you, didn't she. Of course she did. Listen, friend, I have not forgotten. I simply have not remembered at the right moment, which is a different thing entirely.
  • Here's my offer, and it's a handsome one: I'll smoke her whole catch for nothing, all summer. But my smokehouse is short of wood since the crews pulled back. Take her 20 Firewood from the Driftstumps in the Strandwood, salt-dry wood smokes sweetest, and she brings it round with the fish. Tell her the favour's paid. Starting to be paid.

docs.title: Past the Point
docs.text:
Sorcha beaches the Sea Thrift on the Strandwood shore to gut her catch, and the Wrack Boars have taken it over. Defeat 50 of them.

Town Goa Harbour Category Side Given by Sorcha Level 20 Leads to Brodie's Favour

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text: • Defeat 50 Wrack Boar

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 1,750 EXP
  • 800 mesos
  • Brodie's Smoked Fish x5
  • +20 standing with Goa Harbour
  • +150 standing with Sorcha
Dialogue
  • You there, Player! You're handy with a weapon, everyone says so. I could use that.
  • When I fish past the point I beach the Sea Thrift on the Strandwood shore and gut the catch while the tide turns. Now the Wrack Boars root all along it, and one of them had my bucket last week. My bucket! Thin out 50 Wrack Boars on Strandwood Edge, would you?
  • Good. The Strandwood track leaves the Saltwood Road, up past Gull Heath. Don't let them get behind you, they're cleverer than they look.
  • Fine, fine. I'll take a gutting knife to them myself, then. Don't think I won't.
  • Still pigs on my shingle, Player? Fifty Wrack Boars on Strandwood Edge. Count them out loud if it helps.
  • Fifty? Ha! I'll beach there tomorrow and gut in peace. Well, in peace for me, which is louder than most.
  • I don't take the children past the point any more, so that shingle is just for me and Calder now. Take these, the best fish on the market, and don't tell Brodie I gave his away.

docs.title: The Children
docs.text:
Ronan has been wandering along the cliff foot at low tide. Clear 60 monsters on the Undercliff for Sorcha, then go and see Eilidh on the cove rocks.

Town Goa Harbour Category Side Given by Sorcha Level 32 After Brodie's Favour

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
1. Defeat 60 Undercliff monsters in The Undercliff
  2. Talk to Eilidh

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 10,400 EXP
  • 1,300 mesos
  • Cove Fisher's Hat x1
  • +30 standing with Goa Harbour
  • +200 standing with Sorcha
Dialogue
  • Player. Sit down a moment. No, sit. I need to ask you something, and I don't ask things, I tell them, so this is hard.
  • Ronan came home yesterday with a crab claw as big as his hand and said he found it. Found it! Along the cliff foot at low tide, on the boulders under the Saltface. He's seven.
  • I can't keep him in a box, more's the pity. So clear that beach: 60 monsters on The Undercliff, crabs and newts and whatever else. Then go and find Eilidh on the cove rocks. She'll have something to say. She always does.
  • The way down is off the Gullwalk, south of the town. And Player, thank you. I'll not say it twice.
  • Then I'll tie him to the mast. Don't think I haven't thought about it.
  • Sixty on The Undercliff, then Eilidh on the cove rocks. Go on. I'm counting too, you know.
  • She said that? "Mostly the first bit." Oh, she's mine all right, poor girl.
  • One day I'll explain it all to her, when I know what to say. Here, I had this made for Calder, but his head's too big for it, so it's yours. Keep the sun out of your eyes out there.
  • Mum sent you, didn't she? To clear the cliff foot because of Ronan. She tells you things. She doesn't tell me anything.
  • Tell her I'm ten, not a baby. Tell her I'd have gone and fetched him myself. And tell her thank you. But mostly the first bit.

docs.title: Still Enough
docs.text:
Sorrel teaches Blink to any traveller who can sit through one of his listening lessons without fidgeting.

Town Fairy Forest Category Side Given by Sorrel Level 30 After Past the Last Lantern

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Look at the listening bench in Grove School
  • Defeat 40 Creature of Shimmerwaters (Firefly Slime, Shimmer Slime, Water Sprite, Forest Sprite)

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text:
• 6,292 EXP
  • 660 mesos
  • Skill: Blink
  • +100 standing with Sorrel
  • +15 standing with Fairy Forest
Dialogue
  • ...You fidget.
  • There is a step through the air the school teaches anyone. Not only magicians. Anyone patient. Sit on the bench. Listen. Then go and listen to the lake. Then come back.
  • Sit on the listening bench in the Grove School (examine it), then listen to Shimmerwater while you quiet 40 of its creatures.
  • ...Good.
  • Another time, then. I'll still be here.
  • ...The bench. Then the lake.
  • ...You heard it.
  • Blink. A step through the air, the way you face. Not through walls. Walls are for listening to.

docs.title: What the Wind Says
docs.text:
