docs.title: Skills
docs.text:
Skill numbers come from formulas of the skill level; each table below works them out level by level.

Skill Group Kind Max level Description Power Strike Warrior Attack 20 A strong strike at one enemy in front. Sweeping Slash Warrior Attack 20 A wide slash that sweeps the enemies in front. Ground Breaker Warrior Attack 20 A heavy double slash at the enemies in front. War Leap Warrior Leap 10 Dash far through the air the way you face: jump again in the air, or press its key. Triple Slash Swordsman Attack 20 Three quick cuts at the enemies in front. Blade Wave Swordsman Projectile 20 Sends a blade of force flying ahead, cutting every enemy in its way once. Counter Slash Swordsman Counter 20 Hold a guard: the first attack or touch that would land on you meanwhile is turned aside, and you strike back hard. With nothing to turn aside it does nothing. Sword Dash Swordsman Dash 20 Dash along the ground, cutting every enemy you pass through once. It stops at a wall or the edge of a ledge. Flash Cutter Swordmaster Attack 20 Two lightning cuts in front, cheap and quick. The start of most chains. Blade Cyclone Swordmaster Attack 20 Spin with the blade out and cut everything around you, over and over. Thousand Cuts Swordmaster Attack 20 A storm of cuts too quick to count, on every enemy in front. Rising Blade Swordmaster Attack 20 Carries you up on a rising cut, hitting everything above you on the way. A good way into the air, and to the next chain. Blade Tempest Grand Swordmaster Attack 30 A burst of blades that sweeps the whole screen around you. Perfect Counter Grand Swordmaster Counter 30 Counter Slash perfected: the first attack or touch that would land on you meanwhile is turned aside, and you answer with a flurry. With nothing to turn aside it does nothing. Crescent Divide Grand Swordmaster Attack 30 A wide crescent cut that splits everything far in front of you. Heavenly Severance Sword Saint Attack 30 A cut from the sky that parts the field in two: everything far in front of you falls to it, wave after wave. Infinite Blade Dance Sword Saint Attack 30 A swarm of blades answers your sword and dances through every enemy near you, again and again. Warrior's Resolve Buff Buff 1 Steel yourself for the fight. Using it again starts the time over. Courier's Stride Taught Buff 1 A royal courier's burst of running speed, taught by Perrin: for a few breaths you run faster than any boots allow, then it needs a moment. Rooftop Dash Taught Rush 1 Kite's rooftop trick: a low, fast burst along the ground that stops at the edge, the way the runners cross a roof before the next gap. Sure Footing Taught Passive 1 Ennek's lesson on the canyon ledges: plant your feet and lean into the rock. A hit throws you back far less, and never off a rope or ladder. Sea Legs Taught Passive 1 Garrow's dockhands' trick: keep your footing on anything that moves, and be up again before a second blow lands. Blink Taught Blink 1 Step forward in the blink of an eye, the way you face: the Grove School teaches it to anyone patient enough to sit through a listening lesson. It never passes a wall. Rope Up Taught Rise 1 Throw yourself up onto the rope, ladder or ledge above. Rope Slide Taught Slide 1 On a rope or ladder: let go of everything but the rope and slide down it fast, off its end. Snail Hide Passive Passive 1 A hundred snails taught you where it hurts least. Mushroom Lore Passive Passive 1 You know the woods' mushrooms by their smell, and it clears your head. Pig Sense Passive Passive 1 You can tell where a pig will charge before it does. Kaldemor Stride Passive Passive 1 Everyone in Kaldemor knows you, and you know every shortcut. Hardy Spirit Passive Passive 1 Ten levels of hard knocks have made you stronger. Practiced Hand Passive Passive 1 Two hundred Power Strikes later, even your worst blows land well. Field Hardened Passive Passive 1 Ranger Hale's bounty work toughens the skin. Wayfarer's Gait Passive Passive 1 You have walked Kaldemor's corners and secrets so often that your feet know the way. Roadwise Passive Passive 1 The royal road has shown you its crossings and its hiding places; little on it surprises you. Capital Eyes Passive Passive 1 You see the capital the way its guards do: where a hand is going before it moves. Pathfinder Passive Passive 1 Five finds have taught you what a hidden place looks like from the outside. Highland Lungs Passive Passive 1 You have walked the high ridges until the thin air stopped bothering you. Warden-Friend Passive Passive 1 The wardens of the sea count you as one of their own, and it steadies you. Cave Sense Passive Passive 1 You know which way the water moves in a dark place, and which way out. Brush and Sinew Passive Passive 1 Two hundred foxes taught you to watch the dust, not the fox. Climbers' Grip Passive Passive 1 You have pulled enough newts off the cliffs to keep your own feet on them. Salt-Hardened Passive Passive 1 Stone and weed and salt water have made you hard to move. Gap Inn Regular Passive Passive 1 Bethoc keeps a bowl of stew back for you, and a seat by the fire.

docs.title: Honor
docs.text:
Honor is how the whole kingdom regards you, for deeds done for Wonder Kingdom rather than for one town or one person. It is earned only from deeds the game names (a boss's first clear, a town's story, great milestones), never per kill, and it is never lost. It goes up to 10,000.

Rank Points You are Citizen 0 a citizen of the kingdom Steadfast 500 Steadfast, someone the kingdom can count on Defender 1,500 a Defender of the Kingdom Champion 4,000 a Champion of the Kingdom Hero of the Kingdom 8,000 a Hero of the Kingdom

docs.title: Standing
docs.text:
Standing with a town or an NPC goes up to 1,000 points. Quests, bosses and some conversations raise it.

Rank Points Neighbour 0 Known 100 Friend 300 Trusted 600 Honored 900

docs.title: Status Effects
docs.text:
• Slow: monsters lose 50% of their speed, players 40%
  • Poison, Burning, Bleeding: 5 HP lost every 1 s unless the attack says otherwise
  • Darkness and Weaken: 30% and 30% less damage dealt
  • Curse: 50% less EXP gained
  • Seal: no skills
  • Stun and freeze on a boss last 50% of their time

docs.title: Quests of Kaldemor
docs.text: Kaldemor has 54 quests, grouped below into quest lines in the order they are played. A line is a chain of quests that each need the one before.

docs.title: Welcome Home

docs.title: Discoveries
docs.text:
Hidden places and sights. Each one found gives exploration EXP and counts toward its region's mastery.

Exploration EXP by discovery size: common 10, rare 30, major 100.

Exploration level EXP Reward 1 20 - 2 50 500 mesos 3 90 Orange Potion x5

docs.title: Old Bain's Boat-Hook
docs.text:
Region Bain Harbour Where Bain Harbour Size Common Reward 400 EXP, 200 mesos What you see

Above the Harbour Hall's door hangs Old Bain's boat-hook, ash and iron, every nick on its shaft a story Mabyn will tell. You stood under it and counted them.

docs.title: Baysight
docs.text:
Region Bain Harbour Where Baysight Hill Size Common Reward 600 EXP, 250 mesos What you see

From the highest ledge of Baysight Hill the whole bay opens below: the lighthouse on its headland, the masts, the terracotta roofs and the bright lines of the canals.

docs.title: The Pinch's Rotten Gates
docs.text:
Region Bain Harbour Where The Pinch Size Rare Reward 2,500 EXP, 600 mesos What you see

On the high bank above the Pinch the old lock gates hang rotten on their hinges. Whatever broke the sea gates at the Cut's far end, the tide now runs all the way up to here.

docs.title: The Lighthouse Through the Trees
docs.text:
Region Bain Harbour Where The Timber Path Size Common Reward 9,000 EXP, 900 mesos What you see

From the Timber Path's highest ledge the holm oaks part, and the lighthouse stands white against the sea, so close you could count its windows.

docs.title: The Sea-Hole
docs.text:
Region Bain Harbour Where The Rim Size Rare Reward 30,000 EXP, 2,500 mesos What you see

At the Rim the ground drops away into a round pool of sea water open to the sky, joined somewhere below to the Drop under the headland. At night a pale light comes up out of it through the trees.

docs.title: The Bell in the Cliff
docs.text:
Region Bain Harbour Where The Rigging Size Rare Reward 4,000 EXP, 1,200 mesos What you see

At the top of the Saltgrace's broken mast, high in the Bellcaves, the tide comes in below and the whole cave booms like a struck bell. The sound goes on and on in the timbers under your hands.

docs.title: Marram Cove's Post Box
docs.text:
Region Bain Harbour Where Marram Cove Size Common Reward 800 EXP, 300 mesos What you see

In Marram Cove a weathered box on a post takes the letters for the inland roads. Somebody has carved a tiny ship on its lid.

docs.title: The Heart Tree's Crown
docs.text:
Region Fairy Forest Where Fairy Forest Size Common Reward 400 EXP, 300 mesos What you see

From the top of the Heart Tree the whole forest lies below, lanterns and all, and on a clear day the World Tree stands far off to the west.

docs.title: The Carters' Rest
docs.text:
Region Fairy Forest Where The Forest's Hem Size Common Reward 250 EXP, 200 mesos What you see

A stile where Kaldemor's carters have rested for a hundred years. Someone has carved a little lantern into the top rail.

docs.title: A Carpet of Bluebells
docs.text:
Region Fairy Forest Where The Bloomwood Size Common Reward 600 EXP, 400 mesos What you see

A glade in the Bloomwood so thick with bluebells that the ground looks like water.

docs.title: Where the Lake Glows
docs.text:
Region Fairy Forest Where Shimmerwater, the Second Path Size Rare Reward 3,000 EXP, 1,200 mesos What you see

At dusk the water here glows faintly from below, the colour of Faelan's favourite glass.

docs.title: The Oak's Lookout
docs.text:
Region Fairy Forest Where The Hollow Oak, Heights Size Rare Reward 9,000 EXP, 3,000 mesos What you see

A bough of the Hollow Oak juts out over the lake, and from it Shimmerwater and the High Shore lie spread out like a map.

docs.title: Where the Great Root Breaks the Surface
docs.text:
Region Fairy Forest Where The Deepening, III Size Major Reward 30,000 EXP, 8,000 mesos What you see

A root as thick as a house rises out of the ground here and dives back under. Press an ear to it and it hums. The forest believes it runs all the way to the World Tree.

docs.title: The Gap from Gull Heath
docs.text:
Region Goa Harbour Where Gull Heath Size Common Reward 2,000 EXP, 300 mesos What you see

From the middle of the heath the whole inlet lies below: the town on its cliffs, the quay, and far out the narrow gap between the two headlands where every ship waits for a pilot.

docs.title: The Seabird Ledge
docs.text:
Region Goa Harbour Where The Gullwalk Size Common Reward 3,000 EXP, 400 mesos What you see

On the Gullwalk's highest ledge the seabirds fly level with you, and below them the waves break white on rocks nobody has ever named.

docs.title: The Timber Crews' Lookout
docs.text:
Region Goa Harbour Where Strandwood Edge Size Common Reward 6,000 EXP, 600 mesos What you see

A notched post on the Strandwood's top ledge, where the crews' lookout used to stand. Every notch is a tree brought out safely; the newest are old now.

docs.title: The Old Rope-Way
docs.text:
Region Goa Harbour Where The Saltface Size Rare Reward 20,000 EXP, 1,500 mesos, Sea-Herb Salve x2 What you see

High on the Saltface the stumps of an old rope-way still stand, the iron rings worn smooth. The wardens hauled goods up the cliff here before the Long Stair was cut.

docs.title: The Outermost Stack
docs.text:
Region Goa Harbour Where The Skerries Size Rare Reward 60,000 EXP, 3,000 mesos, Elixir x2 What you see

From the top of the last skerry you can see past the gap into the open sea, and back across the inlet to the lanterns of the quay.

docs.title: The Breathing Pool
docs.text:
Region Goa Harbour Where The Still Pool Size Rare Reward 8,000 EXP, 1,000 mesos What you see

At the Still Pool's edge the water rises a finger's width, then falls again, slow as a sleeper's breath.

docs.title: The Hills' Lookout
docs.text:
Region Kaldemor Where Kaldemor Hills Size Common Reward 150 EXP, 150 mesos What you see

From the top of Kaldemor Hills the whole town lies below: the mushroom roofs, the windmills turning, the park's green and the clock tower. Westward the woods begin, darker than they used to look.

docs.title: Above the Square
docs.text:
Region Kaldemor Where Kaldemor Size Common Reward 150 EXP What you see

From the high west ledge you can see over every roof in Kaldemor to the far end of the main street. Somebody has left a tin cup up here, as if they come often.

docs.title: The High Causeway
docs.text:
Region Kaldemor Where The Greenmarsh Size Common Reward 300 EXP, 200 mesos What you see

The old high path above the Greenmarsh stays dry when the reeds flood. From here the tipped cart below looks very small, and the coast road runs on toward the sea.

docs.title: Where the Brook Meets the Sea
docs.text:
Region Kaldemor Where Shellbrook Mouth Size Rare Reward 500 EXP, 300 mesos, White Potion x5 What you see

On the ledge above Shellbrook Mouth the brook runs out over the sand and the shingle starts. To the east the Strand runs on to Bain Harbour; to the west a path climbs along the coast.

docs.title: The Crossing's High Seat
docs.text:
Region The Royal Road Where The Crossing Size Rare Reward 400 EXP, 300 mesos What you see

At the very top of the Crossing a little stone seat looks down on every lane that meets there: the royal road, the farm tracks, the paths that lead nowhere now.

docs.title: Under the Greenwood's Canopy
docs.text:
Region The Royal Road Where The Greenwood Size Common Reward 250 EXP, 200 mesos What you see

High in the Greenwood the trees close overhead and the road below disappears. The light is green and the only sound is the wind, and somewhere ahead, the capital's bells.

docs.title: The Stargazer's Terrace
docs.text:
Region Midbarium Where Midbarium Size Common Reward 400 EXP, 300 mesos What you see

From the highest terrace the whole night sky opens over the plateau. Someone has scratched star names into the low wall in two hands: a lowlander's letters, and the old Brenna marks beside them.

docs.title: The Greywater Cleft
docs.text:
Region Midbarium Where The South Path Size Common Reward 500 EXP, 300 mesos What you see

A narrow cleft halfway down the South Path, its stone stained dark where water ran for longer than anyone remembers. A Tolmach cup hangs from a peg above it.

docs.title: The Far Canyon Bridge
docs.text:
Region Midbarium Where The Broken Ground Size Common Reward 1,200 EXP, 500 mesos What you see

The far canyon bridge sways over a drop with no bottom you can see. Its new lashings are doubled, and there are tooth marks on the old ones.

docs.title: The High Pasture
docs.text:
Region Midbarium Where The Long Ridge Size Rare Reward 2,500 EXP, Goat Cheese x10 What you see

Above the Long Ridge the old Tolmach pasture is still green in the hollows. A ring of herders' stones marks where the camps stood every summer for longer than the songs go back.

docs.title: The War Camp's Lookout
docs.text:
Region Midbarium Where The Old War Camp Size Rare Reward 15,000 EXP, Travel Ration x10 What you see

The old camp's highest wall still stands. From here the Savages watched the western edge of the highlands, and from here you can see the storm walking over the Withered Reach.

docs.title: The Great Bell
docs.text:
Region Selsior Where Royal Plaza Size Common Reward 300 EXP, 200 mesos What you see

Up close the Great Bell is green with age and warm from the sun. The metal of all four peoples went into it, and the plaza was a treaty field before it was a plaza.

docs.title: The View from the High Lane
docs.text:
Region Selsior Where Royal Plaza Size Common Reward 500 EXP, 200 mesos What you see

From the highest lane above the plaza the whole capital spreads out: the palace roofs, the market's awnings and, far to the north, the World Tree against the sky.

docs.title: The World Tree's Foot
docs.text:
Region Selsior Where The Rootlands Size Common Reward 2,500 EXP, 300 mesos What you see

Up on the highest root the Tree is a wall that goes up and up and never ends. The road stops here; the way in is somewhere higher.

docs.title: Above the Chalk Hives
docs.text:
Region Selsior Where The Chalk Hives Size Common Reward 6,000 EXP, 500 mesos What you see

From the top of the chalk bank you can see the hives cut into the white walls below, and the air hums with them.

docs.title: The First Keep's Stone
docs.text:
Region Selsior Where The Deep Cut Size Rare Reward 60,000 EXP, 2,000 mesos What you see

High in the Deep Cut, an old face still shows the chisel marks of the masons who cut the first keep's walls, long before the golems stood up.

docs.title: The Buried Street's Name
docs.text:
Region Selsior Where The Buried Street Size Rare Reward 8,000 EXP, 800 mesos What you see

Under the dust on an old wall, a street sign of the first fortress town. The letters are an Aristocrat hand, and the name is one nobody in Selsior uses any more.

docs.title: The Crooked Tower's Roof
docs.text:
Region Urbanograd Where Urbanograd Size Common Reward 3,000 EXP, 400 mesos What you see

From the highest roof in the city the whole of Old Grad lies below: the lanterns strung between the towers, the Night Market's glow, the Gate Walk, and the walls the Walkers patched a hundred years ago.

docs.title: The Walkers' Pictures
docs.text:
Region Urbanograd Where Urbanograd Size Common Reward 3,000 EXP, 400 mesos What you see

Under the newer paint by Lantern Square the oldest pictures show through, repainted line for line every spring: a cart full of laughing people, a line of walkers with bundles, a lantern between two towers.

docs.title: The Halfway Stone
docs.text:
Region Urbanograd Where The Halfway Stone Size Common Reward 1,500 EXP, 300 mesos What you see

The tall grey marker is worn smooth at shoulder height. Carters touch it for luck on the way to Selsior; the Walkers, the story goes, sat down here and nearly turned back.

docs.title: The Old Cart Track
docs.text:
Region Urbanograd Where The Outworks: Outer Ditch Size Rare Reward 8,000 EXP, 800 mesos What you see

The grooves along the outer ditch are older than the city: the Aristocrats hauled their stone along them to build Old Grad's walls. Nobody has used them since.

docs.title: The Last Beacon
docs.text:
Region Urbanograd Where Beacon Line Size Rare Reward 30,000 EXP, 2,000 mesos What you see

From the highest stone of the Beacon Line the chain of ruined towers runs east along the crest, each one in sight of the next. Once a fire here could have been seen from the middle of the island.
